774c50a3.title: Senior Solutions Architect, Automotive & Manufacturing
774c50a3.description:
**Description**
 Amazon Web Services (AWS) Automotive and Manufacturing team is looking for an experienced and motivated technologist who possesses a unique balance of technical depth and strong interpersonal skills. As a Senior Solutions Architect, you will partner with some of the world's largest automotive and manufacturing firms, AWS Sales and other AWS teams to craft highly scalable, flexible and resilient cloud architectures that address customer business problems and accelerate the adoption of AWS services.
   

  

 This role will drive AWS technology adoption and revenue growth across assigned automotive and manufacturing customers. As a trusted customer advocate, the Senior Solutions Architect will work directly with leading industrial manufacturers as they reimagine how things are designed, built, and operated. You will serve as a trusted technical advisor, helping customers navigate architectural decisions across connected vehicle platforms, digital twins, smart factory/Industry 4\.0 initiatives, supply chain optimization, and software\-defined vehicle (SDV) strategies.
   

  

 As a key member of the Account Team, you will guide customers' architectural choices across use cases involving IoT, edge computing, high\-performance computing (HPC), security, data lakes and analytics, AI/ML, simulation, and robotics — as well as foundational services spanning compute, storage, and networking. You will provide technical design guidance and thought leadership, contribute to best\-practice knowledge sharing within the broader AWS Solutions Architecture community, and help develop reusable industry reference architectures.
   

  

 The ideal candidate must be self\-motivated with a proven track record in software/technology architecture or consulting. The ability to connect technology with measurable business value is critical to a solutions architect. You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges.
   

  

 What We Are Looking For
   

  

* Enjoy working with large, global customers. You will have a passion for connecting with, educating, training, designing, and building cloud solutions for automotive and manufacturing customers.
* Have a strong understanding of large\-scale, mission\-critical solutions in the automotive and manufacturing industry. The ideal candidate will have past experience working as a systems engineer/architect in the automotive or manufacturing sector. You will enjoy keeping your existing technical skills honed and developing new ones, so you can make strong contributions to deep architecture discussions. You will regularly take part in deep\-dive education and design exercises to create solutions built on AWS.


 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Serve as the primary technical point of contact and trusted advisor for assigned Automotive and Manufacturing accounts, engaging Director\-level engineering leaders and senior technical stakeholders.
* Architect and design scalable, secure, and cost\-effective cloud solutions for industry\-specific workloads including connected vehicle data platforms, digital twin environments, MES/SCADA cloud integration, and smart factory deployments.
* Bridge IT and OT — connect traditional enterprise IT architectures with operational technology (OT) environments on the shop floor and at the edge, leveraging AWS IoT, edge, and hybrid services.
* Develop and execute technical account plans aligned with customers' business objectives and digital transformation roadmaps.
* Lead proof\-of\-concept engagements and architectural reviews to accelerate customer adoption and de\-risk production deployments.
* Provide customer feedback to AWS service teams and advocate for industry\-relevant feature development.
* Contribute to industry thought leadership — create reference architectures, blog posts, and reusable technical assets for the vertical.
* Present at AWS events (re:Invent, Summits, industry conferences) and participate in customer technical workshops.
* Share knowledge and best practices with peers in the Solutions Architecture community, contributing to technical community development.
* Stay current with industry megatrends (electrification, SDV, Industry 4\.0, sustainability) and connect them with AWS capabilities to drive customer outcomes.


**About The Team**
 The Automotive and Manufacturing Solutions Architecture team is a specialized group of technologists passionate about helping the world's leading vehicle manufacturers, industrial companies, and mobility innovators transform through cloud. We work at the intersection of current technology and physical\-world engineering — from the factory floor to the connected car to the autonomous future. Our team values deep industry expertise, intellectual curiosity, and a builder mentality.
   

  

 Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we're building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics) experience
* 3\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* Experience communicating across technical and non\-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients

**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.  




### **OVERVIEW:**

### **This role of Sr. Technical Engineer in Analytics Platform team will be responsible for providing** **enterprise ownership and governance for shared data and ontology components in Palantir** **, ensuring they are well\-managed, reusable, and fit for long\-term scale. The role acts as the central point of coordination for ontology change management, standards enforcement, health monitoring, and stakeholder communication, while bridging business, data, and engineering teams to translate enterprise needs into robust, high\-quality Foundry components.**

  

### **KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:**

  

* ### **Own the architecture, governance, and strategic direction for shared data and end\-to\-end capabilities in Palantir.**
* ### **Serve as the senior consultant for enterprise/shared objects, actions, metadata, and architectural exceptions.**
* ### **Define ownership, lifecycle, decision rights, and accountability models for shared components.**
* ### **Provide architectural oversight of Palantir Foundry platform operations, reliability, scalability, and performance.**
* ### **Own platform management and governance, including access control, Foundry API\-based automation, and administrative support.**
* ### **Provide product architecture consultation for new solution designs and optimization of existing implementations, aligned with industry’s best practices.**
* ### **Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, reusable, and maintainable technical architectures.**
* ### **Lead architecture assessments, design reviews, technology evaluations, and solution recommendations across the Foundry ecosystem.**
* ### **Guide teams through implementation, ensuring alignment with enterprise standards, reference architectures, and governance principles.**
* ### **Identify technical risks, dependencies, integration impacts, and opportunities for reuse before execution.**
* ### **Support delivery teams in resolving architectural challenges and ensure successful implementation of approved designs.**
* ### **Lead the evaluation and adoption of new platform offerings and releases by assessing capabilities, advocating for change requests, and driving timely, transparent implementation.**
* ### **Define and govern enterprise standards for data modelling, ontology design, metadata, security, documentation, and reuse.**
* ### **Drive adoption of architecture principles and best practices across delivery teams and consuming squads.**
* ### **Establish health checks for shared components covering usage, performance, data quality, security, and deprecation needs.**
* ### **Own authoritative documentation for end\-to\-end components, including applications, definitions, ownership, lifecycle, and usage guidance.**
* ### **Monitor adoption, quality, risk, and technical debt to guide continuous improvement and investment.**
* ### **Communicate architectural direction, governance decisions, risks, and business impacts to technical and executive stakeholders.**
* ### **Lead change enablement for major ontology, data\-platform, and Foundry capability changes.**
* ### **Facilitate alignment across product, engineering, data, architecture, security, and business teams.**
* ### **Translate business priorities into scalable, reusable, and governed ontology and data\-platform capabilities.**
* ### **Partner with product owners, data stewards, architects, and engineering leaders to establish common enterprise concepts.**
* ### **Ensure enterprise components support interoperability, scalability, maintainability, and long\-term business value.**
* ### **Guide teams in balancing delivery speed with architectural integrity, platform sustainability, and total cost of ownership.**
* ### **Mentor technical engineers and architects and raise architecture maturity across the organization.**
* ### **Define the architecture and priorities for automated workflows, controls, and observability within Palantir Foundry.**

### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* ### **Results\-oriented, high energy, self\-motivated**

efffcc21.description:
**ROLE PURPOSE** 





 RightWalk Foundation works to solve socio\-economic inequality by co\-shaping and co\-designing public policy in Education, Livelihood and Health — converting policy into real, on\-ground outcomes in partnership with governments across India. Under the PMU – Gujarat Apprenticeship Mission, RightWalk drives large\-scale Job Readiness and Apprenticeship programmes for youth, using the Chatur AI Platform and Propel LMS to move students from training into employment.
 





 As Program Manager \- Operations, you will own end\-to\-end delivery of RightWalk's Job Readiness \& Apprenticeship programme in Gujarat — turning strategy into disciplined execution across institutions, government stakeholders and field teams. You will be the operational backbone ensuring programmes run on time, on budget, and with data you can defend — from student onboarding to placement.
 




**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**1\. Programme Delivery** 



* Plan and execute Job Readiness / Apprenticeship programmes across partner ITIs and colleges.
* Drive student onboarding on Chatur AI and NAPS ID registration.
* Oversee baseline and endline assessments, and 10/20/30/60\-hour learning pathways.



**2\. Team \& Stakeholders** 



* Lead and mentor field coordinators and trainers on\-ground.
* Liaise with the PMU – Gujarat Apprenticeship Mission and government stakeholders.
* Build partnerships with institutions and industry for apprenticeship uptake.



**3\. MIS \& Quality** 



* Track KPIs — enrolment, attendance, assessment, conversion — on Propel LMS.
* Publish dashboards and reports for leadership, government and donors.
* Run quality audits and close the loop on field feedback.



**4\. Compliance \& Budget** 



* Ensure adherence to organisational and government compliance norms.
* Manage programme budgets, resourcing and vendor coordination.
* Build and institutionalise scalable SOPs.



**CANDIDATE PROFILE** 



* Education: Graduate / Postgraduate in Management, Social Work, Development Studies or a related field.
* Experience: 5–8 years in programme / operations management, preferably in education, skilling or livelihoods.
* Language: Fluent in English, Gujarati and Hindi; comfortable working with government offices.
* Core skills: Strong project and multi\-site programme management.
* Core skills: MIS, dashboards and advanced MS Excel / Google Sheets.
* Core skills: Stakeholder and government liaison.
* Core skills: Team leadership and field capacity building.
* Core skills: Data\-driven, outcome\-oriented decision making.
* Core skills: Willingness to travel extensively across Gujarat.



**WHAT WE OFFER** 



* Large\-scale impact on youth employability.
* A collaborative, mission\-driven culture.
* Direct exposure to government and policy systems.
* Compensation aligned to sector standards.

5693740e.description:
**Description**
 Sales, Marketing and Global Services (SMGS)
   

  

 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.
   

  

 As a Customer Solution Manager you will work with the largest and most complex enterprises in the world, to enable their multi\-year journey to the cloud. In this new, highly visible, role you will ensure that all AWS teams work together effectively and efficiently to deliver migration, modernization and GenAI outcomes for the customer in relation to Amazon Web Services (AWS) Cloud.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 You will be a trusted advisor to the customer. You will leverage your complex program management, technical, organizational, and transformation expertise to understand customer's business and strategic goals, translate them into an executable plan, and drive the implementation to success by working with the customer, AWS, and our partners. You will understand your customers' biggest IT challenges and provide prescriptive guidance, based on AWS best practices, to guide them through their migration and modernization journey to AWS at scale.
   

  

 You will take end\-to\-end ownership of multiple migration, modernization and GenAI projects within a single enterprise or across several enterprises, utilizing your communication skills to interface with and influence a broad range of multi\-disciplinary teams (Business development, solutions architecture, support, product, professional services, and partners). The Customer Solution Manager role is responsible for cloud migration and modernization programs (incl. technical, operational, organizational, and education) that span across traditional IT teams and business units.
   

  

 Engaging from the inception stage onwards, you will have a deep understanding of your customer's business vision, culture, and processes, you will be your customer's voice within AWS, ensuring that their needs are accurately communicated to AWS leadership, product, and engineering teams. Engaging during the latter stages of the business cycle you will be responsible for ensuring consistent best\-practices are applied, including: (1\) ensuring Migration Readiness Assessment (MRA) is conducted and bringing in SMEs to deliver the migration foundations (e.g. landing zone build, security controls, operating model, training etc.), (2\) Migration kick off workshops are conducted (including stakeholder alignment), and (3\) Executive Steering Committees and reporting are established, including customer, partner, and AWS Cloud exec sponsors and ensure mechanisms are in place to identify and mitigate any identified risks. You should be passionate about delivering a great customer experience by delivering successful IT transformation programs. You will ensure that the customer IT and business stakeholders are aligned, to ensure broad adoption of the migration and modernization across the customer organization. You will use AWS mechanisms to inform the customer migration journey. Where required, you will lead the interaction with specialist teams, ProServ and Partners for handoffs, especially with respect to migreation, modernization and GenAI implementation.
   

  

 In addition to your customer facing responsibilities, you will help shape the rapidly growing Customer Solution Management function, where your passion to define and implement standard processes, methodologies, and tools will be highly valued. Passionate about customer value creation, you will be adept at measuring and quantifying customer value realization and ensuring it stays on path. Successful candidates will have a technical program management background, technology foundation and consultative mindset, be detail driven, and have experience in managing teams to deliver complex programs. You will be a passionate and proven leader with the ability to gain stakeholder buy\-in, communicate confidently at both the executive and project team level, and collaborate with a wide range of technical and non\-technical teams, regardless of geographical or organizational boundaries to ensure compliance with AWS Standards, policies and best practices. You will be comfortable in working with diverse teams to ensure appropriate partners are on\-boarded and involved in the migration as required. Be an active participant of steering committees and governance structures regardless of who is leading the migration and modernization and act as the point of contact for escalations if the migration and modernization hits barriers. You will be proactive in assessing Migration and modernization progress and design and implement plans to mitigate any risks or delays. Along with project management cadence, you will support the people and process pillars of migration including CCOE design and be the overall owner of reporting and system updates related to the health of migration. You will be a natural problem solver with a cool head that can deal with ambiguity, work autonomously to drive the deliver results for your customer, build IP, and share best practice across geographies.

d6a1addc.description:
**Description**
 AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end\-to\-end products that surprise and delight out\-of\-the\-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.
   

  

 We are optimizing the shopping experience for Amazon's Customers in the Physical retail space. This role will be a key member of the program team located in Hyderabad supporting Just Walk Out (JWO) tech and business teams. The successful candidate will be a self\-starter, comfortable with ambiguity, with strong attention to detail, an ability to work in a fast\-paced, high\-energy, and ever\-changing environment. The drive and capability to shape the business group strategy is a must. A successful candidate will:
   

  

* Have the ability to work independently in a broad array of environments.
* Manage cross\-functional project teams, planning, organizing, and executing complex projects across multiple organizations and stakeholders to enable the launch of new sites at scale.
* Build strong partnerships with operations leaders to understand improvement opportunities.
* Have the ability to work in a fast\-paced environment.
* Confidence operating in a highly ambiguous and iterative business space.
* High attention to detail including proven ability to manage multiple competing priorities simultaneously.
* Willingness to challenge and influence senior leaders.
* Able to work in a diverse team


 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Develop, review, approve, coordinate, and lead large strategic projects / programs within Amazon Business Units (BUs) and across different geographies.
* Build relationships and partner across cross\-functional teams to build and execute on new initiatives and roadmaps.
* Collaborate with global stakeholders and partners to deliver on project goals. Coordinate a portfolio of programs from inception to delivery.
* Define and implement metrics to measure performance across procurement, operations, and transportation logistics.
* Compile, manage, and report on weekly project metrics and be responsible for leading meetings to align on project requirements.
* Communicate program status updates to the stakeholders and senior leadership on a regular basis.
* Provide program insights and data driven recommendations to support strategic decisions.


**About The Team**
 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
   

  

 We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 3\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of Excel at an intermediate level (e.g., pivot tables \& charts, multiple criteria lookups, nested logical/IF formulas, data cleansing, array formulas, etc.)
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 5\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules
* Experience identifying and resolving complex issues


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. 52d9f46c.description:
**About Us**
 Zelis is modernizing the healthcare financial experience in the United States (U.S.) across payers, providers, and healthcare consumers. We serve more than 750 payers, including the top five national health plans, regional health plans, TPAs and millions of healthcare providers and consumers across our platform of solutions. Zelis sees across the system to identify, optimize, and solve problems holistically with technology built by healthcare experts – driving real, measurable results for clients.
   

  

 At Zelis, AI is woven into the fabric of how we work. Every associate is expected \- and empowered \- to partner with AI to challenge the status quo, accelerate innovation, and amplify their impact. This is a place for builders with a growth mindset who act with agility, embrace change, and use modern technology to shape smarter solutions, exceptional experiences, and the future of our industry for our clients, customers, and our culture.
   

  

**Why We Do What We Do**
 In the U.S., consumers, payers, and providers face significant challenges throughout the healthcare financial journey. Zelis helps streamline the process by offering solutions that improve transparency, efficiency, and communication among all parties involved. By addressing the obstacles that patients face in accessing care, navigating the intricacies of insurance claims, and the logistical challenges healthcare providers encounter with processing payments, Zelis aims to create a more seamless and effective healthcare financial system.
   

  

 Zelis India plays a crucial role in this mission by supporting various initiatives that enhance the healthcare financial experience. The local team contributes to the development and implementation of innovative solutions, ensuring that technology and processes are optimized for efficiency and effectiveness. Beyond operational expertise, Zelis India cultivates a collaborative work culture, leadership development, and global exposure, creating a dynamic environment for professional growth. With hybrid work flexibility, comprehensive healthcare benefits, financial wellness programs, and cultural celebrations, we foster a holistic workplace experience. Additionally, the team plays a vital role in maintaining high standards of service delivery and contributes to Zelis’ award\-winning culture.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 Technical Program Manager – AI\-Enabled Engineering Pods
   

  

 Role Title: Technical Program Manager – Full Stack, Cloud \& AI Engineering
   

  

 Location: Hyderabad, India
   

  

 Experience Required: Minimum 14\+ years of experience
   

  

 We are looking for a seasoned
 **Technical Program Manager** 
 to lead and manage multiple cross\-functional engineering pod teams based in Hyderabad. This role requires strong technical depth, hands\-on understanding of modern full stack engineering practices, cloud\-native platforms, DevSecOps, and practical experience using AI and Gen AI platforms to improve engineering productivity, delivery predictability, quality, and operational excellence.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have prior experience managing complex technology programs involving distributed engineering teams, product owners, architects, developers, QA engineers, DevOps teams, security teams, and business stakeholders. The candidate must be comfortable operating at both strategic and execution levels — driving roadmap alignment, technical delivery, architecture discussions, release governance, dependency management, risk mitigation, and executive\-level reporting.
   

  

 This is not a pure project management role. The candidate is expected to bring strong technical judgment, understand engineering trade\-offs, challenge solution approaches where required, and guide teams toward scalable, secure, maintainable, and AI\-enabled delivery practices.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Program \& Delivery Leadership**
* Lead multiple engineering pod teams delivering full stack, cloud\-native, and enterprise\-grade digital applications.
* Own end\-to\-end program execution across planning, design, development, testing, release, deployment, and production support.
* Drive delivery predictability across multiple pods by managing scope, schedule, dependencies, risks, milestones, and release commitments.
* Partner with product owners, architects, engineering managers, QA leads, DevOps teams, security teams, and business stakeholders to ensure successful execution.
* Establish clear operating rhythms across sprint planning, backlog refinement, architecture reviews, dependency tracking, release planning, and production readiness.
* Monitor execution health across pods and proactively address blockers, capacity gaps, technical risks, and cross\-team dependencies.
* Drive alignment between business objectives, product priorities, technical architecture, and delivery execution.
* Ensure programs are delivered with strong focus on quality, security, scalability, maintainability, and operational stability.


**Technical Program Management**
* Facilitate technical design discussions across .NET Core, Angular, REST APIs, microservices, cloud platforms, databases, DevSecOps, and integration platforms.
* Partner with architects and senior engineers to validate solution approaches, identify architectural risks, and ensure adherence to enterprise standards.
* Drive technical governance across application architecture, API design, cloud integration, security, performance, observability, and deployment practices.
* Ensure engineering teams follow clean architecture, SOLID principles, secure coding practices, CI/CD standards, and cloud engineering best practices.
* Track and manage technical debt, platform modernization initiatives, production stability issues, and engineering improvement plans.
* Support teams in resolving production issues related to performance, scalability, reliability, integrations, cloud services, and deployment pipelines.
* Ensure delivery teams adopt appropriate engineering metrics, including sprint predictability, defect leakage, deployment frequency, change failure rate, code quality, test coverage, and production incident trends.


**AI \& Gen AI Enablement**
* Drive responsible adoption of AI and Gen AI tools across engineering pods to improve productivity, code quality, documentation, testing, and problem\-solving.
* Enable teams to use platforms such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT Enterprise, Azure OpenAI, Amazon Q, Gemini, or similar enterprise\-approved AI platforms.
* Identify practical AI use cases across software delivery, including code generation, refactoring, unit test generation, API documentation, technical design documentation, defect analysis, and security review support.
* Establish AI usage guardrails aligned with enterprise security, data privacy, compliance, intellectual property, and responsible AI policies.
* Partner with engineering and security teams to evaluate AI\-assisted development workflows and ensure safe adoption.
* Track productivity and quality improvements resulting from AI\-enabled engineering practices.
* Promote a culture of AI\-assisted engineering while ensuring human accountability for design, code quality, security, and production outcomes.


**Agile, DevSecOps \& Release Governance**
* Lead agile execution across multiple pods using Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, or hybrid delivery models.
* Drive consistent sprint ceremonies, backlog hygiene, estimation practices, release planning, and execution governance.
* Ensure CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, quality gates, code reviews, test automation, security scans, and release approvals are integrated into delivery workflows.
* Partner with DevOps and platform teams to improve deployment reliability, environment stability, monitoring, logging, and incident response.
* Ensure production releases meet defined entry and exit criteria, including quality, security, performance, and operational readiness checks.
* Drive continuous improvement across engineering processes, agile maturity, DevSecOps adoption, and delivery effectiveness.


**Stakeholder \& Executive Communication**
* Provide clear, concise, and data\-driven program updates to senior leadership, including Directors, VPs, and CXO\-level stakeholders where required.
* Communicate program status, risks, dependencies, financial impacts, delivery trade\-offs, and mitigation plans with appropriate executive clarity.
* Prepare roadmap views, release dashboards, dependency maps, risk registers, decision logs, and program health reports.
* Translate complex technical topics into business\-relevant insights for non\-technical stakeholders.
* Drive decision\-making across competing priorities, delivery constraints, architecture options, and risk scenarios.


**Required Skills And Experience**
* Minimum 14\+ years of overall technology experience, with strong background in software engineering, technical delivery, program management, or engineering leadership.
* Proven experience managing multiple engineering pods or cross\-functional agile teams in a complex enterprise environment.
* Strong technical understanding of full stack application delivery using .NET Core / ASP.NET Core, Angular, C\#, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
* Solid understanding of REST APIs, microservices, backend services, cloud\-native application patterns, and scalable web architectures.
* Experience working with AWS and/or Azure cloud platforms.
* Strong understanding of relational databases such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or MySQL.
* Good understanding of application security, authentication, authorization, identity management, logging, monitoring, and performance optimization.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevSecOps practices, Git\-based workflows, automated deployment, and production release governance.
* Working knowledge of containerization and orchestration platforms such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Familiarity with event\-driven systems and messaging platforms such as Azure Service Bus, AWS SQS/SNS, Kafka, or RabbitMQ.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, ARM templates, Bicep, or AWS CloudFormation.
* Practical experience using AI or Gen AI platforms such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Azure OpenAI, Amazon Q, Gemini, or equivalent tools.
* Strong understanding of agile delivery models, sprint execution, roadmap planning, dependency management, and engineering metrics.
* Ability to challenge technical assumptions, identify delivery risks, and drive resolution across engineering, product, QA, DevOps, security, and business teams.
* Excellent communication skills with ability to engage senior leadership and technical teams with equal effectiveness.


**Preferred Technical Capabilities**
* Prior hands\-on software engineering experience before moving into technical program management or engineering leadership.
* Experience managing enterprise\-scale modernization, cloud migration, platform transformation, or digital product engineering programs.
* Exposure to regulated industries such as healthcare, fintech, insurance, life sciences, or other compliance\-heavy environments.
* Strong understanding of enterprise architecture governance, security reviews, audit requirements, and compliance controls.
* Experience with observability platforms, production support models, SRE practices, and incident management.
* Experience implementing AI\-assisted SDLC practices across large engineering teams.
* Understanding of responsible AI, AI governance, data privacy, secure prompt usage, and enterprise AI adoption frameworks.


**AI Platform Expectations**
 The candidate should be hands\-on and comfortable using AI platforms to:
   

  

* Improve engineering productivity across multiple pod teams.
* Assist with code review, code generation, and refactoring analysis.
* Generate unit test cases and improve test coverage.
* Support API documentation, architecture documentation, and technical design documentation.
* Analyze technical designs, logs, defects, and production issues for faster triage.
* Identify security, performance, and maintainability concerns in application delivery.
* Build reusable AI\-enabled workflows for engineering teams.
* Promote responsible AI adoption in alignment with enterprise policies.
* Ensure AI tools are used as productivity accelerators while preserving engineering accountability, security, and compliance.


**Leadership \& Soft Skills**
* Strong ownership mindset with ability to operate independently in a senior leadership\-facing role.
* Excellent stakeholder management, negotiation, and conflict\-resolution skills.
* Ability to lead multiple teams through ambiguity, changing priorities, and complex dependencies.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to balance delivery speed with technical quality, security, scalability, and maintainability.
* Strong communication skills with ability to simplify complex technical issues for executive audiences.
* Ability to mentor pod leads, scrum masters, technical leads, and engineering teams on delivery discipline and engineering best practices.
* Strong execution discipline with focus on measurable outcomes, delivery transparency, and continuous improvement.


**Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging**
 At Zelis, we champion diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging in all aspects of our operations. We embrace the power of diversity and create an environment where people can bring their authentic and best selves to work. We know that a sense of belonging is key not only to your success at Zelis, but also to your ability to bring your best each day.
   

  

**Equal Employment Opportunity**
 Zelis is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
   

  

**Accessibility Support**
 We are dedicated to ensuring our application process is accessible to all candidates. If you are a qualified individual with a disability and require reasonable accommodation with any part of the application and/or interview process, please email talentacquisition@zelis.com.

This role requires a strong blend of cybersecurity expertise, presales experience, and consultative problem\-solving to translate complex customer requirements into scalable, multi\-layered security architectures. You will work closely with sales, OEMs, and delivery teams to enable deal success, influence customer decisions, and drive revenue growth. The ideal candidate is hands\-on, business\-aware, and capable of engaging stakeholders across technical and leadership levels.

* Design and present end\-to\-end cybersecurity solutions across SIEM, SOAR, XDR, NDR, SSE, NAC, WAF, and SOC services

* Solid understanding of networking fundamentals including routing, switching, firewalls, VPNs, and SD\-WAN
* Proven experience in designing security architectures, delivering PoCs, and conducting customer workshops
* Experience in handling RFP/RFI responses, technical proposals, and end\-to\-end presales lifecycle

* Strong understanding of compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001, NIST, GDPR, PCI\-DSS
* Experience designing SOC architectures, detection use cases, or managed security service models
* Exposure to multi\-vendor security environments and integration of diverse security technologies
* Experience engaging with CXO\-level stakeholders and influencing strategic security decisions
* Ability to mentor junior presales team members and contribute to sales enablement initiatives
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset with focus on customer outcomes


**Why Gruve**
 At Gruve, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute their best work. If you’re passionate about technology and eager to make an impact, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

 Gruve is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and thank all who apply; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

3b70317d.title: Sales Engineer (Presales)
3b70317d.description:
Why Join Us?
   

  

**About Us**
 At Check Point, what you do matters. Every day, we protect over 100,000 organizations worldwide from increasingly sophisticated cyber and AI\-driven threats, securing their AI transformation.
   

  

 Our prevention\-first approach safeguards hybrid networks, cloud environments, digital workspaces, and AI systems, stopping attacks before they happen.
   

  

 This is where innovation meets real\-world impact. You’ll help customers across industries operate with confidence in a rapidly changing digital world, working alongside smart, curious people who take ownership, challenge assumptions, and solve complex problems.
   

  

 We’re proud to be recognized by TIME, Newsweek, and Forbes for excellence and workplace culture.
   

  

 What really sets Check Point apart is the opportunity to grow, contribute, and help companies navigate their AI transformation securely.
   

  

 If you’re excited to work at the forefront of AI\-driven security on a global scale, this is the place to do it.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**Your Role in a Nutshell**
 No two days are the same. You'll work hands\-on with market\-leading technologies, diagnose customers' toughest security challenges, and design solutions alongside partners — playing a central role in high\-impact projects from discovery through delivery. If you thrive at the intersection of deep technical expertise and real business impact, this is your seat at the table.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Drive the win. Partner with partner sales teams to identify prospects, progress opportunities, and demonstrate Check Point's value proposition where it matters most — in front of the customer.
* Be the face of Check Point. Present at partner\-led customer events, workshops, and industry forums, bringing our story and our technology to life.
* Prove it out. Lead and co\-execute POCs and technical assessments alongside partner technical and presales teams, turning prospects into believers.
* Lead with value. Guide conversations that uncover real business problems and translate them into winning technical solutions — not just feature lists.
* Be the trusted advisor. Serve as a go\-to cybersecurity resource for partner technical communities, fielding tough technical questions and articulating solution benefits with confidence.
* Stay sharp. Keep a pulse on cybersecurity trends and the competitive landscape so every engagement is informed by what's happening now.
* Support the full cycle. Help partners respond to RFIs/RFPs, share best practices, and manage POCs so every customer gets an excellent experience from first conversation to close.
* Enable others. Train and enable partners and customers on the latest security technologies, multiplying your impact across every account you touch.
* Grow the account. Position Check Point's portfolio to maximize cross\-sell and upsell opportunities within partner accounts.
* Deliver excellence. Build solution designs and high\-impact proposals that reinforce Check Point's reputation as a security leader.
* Represent the brand. Show up at cybersecurity events and live demos as a credible, engaging voice for Check Point.


**Qualifications**
**What You'll Bring**
* 8\+ years in technology organizations, including 4–6\+ years in systems engineering, presales, or partner engineering roles
* A genuinely customer\-centric mindset and a commitment to delivering an excellent customer experience

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience building generative AI applications, intelligent agents, or LLM\-powered solutions, and working directly with technical customers.
* Ability to communicate in English fluently to support client relationship management.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Experience building and orchestrating agents using Agent Development Kits (ADKs) or popular frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen).
* Experience implementing Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures and securely connecting LLMs with external productivity tools (e.g., Google Workspace) and internal databases.
* Experience in leveraging LLMs to deploy multimodal solutions encompassing text, image, video, and voice.
* Experience deploying, configuring, and managing enterprise\-grade generative AI platforms, particularly Gemini Enterprise, with an understanding of security, governance, and compliance requirements.
* Knowledge of cloud computing, including serverless execution environments, virtualization, hosted services, multi\-tenant cloud infrastructures, and secure cloud networking.


**About The Job**
 The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.
   

  

 As a Cloud AI Engineer, you'll play a key leadership role in ensuring that strategic customers have the best experience adopting Gemini Enterprise alongside the broader Google Cloud Agentic AI suite of products. You will design and implement robust, production\-ready application architectures to support customer use cases, leveraging Gemini Enterprise and core Google AI products. You'll work with customers to identify opportunities to transform their workflows with autonomous agents, actively removing technical barriers to ensure successful deployment and high adoption rates of Gemini Enterprise. You will have access to Google’s technology to monitor application performance, debug and troubleshoot complex agent behaviors, and address customer and partner needs. In this role, you will lead the end\-to\-end and timely execution of adopting Google Cloud Platform solutions to the customer.
   

  

 Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

* Provide guidance on existing product challenges, and collaborate with the engineering team to address the challenges or provide possible workarounds.
* Deliver leading practice recommendation and technical presentations adapted to different levels of key business and technical stakeholders to proactively foster Gemini Enterprise adoption and enablement.

**The Opportunity**

  



As a Senior Consultant within EY's Digital Health Excellence Center (DHEC), you will advise healthcare providers, public sector organizations, health systems, and digital health stakeholders on designing modern healthcare data ecosystems that enable interoperability, advanced analytics, and digital transformation initiatives across Germany and the European Union. You will bridge business, clinical, and technology domains to help clients realize value from healthcare data while ensuring compliance with European regulatory requirements.

	+ Support business case development and roadmap creation for digital health initiatives.

	+ Design and implement healthcare data architectures integrating clinical, operational, and administrative data sources.
	+ Develop logical and physical data models for structured and unstructured healthcare datasets.
	+ Define interoperability approaches leveraging standards such as HL7 FHIR and related healthcare frameworks.
	+ Enable seamless data exchange across EHRs, clinical systems, digital health platforms, and public health ecosystems.
* **Cloud \& Modern Data Platforms**
	+ Advise clients on cloud\-based healthcare data platforms across Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud environments.
	+ Design data lakes, data warehouses, ETL/ELT frameworks, API\-enabled architectures, and scalable analytics platforms.
	+ Support adoption of AI\-enabled analytics and advanced reporting capabilities to improve healthcare outcomes and operational performance.
* **Regulatory \& Compliance Advisory**
	+ Ensure healthcare data solutions comply with GDPR, health data regulations, and applicable EU requirements.
	+ Advise clients on data privacy, security, governance, and risk management considerations.
* **Project Delivery \& Leadership**
	+ Lead workstreams within complex healthcare transformation programs.
	+ Collaborate with architects, clinicians, product teams, and executive stakeholders to ensure successful delivery.
	+ Mentor junior consultants and contribute to capability building within the Digital Health Excellence Center.
	+ Support proposal development, business development activities, and client relationship management.

  





**Experience \& Qualifications**

  


**Required Experience**

  


* 4–7 years of experience in healthcare consulting, healthcare IT, data architecture, health informatics, or digital transformation.
* Experience designing enterprise data solutions within healthcare or highly regulated industries.
* Proven experience working with multidisciplinary business and technology stakeholders.

  


**Technical Expertise**

  


* Data Architecture and Data Modelling.
* Healthcare Interoperability, including HL7 and FHIR.
* SQL and NoSQL databases.
* ETL/ELT and Data Integration Platforms.
* Cloud Platforms, including Azure, AWS, and GCP.
* Data Governance and Master Data Management.
* Healthcare Analytics and AI\-enabled Data Solutions.

  


**Education**

  


* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Health Informatics, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field.

  


**Languages**

  


* German: C1 or above.
* English: C1 or above.

  


**What We Look For**

  


* Strong consulting and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to executive and clinical audiences.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience working in Agile project environments.
* Passion for healthcare innovation and digital transformation.
* Ability to operate effectively in international and multicultural environments.

920e945c.description:
**Description**
 AWS Global Sales (AGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.
   

  

 Are you excited to work with the team that enables India’s conglomerates to build innovative services with AWS, scaling to serve billion\+ Indians? The Conglomerates team in AWS India is looking for a Solutions Architect who can work with our customers who are augmenting their existing business empires with new business models on the foundations of payment infrastructure like UPI, quick commerce, widespread 5G internet access, affordable smartphones, exploding digital content, identity infrastructure like Aadhaar and world class AI \& cloud infrastructure. These new businesses are rapidly and profoundly changing everyday life of billion\+ Indians through their platforms \& services for E\-commerce, Smart Factories, Connected Vehicles, Travel \& Hospitality, FinTech and many more.
   

  

 \#aws\-ags\-India
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Your broad responsibilities will include, owning the technical engagement and ultimate success around specific implementation projects, and developing deep expertise in the AWS technologies as well as broad know\-how around how applications and services are constructed using the AWS platform. An ideal candidate should have worked on solution design \& architecture of as part of a CoE, Cloud Practice team etc. Candidate must have have in\-depth experience one or more of following technologies \- Full stack application development/ DevOps / Databases / Networking / Security / Observability / Data Analytics \& AIML. Good understanding of patterns and frameworks and ability to identify trade\-offs is required. Candidate should have a flair for hands\-on coding to do Proof of Concepts and demonstrate technologies. Candidate should be good at identifying repeatable pattern and best practices, and able to learn new technologies and customer business domain.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will possess customer facing skills that will allow them to represent AWS India well within a customer’s or partner's environment and drive discussions with mid to senior personnel within the company, as well as a technical background that enables them to easily interact and give guidance to software developers and architects.
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (DEI) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 The selected candidate will work with subsidiairies / JV of large Indian conglomerates to map business requirements to technology. This will include but not limited to, understanding various design patterns \& discern between various data \& compute technologies. The candidate will also ensure right TCO while meeting the functional \& non\-functional requirements. The candidate will also guide on building DevSecOps, Observability \& Monitoring of Infrastructure \& Applications; conduct Well Architected Reviews; partner with AWS Domain \& Technology Specialists to implement innovative solutions; collaborate with the Service Teams to identify feature gaps \& engage with Technical communities and Customer C\-Suite on Technology strategy \& Best practices.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Conglomerates team is one of the most diverse teams you would ever get in your career. Our team members have deep technology experience spanning areas of Analytics, IoT, AI/ML, GenAI, Observability, Resiliency \& Security. Top it up with years of domain expertise across Automotive, Manufacturing, e\-Commerce, Telco, Travel \& Hospitality \- this is the team where Tech meets Business for the largest movers \& shakers of India's push to $5T economy.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics) experience
* 3\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 10\+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* Experience architecting/operating solutions built on AWS
* Experience communicating across technical and non\-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients
* Knowledge of SAP systems (like SAP Business Suite, S/4HANA, SAP Business Warehouse, SAP HANA, SAP Business Objects, etc.) and their architecture and infrastructure needs
* Experience leading or developing high quality, enterprise scale software products using a structured system development lifecycle
* 5\+ years of solving problems with technology in the Automotive \& Manufacturing industries experience

* Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Experience leading workshops, training sessions, and presenting technical solutions to diverse audiences.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Familiarity with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker) and orchestration tools (e.g., Kubernetes) for scalable and efficient model deployment.

add45747.title: Solutions Architect, ISV
add45747.description:
**Description**
 AWS Global Sales (AGS) drives adoption of the AWS Cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud.
   

  

 Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer\-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud.
   

  

 AWS is where innovation, risks, and ideas are celebrated. We are builders; we try new things, imagine big dreams and reuse whenever we can. It is still Day 1 for us, and we are looking for curious people to be part of our diverse teams of thinkers, problem solvers, and doers. Come join us and work with AWS technologies that enable our Independent Software Vendor (ISV) customers and partners to adopt cloud\-based solutions.
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 This role is within the ISV team in Amazon Web Services India (AWS India) and can be based out of Bangalore, Delhi, Mumbai, Pune and Hyderabad locations.
   

  

 As a Solutions Architect, you’ll help your customers plan their successful cloud journey leveraging emerging technologies like GenAI to achieve business outcomes. You’ll solve complex, technical challenges so your customers can focus on their business. This includes using your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures. You’ll drive or take part in technical solutions discussions, diving deep into the details with customer teams.
   

  

 Building relationships to understand our customers and partners is key. As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll use your interpersonal skills to influence a variety of stakeholders from technical teams to executives. You’ll help ensure their short\-term technology decisions are aligned with their long\-term goals. Speeding up the adoption of our services will be part of your day to day.
   

  

 You’ll also act as thought leader in the wider community. This includes taking part in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops. You won’t just be part of an industry movement; you’ll be leading it.
   

  

 As a customer obsessed advisor, you’ll also have the chance to shape the direction of our products and services. This is through gathering feedback from customers whilst collaborating with our engineering and service teams.
   

  

 To be successful in this role you need to be passionate about ISV and cloud architectures. You are a builder with genuine curiosity about how technology can support your customers’ business models and objectives.
   

  

 Want to find out what it’s like to be a Solution Architect at AWS? Watch this video (https://bit.ly/3keYcC9\).
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 The Solutions Architect team at AWS is responsible for helping customers successfully implement cloud technologies. In a typical week you will meet multiple customers, and you will collaborate with them on designing and operating well\-architected solutions. You will earn their trust and show them the art of the possible, educating them around the capabilities of AWS. Partnering with internal teams and experts, leveraging a deep knowledge of our tools and products, you’ll craft highly scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures that address our customers’ business problems. As part of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to continuously learn and innovate daily.
   

  

**About The Team**
 ISV Solutions Architects work hand in hand with AWS customers to help drive AWS services adoption. They are at the crossroads of business and technology and engage with customers of different stages. Supporting the overall technical relationship between customers and AWS, they work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology. Solutions Architects also have broader impact at scale, taking a supporting role in creating and presenting technical content and best practices.
   

  

 You will be part of a team that is responsible for driving adoption of AWS technologies while bringing differentiated value to customers. This is a team dedicated to ISV customers, an important and growing subset of customers for AWS India. ISV customers follow unique technology adoption patterns and growth trajectories that distinguish them from traditional businesses, so you will be employing engagement strategies and programs tailored to their business needs and technical preferences.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience in design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures
* Experience in a similar role such as technical account manager, consultant, solutions architect, platform engineer, systems engineer, cloud architect, or service delivery manager
* Experience in specific technology domain areas like software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data and analytics
* 4\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
* Experience communicating clearly and concisely with leadership, stakeholders, and cross\-functional teams
* Can create proof of concepts, demos, and/or scripts from scratch or leveraging reusable components.
* Able to create technical content that is easily adopted and reusable by others.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Knowledge of AWS services
* Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud
* Experience architecting/operating solutions built on AWS, or experience implementing a cloud\-based technology solution
* Experience implementing cloud services including migrations and modernization projects or similar
* AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification, or Cloud Technology Certification
* Able to present to technical and business audiences (training, workshops, publications)
* 4 years’ experience as a Solution Architect or related role.


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
   

  

  

**Company** 
 \- AWS India \- Maharashtra

 **Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience in consulting, IT services, or a related field.
* Experience leading cloud migrations, digital implementations, or managed services operations for organizations.
* Experience with IT infrastructure or cloud\-native applications development.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Advanced degree in a Management, Technical, or Engineering field.
* 15 years of experience in customer\-facing roles.
* Experience leading enterprise organizations through a people, process, and technology transformation from building and operating legacy, on\-premises software to running as a digital\-native business in the public cloud.
* Experience helping customers decide whether to make investments in new technologies and projects based on expected value and Return On Investment (ROI).
* Experience with data center migration strategies, and collaborating with channel partners and systems integrators.
* Knowledge of the Google Cloud ecosystem.


**About the job** 
 As a Consulting Account Lead, you will act as a trusted advisor to Google Cloud’s customers by enabling them to use Google Cloud products to achieve their business goals. You will partner with customers to develop cloud success plans such as organizational, programmatic, and technical strategies to meet their business and stakeholder goals. You will work with customers to remove organizational and technical barriers and identify opportunities to help customers expand their use of Google Cloud products. You will recommend best practices related to their industry and organizational changes to accelerate their onboarding and migration plans. You will lead the adoption of Google Cloud, guiding customers through the people, process, and technology facets of their cloud transformation journey. You will work across customer\-facing teams to ensure that a customer’s experience on Google Cloud exceeds their expectations. You will understand the customer’s industry and business goals and regularly engage with executive stakeholders across a cross\-functional and geographically dispersed team to ensure Google is helping them achieve their goals. You will travel to the customer site up to 50% of the time as needed.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Drive the adoption and onboarding of Google Cloud at organizations to help customers realize the business value of the partnership and offerings.
* Create value for customers by partnering to define success and building a joint plan with identified objectives, stakeholders, milestones, risks, and metrics needed to achieve their goals.
* Form relationships with stakeholders (e.g., C\-level and IT team) to understand a customer’s business within their industry and develop roadmaps.
* Guide IT and business executives through the organizational changes needed to unlock the full value of the cloud, and help them staff, train, and align their people and partners to deliver on their cloud transformation.
* Partner with customer\-facing account teams and executives from across Google to develop technical plans that help customers achieve their business and cloud consumption goals.

The company is defined by its extensive product and service offerings, broad distribution capabilities, exceptional financial strength and local operations globally. Parent company Chubb Limited is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: CB) and is a component of the S\&P 500 index. Chubb employs approximately 40,000 people worldwide. Additional information can be found at: http://www.chubb.com/
 



**About Chubb India** 




 At Chubb India, we are on an exciting journey of digital transformation driven by a commitment to engineering excellence and analytics. With a team of over 2500 talented professionals, we foster a startup mindset that promotes collaboration, diverse perspectives, and a solution driven attitude. We are dedicated to building expertise in engineering, analytics, and automation, empowering our teams to excel in a dynamic digital landscape. We offer an environment where you will be part of an organization that is dedicated to solving real\-world challenges in the insurance industry. Together, we will work to shape the future through innovation and continuous learning.
 



  





**Position Details** 




**Job Title: Sr Delivery / Program Manager \- AI SDLC** 




**Function/Department: Technology** 




**Employment Type: Full\-time** 




**Location: Hyderabad/Bangalore** 




  





**Key Responsibilities:**




 We are not looking for someone who tracks RAG status on a spreadsheet. We need a Delivery Manager who operates in AI\-native programs — where plans change because models behave unexpectedly, where the definition of done includes evaluation metrics, and where team velocity is augmented by AI tools. You bring structured thinking, strong stakeholder management, and a genuine ability to lead complex, multi\-workstream programs. You have run programs that shipped AI\-enabled outcomes, and you know how that changes every aspect of delivery.
 


* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of large, complex programs across multiple teams and stakeholders.
* Manage delivery for AI\-native programs: sprint rhythms, model evaluation cycles, data dependency tracking, and model deployment gates are part of your delivery vocabulary.
* Use AI tools actively in your own delivery work: AI\-assisted planning, risk identification, status summarisation, and decision documentation.
* Drive alignment between program objectives, business priorities, and delivery outcomes across geographies.
* Identify, escalate, and resolve risks and blockers with speed and precision — no bureaucratic padding.
* Build delivery dashboards and reporting that give leadership genuine signal, not false comfort.
* Manage third\-party and partner delivery relations



**Qualifications:**



* Degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
* Indicative experience: 15\+ years in program/delivery management. Demonstrated AI program delivery experience carries more weight than years alone. PMP, PgMP, or equivalent is a plus, not a gate.



  





**Why Join Us?** 



* Be at the forefront of digital transformation in the insurance industry.
* Lead impactful initiatives that simplify claims processing and enhance customer satisfaction.
* Work alongside experienced professionals in a collaborative, innovation\-driven environment.



  





**Why Chubb?** 




 Join Chubb to be part of a leading global insurance company!
 



 Our constant focus on employee experience along with a start\-up\-like culture empowers you to achieve impactful results.

 Chubb is a world leader in the insurance industry, powered by underwriting and engineering excellence

 Embracing the spirit of a start\-up, our focus on speed and agility enables us to respond swiftly to market requirements, while a culture of ownership empowers employees to drive results that matter

 As we continue to grow, we are steadfast in our commitment to provide our employees with the best work experience, enabling them to advance their careers in a conducive environment



  





**Employee Benefits** 




 Our company offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our employees’ health, well\-being, and professional growth. Employees enjoy flexible work options, generous paid time off, and robust health coverage, including treatment for dental and vision related requirements. We invest in the future of our employees through continuous learning opportunities and career advancement programs, while fostering a supportive and inclusive work environment.
