1f8a04df.title: Principal Software Engineer (Java Full Stack with Cloud)
1f8a04df.description:
**Overview:**

At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer’s and partner’s needs and solve their challenges.


Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve.  



You’ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward\-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about—locally and globally.


Come make an impact every day at Zebra.


**What We're Looking For:**

As a Principal Software Engineer at Zebra, you will act as a key technical leader and full\-stack developer, shaping the future of our enterprise device and cloud solutions. Under consultative direction, you will be entrusted to determine and pursue courses of action essential to achieving our predetermined long\-range targets. This is a hands\-on, full\-stack software engineering leadership role, not a DevOps or IT infrastructure position. We are seeking a master\-level engineer who will personally research, architect, design, and write production\-grade code for our most complex and real\-time cloud solutions. You will also maintain the critical software for our products and systems, acting as a technical leader who builds and delivers enterprise\-grade platforms from the ground up. A key aspect of your work will involve performing complex system integration of software and hardware to ensure program consistency and maintain system throughput. Beyond coding, you will develop, validate, and test system structures and user documentation to ensure we deliver robust, high\-quality, and well\-documented solutions.
  

  

Candidates whose experience is primarily in DevOps, SRE, or cloud administration will not be considered for this position.
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**  

* Architects, designs, and oversees the development of cloud software solutions for highly complex technical projects, ensuring alignment with business and technical strategies and highly decoupled microservices optimized for distributed cloud environments.
* Creates detailed software specifications and leads the technology roadmap process, recommending project approaches and long\-term goals
* Champions innovation and cultivates creativity among team members, fostering an environment that attracts and retains top talent
* Leads and advises on all aspects of the software development lifecycle, prioritizing quality and continuous improvement
* Monitors competitor products and development strategies, ensuring the organization’s designs exceed industry standards
* Develops next\-generation technologies and solutions in collaboration with other engineering disciplines, anticipating and addressing client needs before the competition
* Protects intellectual property by analyzing competitor patents and contributing to related organizational initiatives
* Serves as a thought leader, representing the organization as a spokesperson on specialized projects and programs
* Establishes formal networks and coordinates efforts across teams and organizational units to achieve shared objectives
* Acts as a prime consultant and advisor for projects impacting the organization’s long\-term technical and business goals
* Provides strategic mentorship to senior engineers and management, fostering knowledge sharing and technical excellence
* Lead end\-to\-end development of high\-performance cloud solutions, ensuring maximum reliability and system uptime.
* Leverage Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services to design, deploy, and continuously optimize cloud\-native products.
* Build low\-latency, real\-time push notification and messaging systems for enterprise mobile devices and peripherals.
* Manage and tune highly scalable databases and storage layers (PostgreSQL, BigQuery, MongoDB, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage) to guarantee data integrity and performance.

  

**Job Requirements:**  

* Bachelors Degree or Advanced Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related engineering discipline
* 10\+ years of relevant full stack development experience with a Bachelors Degree or 7\+ years of experience with an Advanced Degree
* Expert hands\-on experience in architecture, design, full\-stack development, and coding is essential. **Experience limited to DevOps will not qualify for this position.**

  

**Key Skills and Competencies:**  

* Expertise in software architecture, system design, and scalable software solutions for enterprise\-level applications
* In\-depth knowledge of multiple programming languages, advanced software development methodologies, and adopting GenAI in the Software Development Lifecycle
* Proven ability to lead and influence cross\-functional teams and drive complex, high impact projects to completion
* Strong strategic thinking skills, with a focus on long\-term technical and business goals
* Exceptional innovation and creativity in solving complex challenges and developing novel solutions
* Demonstrated ability to mentor and develop technical talent, fostering a culture of learning and growth
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with experience engaging with senior leadership and external customers
* Familiarity with intellectual property protection, competitor analysis, and industry trends
* Proven hands\-on experience of 10\+ years as a Cloud Solutions Engineer with multiple enterprise\-grade solutions architected, designed, developed, and delivered.
* Proven hands\-on experience in architecting and developing highly scalable, multi\-tenanted, and real\-time solutions.
* Proven hands\-on experience with microservice architecture, design, and development.
* Proven hands\-on experience with containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes.
* Proven hands\-on experience with real\-time push notifications for mobile devices and peripherals.
* Extensive hands\-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, Cloud Functions, Kubernetes Engine, and others.
* Expertise in designing and managing highly scalable databases such as PostgreSQL, BigQuery, and MongoDB.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills, the ability to troubleshoot complex issues, and ability to work in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a global team environment.
* Strong programming skills in languages such as JavaScript and Java.
* Solid understanding of networking concepts, security best practices, and cloud architecture patterns.
* GCP Platform Deployment: Leverage Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services to design, deploy, and continuously optimize cloud\-native products.
* Real\-Time Systems: Build low\-latency, real\-time push notification and messaging systems for enterprise mobile devices and peripherals.
* Data \& Database Systems: Manage and tune highly scalable databases and storage layers (PostgreSQL, BigQuery, MongoDB, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage) to guarantee data integrity and performance.
* Data Analytics Integration: Seamlessly integrate analytics and telemetry pipelines into cloud platforms to extract actionable system insights.
* AI Integration in SDLC Adaptation: Drive the secure adoption of AI technologies (such as Claude and other LLMs) within the software development life cycle (SDL), ensuring code quality, security compliance, and prompt engineering best practices.
* Leadership \& Collaboration: Partner with cross\-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical specs, and mentor junior engineers to drive continuous improvement.
* Documentation \& Stakeholder Reporting: Maintain comprehensive architectural designs and proactively report on project milestones, risks, and systems health.

  

**Position Specific Information:**  

* Travel Requirements: Up to 15%
* Able to Telework?: Hybrid

  

**Physical Demands:**  

* Sedentary work that primarily involves sitting or standing

**Benefits:**

We understand the importance of work\-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well\-being day to promote revitalization and success.


**Job Posting Statement:**

To protect candidates from falling victim to online fraudulent activity involving fake job postings and employment offers, please be aware our recruiters will always connect with you via @zebra.com email accounts. Applications are only accepted through our applicant tracking system and only accept personal identifying information through that system. Our Talent Acquisition team will not ask for you to provide personal identifying information via e\-mail or outside of the system. If you are a victim of identity theft contact your local police department.


**AI Technology Statement:**

Zebra Technologies leverages AI technology to evaluate job applications using objective, job\-relevant criteria. This approach enhances efficiency and promotes fairness in the hiring process. However, every decision regarding interviews and hiring is made by our dedicated team, because we believe people make the best decisions about people. For more on how we use technology in hiring and how we process applicant data, see our Zebra Privacy Policy .

7499805f.title: Technical Account Manager - Strategic Account
7499805f.description:
**Technical Account Manager**

 **Responsibilities:**


* Drive pre\-sales initiatives to secure impactful deals by identifying opportunities, crafting compelling technology roadmaps, and supporting sales teams to achieve their business targets
* As an account technical solution leader engaging with specified key account(s) to generate, lead and execute upon consultative sales engagements with key technical and business leaders at the customer
* Influence specifications, secure approved vendor status, and establish Siemens solutions as the preferred choice with EPCs / OEMs / End users / Consultants
* Build trusted advisor status by communicating knowledgably with the customer around business challenges, industry trends, competitor landscapes and wider interfaces, through the delivery of thought leadership, and speaking with authority, articulating adoption of appropriate Integrated Automation \& Digitalization solution to deliver competitive advantages
* Engage at early stage of a Project, understand the nature of the opportunities and associated deliverables, accordingly, develop strategies to stitch \& pitch the portfolio elements like Instrumentation, Automation \& Drives, Digitalization \& AI along with overall system architecture
* Crafting, co\-creating \& convincing digital transformation roadmap for customers with value propositions and real use cases
* Build and maintain trusted relationships up to CxO\-level / key business stakeholders — as the account's strategic technical advisor
* Understand the complete scope of the project and position the possible portfolio elements by engaging with multiple stakeholders and stitch the data\-fabric across systems to provide unified view of the operations to EPC / End\-users / Consultant as a differentiator.
* Support to drive profitable sales growth and expand market share of SIEMENS across assigned key account(s)
* Build an integrated approach where technical expertise, business understanding, and commercial strategy reinforce each other. Because the most ambitious projects require the commitment of many stakeholders, the TAM plays an essential role in coordination, alignment, and transforming opportunities into concrete successes
* Fully understand the portfolio (Instrumentation, VFDs, Automation, Digitalization \& AI and Cybersecurity) and effectively use available opportunities to articulate Siemens’ value\-added propositions and create sustainable business growth
* Lead technical discussions, solution workshops, customer presentations, Demo and proof\-of\-concept discussions. Organize product training for customers.
* Building and expanding trusted relationships with respective Sales team, technical experts, Channel Partners, EPCs/OEMs, Consultants and End\-users
* Capability to prepare the technical proposal along with system architecture and convince the customer with most optimized BoM to actively negotiate in coordination with Sales Account Manager and key stakeholders
* Collaboration with channel partners to co\-create value propositions that accelerate deal cycles and expand wallet share
* Align with respective Sales team for the forecast \& opportunity pipeline for assigned key account(s); further to find opportunities to widen the portfolio footprint and actively support to close the opportunities \& achieve the assigned targets
* Collaborate with sales teams to qualify leads, conduct discovery workshops, and uncover customer pain points, process optimization, and achieve a healthy lead\-to\-opportunity conversion rate
* Analyzing markets, customer needs, technology trends and competing portfolios to identify strategic opportunities, value creation, support to do pilot project and scale

**Qualifications / Background:**

* Degree in Engineering (Electronics / Electrical / Instrumentation \& Control / Information Technology); A master's degree or specialization is advantageous
* 10\+ years of practical experience in Industrial Automation; Proven track records of 6\+ years of experience in Technical Sales / Pre\-sales, supported as Solution Consultant for Industrial Automation systems
* Having experience of crafting, co\-creating \& convincing the digital transformation roadmap to customers with value propositions and real use cases
* Expertise and deep understanding of Minerals, Material Handling and Metals industries; and experience of handling large EPCs/OEMs/Consultants/End\-users
* Strong technical knowledge about Instrumentation, VFDs, PLC, SCADA, DCS System and Industrial Communication
* Good understanding of IT/OT integration, Digitalization, IIoT, Industrial AI and Cybersecurity
* Commercial awareness with experience of developing suitable solution concepts, system architecture, technical proposals and value propositions in collaboration with relevant teams
* Strong analytical and systemic problem\-solving skills with a clear passion for addressing business needs \& add new dimensions to the strategy
* A winning combination of engineering experience and strong interpersonal skills: you communicate clearly, listen carefully, present convincingly, and influence stakeholders at every level up to C\-suite executives.
* The ability to collaborate across functions, manage several bids or opportunities simultaneously
* This role requires travelling to customer locations across India for meetings \& account development activities

 We partner with major global platforms such as Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Our B2B portfolio includes Precision, our specialist in travel fintech; Tripstack, our B2B Flights as a Service Provider and world leader in virtual interlining, serving as the gateway to Etraveli Group’s flight content and fulfillment services; Wenrix, the AI Infrastructure for profitable growth in air; and Flygresor.se, Sweden’s leading flight comparison site. We also operate our own online travel agency brands including Gotogate, Mytrip, and Flightnetwork.
   

  

 Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 3200 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do.
   

  

 Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay.
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 The System Solution Engineer is accountable for the strategic oversight, successful implementation and reliable maintenance of the core Customer Services technology stack, including systems like Genesys, Zendesk, Teramind, and associated Data \& Quality Management (QM) tools. This role acts as the primary subject matter expert, ensuring system stability, optimal performance, and continuous feature adoption. The purpose is to maximize agent efficiency, ensure compliance and align the capabilities of these platforms directly with operational objectives to deliver a seamless, high\-quality agent \& customer experience.
   

  

**Duties \& Responsibilities**
* System Ownership \& Strategy: Take full ownership of the technical health, lifecycle management, and multi\-year roadmap for the entire Customer Services IT systems portfolio (including Genesys Cloud, Zendesk, Teramind, and integrated 3rd party tools).
* Cross\-System Integration: Define and govern the strategic approach for integrating different platforms (telephony, CRM, WFM, QA) to ensure data flow, system compatibility, and a unified agent experience.
* Vendor \& Budget Management: Manage key technology vendor relationships and oversee system\-related budgets and capacity planning.Provide L3 subject matter expertise and guidance on how agents and supervisors can best utilize the appointed systems.
* Maintain an expert\-level understanding of new features and market trends across the CS technology landscape to drive continuous feature adoption.
* Assesses situations to make appropriate recommendations based on operational needs.
* Adheres to support processes and best practices.
* Prepares and/or reviews functional requirements documentation.
* System Configuration, Development \& Change Management: Design, develop, test, and deploy complex system configurations, integrations, and changes based on business requirements.
* Hands\-on Coding: Write and maintain ad\-hoc scripts, APIs, and microservices (e.g., using Python, Go, or JavaScript) to facilitate system integrations and custom functionality.
* Adapts to prestigeless work within a small team environment.
* Participate in operational meetings for technical guidance and solution proposals.


**Qualification /Personal Characteristics** 
**:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
* 5 or more years of IT experience supporting applications and infrastructure in a contact center or large\-scale enterprise environment.
* Proven experience as a solutions architect or lead engineer, with a strong portfolio of successfully delivered projects.
* Strong, demonstrable experience with Customer Service platforms (e.g., Genesys Cloud, Zendesk, Teramind, WFM systems).
* Expertise in designing systems on cloud platforms such as AWS or Google Cloud.
* Strong knowledge of microservices architecture, APIs and RESTful services.
* Programming knowledge (Python, Go, or JavaScript preferred) for ad\-hoc scripts and integrations.

* Strategic Communication \& Stakeholder Alignment: Excellent communication skills to articulate complex technical issues and translate system capabilities into business value for both technical and non\-technical stakeholders (e.g., leadership, operations teams).
* Analytical \& Problem Solving Mindset: Ability to think strategically, solve complex, cross\-functional technical problems, and demonstrate strong analytical skills with a hands\-on approach.
* Organizational \& Team Skills: Prestigeless team player with strong organizational, detailed orientation, and planning skills to manage multiple priorities effectively.
* Must be passionate about contributing to an organization focused on continuously improving consumer experiences.


**Benefits**
 What’s in it for You?

**Role description**  

The Presales Solution Architect for Digital Workplace Services will play a critical role in shaping technology and managed service solutions that enable modern, productive and user\-centric workplace environments.



The role will partner closely with sales, practice, delivery, engineering, commercial teams, technology partners and clients to understand business requirements, develop tailored solutions and articulate the value of Digital Workplace Services.



The solution scope may include Service Desk, Field Services, Modern Endpoint Management, Device Lifecycle Services, Microsoft 365 and Collaboration, Workplace AI and Automation.



The ideal candidate will be a Digital Workplace generalist with broad solutioning experience across multiple workplace service areas and deeper expertise in one or more domains.



The candidate should combine technical understanding, managed services solutioning, commercial awareness, strong documentation capability and confident client\-facing communication skills.


**Key Responsibilities:**



Solution Design and Architecture Lead the design of end\-to\-end Digital Workplace solutions spanning Service Desk, Field Services, VIP support, endpoint management, device lifecycle services, Microsoft 365, collaboration platforms, Digital Employee Experience, digital adoption and workplace automation.



Translate customer business, operational and technical requirements into scalable, supportable and cost\-effective solution architectures.



Design integrated operating models covering service scope, support tiers, delivery locations, coverage windows, staffing, governance, service levels and enabling technology platforms.



Coordinate inputs from domain specialists, delivery teams, technology vendors and service partners to create a cohesive end\-to\-end solution. Develop solution blueprints, architecture diagrams, service descriptions, service catalogues, operating models and transformation roadmaps. Define solution assumptions, dependencies, exclusions, risks, customer responsibilities and third\-party responsibilities.



Ensure proposed solutions are aligned with customer objectives, operational requirements and delivery capabilities.



Presales and Bid Support Work with sales and account teams to qualify opportunities and define appropriate Digital Workplace solution strategies.



Lead or contribute to RFP, RFI and proposal responses.



Conduct customer discovery workshops, requirements sessions, assessments and solution walkthroughs.



Develop high\-quality solution proposals, response documents, PowerPoint presentations, bid\-orals decks, executive narratives and supporting solution artefacts.



Build value propositions, business cases, ROI and TCO models, transformation benefits and competitive differentiators.



Lead or support bid\-orals presentations, solution walkthroughs and client solution\-defence sessions.



Respond to technical, operational and commercial challenges relating to the proposed solution.



Support customer due diligence, clarification sessions and commercial negotiations.



Create detailed effort estimates across transition, transformation, engineering, service management and business\-as\-usual operations.



Define service levels, KPIs, OLAs, XLAs, governance structures and reporting requirements.



Provide resource models, effort estimates, technology requirements and commercial inputs.



Work with pricing, finance, delivery and partner teams to validate solution cost, feasibility and competitiveness.



Support the development of pricing models, including resource\-based, transaction\-based, per\-user, per\-device and outcome\-based constructs where applicable.



Participate in internal solution reviews, risk reviews and commercial approval processes.



Ensure proposed commitments are measurable, deliverable and commercially viable.

Validate partner coverage, delivery capability, service hours, language support, logistics capability and regional constraints.



Obtain and validate partner effort, pricing, lead\-time and service\-level inputs.



Define scope boundaries, hand\-offs, escalation paths, service responsibilities and governance requirements for partner\-delivered services.



Integrate partner\-delivered field services into the overall Digital Workplace operating model and commercial solution.



Support partner selection, benchmarking and solution\-risk assessment where required.



Customer Engagement Present and articulate Digital Workplace capabilities, solution options and transformation roadmaps to senior and executive stakeholders.



Facilitate customer workshops and consultative discussions across business, technology and operational stakeholders.



Conduct demonstrations, proof\-of\-concept planning and solution walkthroughs where applicable. Serve as a trusted advisor on workplace technologies, managed service models, employee experience and workplace transformation.



Translate technical and operational concepts into clear business outcomes and measurable value.



Defend solution assumptions, design decisions, operating models, service levels, effort estimates and commercial constructs in front of customers.



Collaboration and Delivery Enablement Work closely with service delivery, engineering, transition, operations and practice teams to ensure solution feasibility and accuracy.



Engage product vendors, OEMs and service partners where third\-party capabilities form part of the solution.



Develop and review Statements of Work, service descriptions, responsibility matrices, assumptions, dependencies and contractual solution commitments.



Ensure alignment between the proposed solution, contractual scope, pricing model and delivery approach.



Practice and Capability Development Contribute to the development of reusable solution assets, reference architectures, estimators, service descriptions, accelerators and proposal content.



Share knowledge, market insights and solution lessons across sales, presales, practice and delivery teams.



Market and Technology Expertise Maintain awareness of developments across modern endpoint management, Microsoft 365, collaboration, workplace AI, automation, Digital Employee Experience and device lifecycle services.



Understand market trends, customer priorities, competitor offerings and evolving workplace operating models.



Ability to understand complex customer environments and translate requirements into coherent and workable solutions.



Ability to integrate inputs from multiple domain specialists and partners into a single end\-to\-end solution.



Strong customer\-facing presales, consulting and stakeholder\-management experience.



Comfortable working in fast\-paced, multi\-stakeholder and deadline\-driven deal environments.



Strong commercial awareness and understanding of how solution decisions affect cost, risk and delivery.



Ability to balance customer expectations, technical feasibility, operational practicality and commercial viability.



Experience 8–15 years of overall IT industry experience.



At least 5 years of experience in Digital Workplace presales, solution architecture, consulting or managed services solutioning.



Experience designing managed service operating models, support structures, resource models and coverage approaches.



Technical and Service Skills Strong understanding of enterprise endpoint architectures and modern device\-management platforms.

**Role Summary**


We are seeking an **Oracle** **Cloud Security Consultant / OCI Security Architect** to help organizations design, secure, and govern **Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)** environments while protecting critical business applications, data, and cloud\-native services. The role focuses on OCI security architecture, identity and access management, data protection, cloud governance, posture management, and secure cloud transformation initiatives.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Design and review secure OCI architectures, landing zones, and infrastructure security controls.


* Implement and govern OCI Identity and Access Management (IAM), policies, compartments, and least\-privilege access models.


* Assess and improve OCI security posture using cloud security best practices.


* Design and implement data protection controls, including encryption, key management, vault services, and secrets management.


* Support Zero Trust initiatives, network segmentation, and secure connectivity using OCI networking services.


* Conduct OCI security assessments, threat modeling, architecture reviews, and compliance evaluations.


* Enable secure DevSecOps practices and protect CI/CD pipelines deployed within OCI environments.


* Secure Oracle PaaS and SaaS integrations, including database, analytics, and application workloads.


* Support cloud migration and modernization programs by embedding security controls into OCI landing zones and migrated workloads.


* Develop cloud security dashboards, security monitoring use cases, and compliance reporting capabilities.


* Collaborate with infrastructure, application, database, and business teams to operationalize security controls and remediate identified risks.


* Support incident response, security investigations, and cloud threat detection activities within OCI environments.


**Required Skills**


* Hands\-on experience with **Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)** services and security capabilities.


* Strong understanding of OCI security architecture, governance, and operational best practices.


* Experience implementing OCI IAM, compartments, dynamic groups, federation, and privileged access controls.


* Knowledge of OCI **Cloud Guard**, **Security Zones**, **Vault**, and **Key Management Services (KMS)**.


* Experience securing OCI networking components, including VCNs, NSGs, security lists, load balancers, and hybrid connectivity.


* Understanding of encryption, key lifecycle management, and secrets management.


* Familiarity with CSPM, cloud governance, and cloud compliance frameworks.


* Knowledge of DevSecOps practices, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), and secure CI/CD pipelines.


* Experience with cloud monitoring, logging.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Basic understanding of AI and securing AI\-enabled cloud workloads.


* OCI certifications such as:

o Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Architect Professional


o Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Security Professional


* Industry certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CCSK, or CISM.


* Experience supporting large\-scale cloud migration, modernization, or Oracle workload transformation programs.


* Knowledge of compliance frameworks such as NIST, CIS Benchmarks, PCI\-DSS, HIPAA, ISO 27001, and SOC 2\.

**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Oracle Cloud Security**
**Role Summary**
 We are seeking an
 **Oracle** 
**Cloud Security Consultant / OCI Security Architect** 
 to help organizations design, secure, and govern
 **Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)**

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design and review secure OCI architectures, landing zones, and infrastructure security controls.
* Implement and govern OCI Identity and Access Management (IAM), policies, compartments, and least\-privilege access models.
* Assess and improve OCI security posture using cloud security best practices.
* Design and implement data protection controls, including encryption, key management, vault services, and secrets management.
* Support Zero Trust initiatives, network segmentation, and secure connectivity using OCI networking services.
* Conduct OCI security assessments, threat modeling, architecture reviews, and compliance evaluations.
* Enable secure DevSecOps practices and protect CI/CD pipelines deployed within OCI environments.
* Secure Oracle PaaS and SaaS integrations, including database, analytics, and application workloads.
* Support cloud migration and modernization programs by embedding security controls into OCI landing zones and migrated workloads.
* Develop cloud security dashboards, security monitoring use cases, and compliance reporting capabilities.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, application, database, and business teams to operationalize security controls and remediate identified risks.
* Support incident response, security investigations, and cloud threat detection activities within OCI environments.


**Required Skills**
* Hands\-on experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) services and security capabilities.
* Strong understanding of OCI security architecture, governance, and operational best practices.
* Experience implementing OCI IAM, compartments, dynamic groups, federation, and privileged access controls.
* Knowledge of OCI Cloud Guard, Security Zones, Vault, and Key Management Services (KMS).
* Experience securing OCI networking components, including VCNs, NSGs, security lists, load balancers, and hybrid connectivity.
* Understanding of encryption, key lifecycle management, and secrets management.
* Familiarity with CSPM, cloud governance, and cloud compliance frameworks.
* Knowledge of DevSecOps practices, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), and secure CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with cloud monitoring, logging.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Basic understanding of AI and securing AI\-enabled cloud workloads.
* OCI certifications such as:
* Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Architect Professional
* Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Security Professional
* Industry certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CCSK, or CISM.

 To manage change projects that help the organisation achieve its strategic objectives, while ensuring that projects are delivered on time, within budget, in control and in compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies and procedures.

* Development and management of project plans that outline the scope, objectives, timelines, and resource requirements for change projects.

8a8873e8.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, Trust CX Innovations
8a8873e8.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Trust depends on two things being true at once: that every piece of customer data is governed, controlled, and provably compliant, and that the organization can move fast enough to keep up as products evolve in the era of AI. TCI's AI Enablement \& Data Governance charter owns both. On the data side, we make sure data is classified, its handling is enforceable, and compliance can be proven rather than asserted. On the enablement side, we use AI\-driven automation to take operational load off the entire organization so builders spend their time building trust, not maintaining it by hand.  

  

We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to drive the programs across this charter. You will own complex, cross\-functional initiatives that span product, engineering, and science teams, and often multiple organizations, from data governance and enforcement programs to the automation efforts that reduce operational burden at scale. Operating with significant autonomy, you will set the plan, map dependencies across teams, surface risks early, and keep a broad set of stakeholders aligned on a shared bar and timeline, including partners in privacy, legal, and other organizations we depend on. You will operate at a technical level, understanding the systems and trade\-offs well enough to ask the right questions and drive sound decisions, and you will bring the judgment and influence to hold teams that do not report to you accountable to their commitments. Above all, you will be the connective tissue that turns provable data governance and AI\-driven efficiency from goals into delivered outcomes.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Own and drive complex, cross\-functional programs across both data governance and AI enablement, spanning multiple engineering, product, and science teams and often multiple organizations.
* Build the program plan from ambiguity: define scope, milestones, and success criteria, and translate a broad charter into an executable roadmap with clear owners.
* Map and manage cross\-team and cross\-org dependencies, including partners in privacy and legal, surface risks early, and drive them to resolution before they affect delivery.
* Drive data governance programs so that data classification, handling enforcement, and retention obligations are met and provable, and make those requirements a prerequisite for new services rather than an afterthought.
* Drive the AI enablement and automation agenda that reduces operational burden across the organization, and track its impact on capacity and delivery.
* Establish the bar for what "done" and "compliant" mean in this space and embed it into how programs are planned and run.
* Keep a diverse set of stakeholders aligned, from individual builders to senior leaders, through clear written narratives, status, and decision documents.
* Operate at a technical level: understand the systems and trade\-offs well enough to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions, and drive sound decisions.
* Define and track the metrics that show whether governance is provable and whether automation is actually returning capacity, and use them to prioritize.
* Influence and hold teams that do not report to you accountable to shared commitments and timelines.

  

About the team  

The Trust CX Innovation team drives advancements across Amazon Devices \& Services (D\&S) products. Our mission focuses on maintaining trust as the foundation while ensuring universal access as AI technology evolves. Our team develops essential privacy safeguards and accessibility features that serve millions of customers globally.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 8\+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 7\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5\+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi\-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership


\- \- Understanding of AI architecture and integration patterns  

\- \- Expertise in privacy regulations and accessibility standards  

\- \- Ability to drive technical decisions across teams  

\- \- Advanced program management capabilities  

\- \- Experience defining technical metrics  

\- \- Track record of process optimization  

\- \- Experience with rapid technology adoption  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

53185ce6.title: Senior Program Manager, RBS : Cost to Serve
53185ce6.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon strives to be Earth's most customer\-centric company, where customers can find and discover anything they want to buy online. Retail Business Services (RBS) accelerates Amazon's growth by improving customer and Selling Partner (SP) experiences, while optimizing costs across Stores WW. RBS operates at the intersection of retail, operations, technology, and finance, ensuring Amazon's systems and processes scale reliably while maintaining a high\-quality customer and selling\-partner experience.  

  

Cost to Serve (CtS) is a specialized organization within RBS focused on improving Amazon's per\-unit economics across the global supply chain. CtS operates on two pillars: defect identification and defect elimination, and partners with WW Operations, Finance, Returns, Concessions, and abuse\-related programs to uncover true cost drivers and remove them systematically. The team builds mechanisms that improve cost predictability, strengthen upstream defect visibility, and enable consistent governance across high\-impact cost categories, contributing directly to improved Free Cash Flow and scalable business growth.  

  

Are you passionate about building AI\-powered cost intelligence solutions at scale? Amazon's RBS CtS organization is looking for an experienced Senior Program Manager to lead our charter for identification of emerging cost trends, which serves as the first step in the journey of Defect Identification and contributes to the organization’s defect elimination work. This role serves as the primary business POC, engaging with RBS, Retail category, FBA and Finance teams in managing two projects (i) Project Strata, a layered analytical product built on a "peel the layers" philosophy that gives RBS and Stores leadership a unified, one\-stop view of how Cost to Serve is trending — decomposing headline P\&L costs into granular operational drivers and identifying cost opportunities through benchmarking between different time periods, MPs, channels and business lines. (ii) Defining and setting up P0 output and input metrics for RBS's UDE program. This role also serves as the primary POC to our tech partners in building and scaling above two projects and guides a team of Business Analysts who co\-develop and validate the MLP and scaled product's outputs.  

  

This leader will define requirements, own the working backward plan and oversee the daily mechanisms that connect business expertise to technical development. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable managing technical product delivery and presenting program health to Director\-level leadership, with the judgment to navigate ambiguity in a fast\-moving, high\-visibility space.  

  

Why You’ll Love This Role  

  

* High Impact at Scale: You'll lead identification of emerging cost trends and drive investment by the Org in right cost areas.
* Build with Tech: Serve as the key business voice shaping an AI\-powered platform from the ground up, defining what good looks like and ensuring the tool meets the bar for downstream adoption.
* Leadership Visibility: Own updates to senior leaders on key organizational priorities, with direct influence on how the organization invests in automation long\-term.

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Business/Tech Partnership \& Requirements Definition: Serve as the primary business counterpart to the analytics and tech teams.
* Working Backward Planning: Own the milestone delivery plan for above two projects. Identify risks early, adjust plans proactively, and maintain credible path\-to\-green narratives for leadership.
* BA Team Oversight: Manage the Business Analysts who develop MLP of the products. Iteratively capture feedbacks from Stores leaders and ensure the feedback mechanism runs smoothly, quality standards are maintained, and BAs are effectively translating domain expertise into product development.
* Quality \& Trade\-off Decisions: Hold a high bar on output quality. When design or quality blockers arise, make trade\-off decisions that balance speed, accuracy, and adoption — escalating to senior leaders for significant calls.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* 5\+ years of managing stakeholders in cross\-functional project experience
* Experience working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
* Bachelor's degree

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 2\+ years of leading large complex programs experience

 It’s no secret that Amazon relies on its technology to deliver millions of packages every day to its customers – on time, with low cost. We build the complex software solutions that work across our vendors, warehouses and carriers to optimize both the time and cost of getting packages delivered. Our products and services already handle thousands of requests per second, make business decisions impacting billions of dollars a year, integrate with a network of small and large carriers worldwide, manage business rules for millions of unique products, and improve the ordering and delivery experience for millions of online shoppers.
   

  

 We are looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager (TPM) to join our growing team! This position requires influencing across multiple teams, businesses, and senior leaders. You have a track record of exceptional performance and love working in a dynamic, ambiguous, fast\-paced environment in which managing multiple projects and priorities is the norm. You dive deep and like the complexity of systems but drive simple, innovative solutions for customer\-facing experiences. You have excellent judgment and high standards. You are an articulate, persuasive communicator and a good writer.

* Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems

3c01d699.description:
**Job Description**
 This role will lead complex technical programs, establishes scope and milestones, improves cross\-team processes, automates reporting, and acts as a technical liaison across stakeholder teams.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Primary Responsibilities**
**Program Ownership**
* Lead one or more major GPU Cluster Health domains such as strategic customer availability, partner repair execution, RMA/spares governance, data/reporting framework, repair workflow improvement, or engineering platform tooling.
* Translate availability gaps into structured programs with scope, owners, milestones, KPIs, risks, dependencies, and executive\-ready status.
* Drive weekly operating rhythm for assigned domains, including KPI review, blockers, escalations, decisions, and follow\-through.


**Customer and Horizontal Leadership**
* Support the vertical/horizontal TPM model by owning either a customer vertical or a horizontal functional area.
* For vertical ownership, lead availability and repair strategy for assigned strategic customers and customer clusters.
* For horizontal ownership, lead cross\-cutting programs such as NVIDIA/AMD partner tracking, SDE/SRE tooling, RMA/spares feedback loop, SOP tracking, or metrics/reporting framework.


**KPI Definition and Governance**
* Define KPI measurement methods for repair health, including cluster availability, unavailable\-host backlog, repair cycle time, repair success rate, reopen rate, spare availability, RMA loop performance, partner responsiveness, and SLA/SLO adherence.
* Drive consistent reporting standards across TPMs and support teams.
* Identify trends across multiple workstreams and convert them into prioritized corrective actions.


**Cross\-Functional Execution**
* Partner with India, Morocco, and Mexico SDE/SRE teams to identify tooling and first\-level support needs.
* Prioritize tooling requirements that reduce manual repair coordination, improve triage, automate reporting, or accelerate repair handoffs.
* Work with GSL, CHS, CPV, TRS, Warminator , and data center operations to remove repair blockers.
* Support incident\-style escalation for clusters at availability risk.


**Continuous Improvement**
* Lead post\-program retrospectives and drive process updates.
* Standardize repeatable playbooks, intake processes, escalation paths, and repair governance artifacts.
* Identify automation opportunities and advocate for prioritization.


**Expected Outcomes**
* Major repair programs have clear objectives, metrics, owners, and measurable improvement .
* Leadership has reliable visibility into customer cluster health and repair risk.
* Repair blockers are resolved through structured governance instead of ad hoc escalation.
* Tooling and reporting requirements are translated into actionable SDE/SRE work.


**About Us**
 Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life\-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.

c5f99d2b.title: Engagement Manager, Professional Services, AWSI, Healthcare and Life Sciences
c5f99d2b.description:
**Description**
 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector
   

  

 The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Engagement Manager to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you will lead delivery quality and velocity for programs spanning several concurrent workstreams, orchestrating 50\+ person teams of AWS builders, partners, and customers to deliver transformational AI, data, and enterprise modernization outcomes for the world's leading HCLS organizations.
   

  

 Your objective will be to deliver distinctive customer business outcomes and experience. In doing so, you will lead the implementation of AWS delivery innovations with customers, including re\-designing software development processes to become AI\-native end\-to\-end (“AI\-DLC”). You will bring exceptional stakeholder orchestration and relationship\-building skills, intrinsic problem\-solving ability to proactively shape program direction, anticipate and mitigate risks, and actively manage interdependencies, and the backbone to influence customers and partners when program success demands it. This is an opportunity to shape the future of the industry directly through hands\-on transformation leadership.
   

  

 The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Build and nurture trusted executive relationships (VP\+), delivering strategic counsel on program direction, health, risks, and trade\-offs to inform executive decisions
* Proactively manage interdependencies, mitigate risks, and drive accountability for program outcomes in ambiguous, fast\-changing environments
* Orchestrate across customer lines of business, IT, and partner teams simultaneously, aligning these stakeholders on priorities, timelines, and definitions of success, and escalating blockers where necessary for resolution
* Define and track measurable customer business outcomes (e.g., time\-to\-market acceleration) as the north star for program success, translating technical delivery progress into executive\-ready value narratives that demonstrate ROI and inform strategic decisions
* Own the program financial health, including forecasting, revenue recognition, commercial management, change request negotiation, and scope management for fixed\-price, milestone\-based delivery constructs
* Influence human builder and agent builder teams effectively, establishing clear operating models and responsible AI guardrails as delivery increasingly incorporates AI\-augmented development workflows and agentic automation
* Drive adoption of AI\-DLC (AI\-Driven Development Life Cycle) methodologies across delivery programs, adapting delivery models and team structures for accelerated scale and pace, establishing outcomes\-based governance frameworks for AI\-native builds, and steering multi\-agent systems at scale to drive delivery productivity across the program
* Establish and enforce governance frameworks for agentic AI in delivery — including observability, cost controls, human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, and compliance guardrails — ensuring AI\-augmented workflows remain auditable, secure, and aligned with customer regulatory requirements
* Proactively surface ideas on how ProServe and other AWS teams can innovate to help our customers achieve their goals at a faster pace and larger scale


**About The Team**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* 2\+ years of solving problems with technology in the Healthcare/Life Sciences Industry experience
* Experience delivering results for large, cross\-functional initiatives/projects, or experience in solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits)
* 5\+ years of experience in technology transformation program management, with experience leading complex, multi\-workstream delivery programs ($5M\+/year in professional services revenue) end\-to\-end, including governance, program delivery quality and velocity, and financial health
* Experience in adopting and championing emerging delivery methodologies and tooling that accelerate team productivity, including experience adapting governance frameworks for new technology\-driven delivery models


**Preferred Qualifications**
* cloud certification like AWS Cloud Practitioner or AWS Solutions Architect \- Associate
* Experience creating and implementing large\-scale programs
* MBA, or 3\+ years of working with Data \& AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage experience
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
* Experience in advising and influencing executive leadership
* Experience building trusted relationships with senior customer executives (VP\+) to influence strategic and operational decisions and managing escalation paths across complex stakeholder landscapes
* Experience in software development and proficiency in AI\-DLC or equivalent AI\-accelerated development methodologies at the governance and program leadership level, including experience adapting estimation, milestone tracking, and quality assurance frameworks for AI\-native delivery models

 Technology Delivery Lead

 Manages the delivery of large, complex technology projects using appropriate frameworks and collaborating with sponsors to manage scope and risk.  As a Technology Delivery Lead, a typical day involves overseeing the execution of extensive and multifaceted technology initiatives, ensuring alignment with project goals and stakeholder expectations. The individual leads efforts to maintain high standards of service quality while controlling costs to drive project profitability. f174fa97.title: Technical Delivery Manager
f174fa97.description:
Join us as Technical Delivery Manager at Barclays where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting\-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable, and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.
   

  

**To be successful as a Technical Delivery Manager, you should have experience with:**
* Experience in managing large multi\-year complex projects involving global teams, through the full project lifecycle from inception to implementation.
* Collaborating with an experienced team of SMEs, Operations, Dev managers, and other Global Business stakeholders to understand the requirements and project deliverables.
* Managing Risks, Assumptions, Issues and Dependencies closely, across all aspects of the project.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, together with well\-developed collaborative mindset.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* Formal credentials in PMP/SAFE.
* Estimation skills for tasks, including design, development, technical debt, and testing.
* Exposure to Agile / SAFe methodologies.
* Understanding of any Merchant Payments.


 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 The role is based out of Pune, India.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To manage change projects that help the organisation achieve its strategic objectives, while ensuring that projects are delivered on time, within budget, in control and in compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies and procedures.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Management of change projects within the organisation, ensuring that they are delivered on time, within scope, budget, and to the required quality standards.
* Development and management of project plans that outline the scope, objectives, timelines, and resource requirements for change projects.
* Communication with stakeholders, including senior management, project teams, and external partners, to ensure that they are informed about project progress and that their needs and expectations are being met.
* Management of project teams, ensuring that they are properly resourced and that they have the necessary skills and expertise to deliver on project objectives.
* Management of project budgets, ensuring that projects are delivered within the agreed budget.
* Creation of reports on project progress to ensure that proposed solutions are delivered on time and within budget.
* Management of project risks, ensuring that risk, assumptions, issues and dependencies are identified, assessed, and mitigated as necessary.
* Facilitation of change management activities, including training and communication, to ensure that change projects are successfully implemented and embedded in the organisation.


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

fc2e5ae5.title: Pre Sales Associate
fc2e5ae5.description:
**About Meragi**
 Meragi is a rapidly growing start\-up in India's thriving $50 billion wedding industry. As a full\-stack technology platform, we revolutionize the way wedding\-related services are bought and delivered. Our mission is to create pioneering industry\-first solutions that address the complexities of this industry, utilizing innovative technology to consult, design, and sell wedding services with a strong focus on ensuring high\-quality fulfillment.
   

  

 Backed by top\-tier investors, we are at the forefront of transforming the wedding industry landscape. To drive our growth and success, we are seeking dynamic and growth\-oriented individuals to design dream weddings for our customers.
   

  

 This is an incredible opportunity to join a fast\-paced, innovative company and make a significant impact in shaping the future of the wedding industry.
   

  

**Job Description**
 As a Pre Sales Associate, you will play a vital role in the sales process by working closely with the sales team and potential clients to understand their needs and present suitable solutions. You will be responsible for providing product and service information, preparing presentations, and building strong relationships with prospects to enhance the company's sales efforts.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Client Engagement: Act as a primary point of contact for potential clients, responding to their inquiries and providing detailed information about the company's products or services.
* Product Knowledge: Stay up\-to\-date with the company's product or service offerings, understanding their unique selling points, features, and benefits to effectively communicate with clients.
* Relationship Building: Build and maintain strong relationships with prospects to foster trust and credibility throughout the sales process.
* Competitive Analysis: Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify the strengths and weaknesses of competitors, enabling the development of effective selling strategies.
* Sales Support: Collaborate with the sales team, providing support in the negotiation process and addressing any client concerns or objections.
* CRM Management: Ensure all client interactions, leads, and opportunities are accurately documented and updated in the Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system.


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field.
* Proficient in English, Kannada, Hindi \& or Telugu language
* Proven experience in a pre\-sales or sales support role, preferably in the technology or software industry.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Excellent presentation and negotiation abilities.
* Proficient in using CRM software and sales tools.
* Strong organizational and time management skills to handle multiple prospects and tasks simultaneously.


 As a Pre Sales Associate, you will contribute significantly to the success of the sales team by providing valuable insights and solutions to potential clients, ultimately driving business growth and customer satisfaction.

5cfa088c.title: Technology Architect
5cfa088c.description:
**Project Role :** Technology Architect  

**Project Role Description :** Design and deliver technology architecture for a platform, product, or engagement. Define solutions to meet performance, capability, and scalability needs.
  

**Must have skills :** Manufacturing Operations  

**Good to have skills :** NA  

Minimum **18** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Summary  

We are looking for an Automotive Industry SME – Senior Manager with 18\+ years of experience and strong expertise in automotive engineering, manufacturing, operations, supply chain, connected vehicles, and digital transformation. The role involves industry advisory, solution shaping, and transformation leadership across Digital Manufacturing, Digital Twin, Physical AI, Industrial AI, simulation, IT/OT integration, and Software\-Defined Vehicles. The candidate should have proven experience with Automotive OEMs and Tier\-1 suppliers, along with expertise in transformation roadmaps, executive workshops, PoCs, RFP/RFI responses, solution proposals, and business development.  

  

Roles and Responsibilities  

Serve as the Automotive Industry SME and trusted advisor for global Automotive OEMs, Tier\-1 suppliers, mobility companies, and manufacturing partners.  

Provide domain leadership across vehicle engineering, product development, manufacturing, operations, quality, supply chain, logistics, service, and aftermarket.  

Shape transformation strategies across Smart Manufacturing, Digital Manufacturing, Digital Twin, Physical AI, Industrial AI, connected operations, and Software\-Defined Vehicles.  

Lead executive workshops, discovery sessions, capability assessments, and transformation roadmap development.  

Translate business and manufacturing challenges into industry solutions, reference architectures, implementation roadmaps, and measurable outcomes.  

Provide expertise across automotive manufacturing processes including press, body, paint, powertrain, battery, assembly, inspection, testing, warehousing, and intralogistics.  

Guide EV and battery manufacturing initiatives covering cell, module, pack, e\-powertrain, traceability, quality, equipment integration, and production ramp\-up.  

Shape Digital Twin and simulation use cases for factory design, virtual commissioning, production optimization, capacity planning, line balancing, and material flow.  

Define Physical AI and intelligent automation opportunities using robotics, AMRs/AGVs, machine vision, edge AI, synthetic data, and simulation.  

Guide integration across PLM, MES/MOM, ERP, WMS, QMS, EAM, IoT, industrial controls, data platforms, and Digital Twin environments.  

Govern automotive transformation programs across solutioning, design, delivery, deployment, adoption, and value realization.  

Assess process, technology, data, and organizational maturity and identify gaps, risks, dependencies, and improvement opportunities.  

Develop industry offerings, solution assets, accelerators, reference models, and demonstrations for automotive engineering and manufacturing.  

Lead RFP/RFI responses, proposals, solution qualification, effort estimation, delivery planning, partner alignment, and commercial shaping.  

Collaborate with architects, manufacturing engineers, AI/data teams, simulation specialists, cybersecurity experts, and technology partners to deliver integrated solutions.  

Engage senior stakeholders on industry insights, transformation priorities, investment decisions, risks, and business value.  

Lead and mentor consultants, architects, engineering leads, and multidisciplinary global delivery teams.  

Drive thought leadership, client innovation, ecosystem collaboration, account growth, and opportunity origination.  

Translate transformation initiatives into measurable outcomes such as faster launches, higher throughput, improved quality, reduced downtime and cost, optimized inventory, improved asset utilization, and sustainability.  

  

Professional and Technical Skills  

Deep Automotive expertise across OEM/Tier\-1 value chains, product engineering, manufacturing, operations, supply chain, service, and aftermarket.  

Strong knowledge of vehicle development, industrialization, launch management, production ramp\-up, and lifecycle management.  

Strong understanding of automotive manufacturing processes, including stamping, BIW, paint, powertrain, battery, assembly, quality, and end\-of\-line testing.  

Strong knowledge of EV, battery, e\-powertrain, connected vehicles, autonomous systems, mobility, and Software\-Defined Vehicles.  

Expertise in Digital Manufacturing, Smart Manufacturing, Industry 4\.0, Digital Twin, Physical AI, Industrial AI, simulation, and intelligent automation.  

Experience with MES/MOM, PLM, ERP, WMS, QMS, EAM, IoT, industrial data, and IT/OT integration.  

Understanding of robotics, PLC/SCADA, industrial networks, edge computing, machine vision, AMRs/AGVs, and warehouse automation.  

Experience with platforms such as Siemens, Dassault Syst mes, PTC, SAP, NVIDIA, Rockwell Automation, or equivalent ecosystems.  

Knowledge of Digital Twin and simulation platforms such as NVIDIA Omniverse, Tecnomatix, DELMIA, AnyLogic, FlexSim, or Simio.  

Strong understanding of manufacturing KPIs, Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Theory of Constraints, and process optimization.  

Working knowledge of automotive quality, functional safety, cybersecurity, sustainability, traceability, and regulatory requirements.  

Strong capabilities in industry strategy, transformation planning, solution architecture, value\-case development, and program governance.  

Excellent executive communication, stakeholder management, workshop facilitation, presentation, and negotiation skills.  

Proven ability to lead global multidisciplinary teams across business, engineering, manufacturing, technology, and delivery functions.  

Experience in PoCs, feasibility studies, maturity assessments, business cases, RFP/RFI responses, solution proposals, and commercial discussions.  

Ability to translate automotive expertise into scalable solutions and measurable business outcomes.  

  

Additional Information:  

Experience: 18\+ years of overall experience with significant leadership experience in Automotive, Manufacturing, Engineering, Operations, Consulting, or Digital Transformation minimum 15 years of full\-time education required.  

Industry Exposure: Demonstrated experience working with Automotive OEMs, Tier\-1 suppliers, mobility providers, engineering organizations, or manufacturing ecosystem partners.  

Location: Bengaluru, India.
