5217d296.title: Cloud Platform Engineering - Azure Security, AVP
5217d296.description:
Charles River Development is seeking an experienced Assistant Vice President (AVP), Cloud Platform Engineering to lead strategic cloud security, identity and governance initiatives across enterprise\-scale Azure environments. This role combines deep technical leadership with people management responsibilities, driving cloud modernization, security transformation, governance automation, and platform engineering excellence.


The AVP will be responsible for defining and executing cloud security and identity strategies, managing high\-performing engineering teams, influencing enterprise architecture decisions, and partnering closely with senior technology and business leaders. The role requires strong expertise in Microsoft Entra ID, Azure Security, Azure Policy, Azure IAM, Azure AD B2C/External Identity, cloud governance, IAC, automation, and AI\-enabled engineering solutions.


This lead will oversee the full employee lifecycle, including hiring, onboarding, mentoring, performance management, career development, succession planning, and talent retention while ensuring delivery of secure, scalable, and compliant cloud platform services.

  

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Azure Cloud Security**

* Define and execute enterprise identity and access management strategies leveraging Microsoft Entra ID
* Lead design and implementation of Azure Identity Governance, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), Conditional Access, Identity Protection, Access Reviews, and Zero Trust security controls
* Drive enterprise adoption of Azure IAM best practices, RBAC models, least\-privilege access, federated identity solutions, and authentication services basis business decisions
* Lead architecture and governance of Azure AD B2C / External Identity solutions for client\-facing and partner\-facing applications
* Partner with security, risk, compliance, and audit teams to ensure adherence to regulatory and security requirements
  

  

**Azure Governance \& Platform Engineering**

* Define enterprise cloud governance frameworks using Azure Policy, Management Groups, Landing Zones, and subscription governance models
* Lead implementation of Policy\-as\-Code, Governance\-as\-Code, and Security\-as\-Code capabilities using modern engineering practices
* Establish automated compliance validation, remediation, and continuous governance processes across Azure environments
* Collaborate with architecture, security, application, and infrastructure teams to define cloud standards and guardrails
* Drive platform engineering initiatives focused on self\-service capabilities, standardization, scalability, and operational excellence
  

  

**Automation \& AI Enablement**

* Champion automation\-first engineering practices using Terraform, PowerShell, Python, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, and other cloud\-native tooling
* Identify and implement AI\-driven solutions to improve engineering productivity, governance automation, operational efficiency, compliance monitoring, and developer experience
* Lead adoption of intelligent operational workflows leveraging Generative AI, Copilot technologies, and engineering automation frameworks
  

  

**Stakeholder \& Client Engagement**

* Collaborate with internal technology teams, enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, operations, product management, and executive leadership.
* Partner with external clients, vendors, and strategic partners to understand requirements and deliver secure cloud solutions.
* Influence and negotiate across multiple stakeholder groups to drive alignment on priorities, standards, and platform roadmaps.
* Act as a trusted advisor to senior leaders on cloud strategy, identity modernization, security posture, and governance transformation.
  

**Leadership \& People Management**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of cloud platform, security, and identity engineers.
* Manage the end\-to\-end employee lifecycle including workforce planning, hiring, onboarding, performance management, compensation discussions, talent development, succession planning, promotions, and retention strategies.
* Conduct year\-end performance reviews, goal setting, career development planning, and ongoing performance coaching.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Effectively manage employee relations, conflict resolution, difficult conversations, and stakeholder escalations.
* Provide executive\-level reporting and updates to senior technology leadership, engineering leadership, and business stakeholders.
* Build and maintain a high\-performing engineering organization aligned with business priorities and strategic objectives.
  

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related discipline.
* 15\-20 years of extensive experience in cloud security, identity management
* 5\+ years of direct people management experience leading Cloud engineering teams
* Demonstrated experience managing year\-end reviews, performance management processes, career development, employee mentoring, and conflict resolution.
* Deep expertise in Microsoft Entra ID, including:
	+ Conditional Access
	+ Identity Protection
	+ Privileged Identity Management (PIM)
	+ Access Reviews
	+ Identity Governance
	+ Federation and SSO
* Strong experience with Azure IAM, RBAC, Privileged Access models, and Zero Trust architectures.
* Extensive experience with Azure Security services including:
	+ Microsoft Defender for Cloud
	+ Microsoft Sentinel
	+ Key Vault
	+ Security Center
	+ Azure Monitor
	+ Security Governance Frameworks
* Strong expertise implementing Azure Policy, Policy\-as\-Code, Governance\-as\-Code, and enterprise cloud controls.
* Experience reporting platform health, risk, compliance, security, and delivery metrics to executive leadership.
* Proven ability to manage complex stakeholder relationships across global organizations.
* Strong communication, presentation, influencing, and leadership skills.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience leading cloud transformation programs within large\-scale financial services or regulated enterprise environments.
* Strong understanding of Azure Landing Zones, enterprise networking, hybrid connectivity, and multi\-cloud operating models.
* Strong experience developing infrastructure automation using Terraform, Bicep, PowerShell, Python, and CI/CD platforms.
* Hands\-on expertise with Azure AD B2C / External Identities and customer identity management solutions.
* Experience building platform engineering organizations and self\-service cloud capabilities.
* Exposure to AI\-assisted engineering, Generative AI platforms, Microsoft Copilot, agentic AI frameworks, and automation\-based operational models.
* Knowledge of regulatory frameworks such as NIST, ISO 27001, CIS, SOC2, PCI\-DSS, and financial industry compliance standards.
  

  

**Microsoft certifications such as:**

* + Azure Solutions Architect Expert
	+ Azure Security Engineer Expert
	+ Microsoft Cybersecurity Architect Expert
	+ Azure Administrator Expert
	+ Identity and Access Administrator Associate

**What We Value**

* Strong people\-first leadership approach.
* Strategic thinking combined with hands\-on technical credibility.
* Executive presence and ability to communicate effectively with senior leadership.
* Passion for mentoring and developing engineering talent.
* Strong conflict resolution and stakeholder management skills.
* Automation\-first and AI\-first engineering mindset.
* Ability to balance business priorities, risk management, security, and engineering velocity.
  

  

**About State Street**

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

  

  

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work\-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

Summary: We are looking for an IT/OT – Industrial AI – Connectivity Solution Architect / Senior Manager with 15\+ years of experience and strong expertise in IT/OT convergence, industrial connectivity, data platforms, edge computing, automation, cybersecurity, and AI\-enabled operations. The candidate will lead solution architecture, technical delivery, and client engagement for Smart Manufacturing, Connected Factory, Industrial AI, and Digital Twin programs across Automotive, Aerospace, CPG, Life Sciences, Resources, and Manufacturing. Lead architecture and delivery of secure, scalable IT/OT, Industrial AI, plant connectivity, and Smart Manufacturing solutions.  

Define reference architectures connecting OT assets, PLCs, DCS, SCADA, historians, MES/MOM, edge, enterprise, and cloud platforms.  

Assess brownfield/greenfield environments and define current, target, transition, and deployment architectures.  

Translate manufacturing needs into connectivity, data, contextualization, integration, analytics, and AI solutions.  

Design industrial data pipelines for real\-time and historical production, quality, maintenance, energy, event, and time\-series data.  

Lead Industrial AI and Edge AI use cases including predictive maintenance, anomaly detection, quality/process optimization, computer vision, and energy management.  

Architect industrial connectivity using OPC UA, MQTT, Sparkplug B, Modbus TCP, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, REST APIs, and vendor interfaces.  

Integrate OT with MES/MOM, ERP, PLM, WMS, QMS, EAM/APM, IoT, data platforms, Digital Twin, and analytics.  

Establish standards for asset hierarchy, Unified Namespace, semantic models, contextualization, metadata, and data quality.  

Implement OT cybersecurity and resilient architectures covering segmentation, zones/conduits, identity, encryption, remote access, redundancy, and disaster recovery.  

Lead site assessments, PoCs, feasibility studies, workshops, design reviews, vendor evaluations, and demonstrations.  

Govern architecture, integration, testing, DevSecOps/MLOps, documentation, risks, dependencies, quality, and multi\-site delivery.  

Provide technical leadership across IT/OT, automation, data, AI, cloud, and cybersecurity teams, including client engagements, RFP/RFI, proposals, estimation, and partner coordination.  

Develop reusable frameworks, accelerators, reference architectures, and deployment patterns that deliver measurable improvements in downtime, quality, throughput, cost, energy efficiency, and scalability.

Strong hands\-on expertise in industrial IT/OT architecture, factory connectivity, manufacturing integration, edge computing, industrial data engineering, and Industrial AI is mandatory.  

Deep knowledge of OT systems including PLC, DCS, SCADA, HMI, historians, industrial gateways, machine controllers, sensors, drives, robots, and vision systems.  

Advanced knowledge of OPC UA, MQTT, Sparkplug B, Modbus TCP, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, REST, AMQP, Kafka, and industrial/vendor connectivity patterns.  

Strong understanding of Purdue/ISA\-95 architecture, industrial network segmentation, DMZ patterns, zones and conduits, and enterprise\-to\-plant integration.  

Experience designing high\-availability industrial networks and edge architectures with firewalls, switches, routing, VLANs, redundancy, time synchronization, and secure remote access.  

Strong understanding of IEC 62443, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, zero\-trust principles, asset inventory, identity and access management, certificate management, patching, and vulnerability management.  

Experience with industrial connectivity and data platforms from Siemens, Rockwell Automation, Schneider Electric, Honeywell, ABB, PTC, Microsoft, AWS, NVIDIA, or equivalent ecosystems.  

Experience with edge and IoT platforms, containerized workloads, Kubernetes, Docker, APIs, message brokers, streaming platforms, and hybrid\-cloud architectures.  

Strong experience integrating OT data with MES/MOM, ERP, PLM, WMS, QMS, EAM/APM, historians, data lakes, lakehouses, Digital Twin, and analytics platforms.  

Strong knowledge of industrial data modelling, asset hierarchies, Unified Namespace concepts, semantic models, contextualization, time\-series data, event processing, and data governance.  

Experience designing Industrial AI/ML solutions covering data preparation, feature engineering, training, deployment, inference, monitoring, retraining, and responsible AI controls.  

Experience with Python, SQL, REST APIs, scripting, data engineering, analytics, and integration automation is preferred.  

Understanding of AI/ML, deep learning, anomaly detection, predictive models, optimization, computer vision, GenAI, and retrieval\-oriented industrial knowledge solutions.  

Strong understanding of Digital Twin, Industry 4\.0, smart manufacturing, connected operations, virtual commissioning, and closed\-loop optimization concepts.  

Experience with observability and operations covering device health, connectivity status, data quality, pipeline monitoring, model performance, logging, alerting, and support processes.  

Knowledge of manufacturing operations, production systems, maintenance, quality, material flow, utilities, energy management, and industrial engineering.  

Strong solution architecture, system design, analytical, troubleshooting, problem\-solving, and technical decision\-making skills.  

Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile, DevSecOps, DataOps, MLOps, project delivery, technical governance, quality management, and change control.  

Excellent client\-facing communication, executive stakeholder management, workshop facilitation, presentation, and technical documentation skills.  

Proven experience leading global and distributed teams and coordinating industrial OEMs, automation vendors, network providers, cloud providers, and delivery partners.  

Strong experience in solution design, PoCs, feasibility studies, technical assessments, site surveys, RFP/RFI responses, effort estimation, and proposal development.  

Strong understanding of Automotive, Aerospace, CPG, Life Sciences, Resources, Utilities, or General Manufacturing domains.  

Ability to convert architecture and Industrial AI insights into actionable recommendations, scalable rollout patterns, and quantified business outcomes.  

Additional Information:  

Experience: 15\+ years of overall experience with significant expertise in industrial IT/OT, manufacturing connectivity, automation, industrial data, edge computing, cybersecurity, and Industrial AI.  

Location: Bengaluru, India.

Recognized on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest\-growing companies in the US, Peloton is one of the most respected and fastest\-growing global Oracle consulting firms, delivering Advisory, Consulting, and Managed Services to leading organizations across many industries, including Retail, Financial Services, Manufacturing, Consumer Packaged Goods, and more.
   

 Peloton Consulting Group has the vision and connected global capabilities to help organizations envision, implement, and realize the benefits of digital transformation. Our team has the best practices, knowledge, industry expertise, and know\-how. We make digital transformation a reality by leveraging AI, Enterprise Performance Management (EPM), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Supply Chain Management (SCM), Human Capital Management (HCM), Customer Experience (CX), Analytics, and Data Management for the cloud. Through connected capabilities, we bring people, processes, and technology together. We help organizations go further faster. That is the Peloton way!
   

 What truly sets us apart is our people. We are team players. We are energetic and entrepreneurial. We are problem solvers and innovative thinkers who believe the best outcomes are built together. We believe in quality, appreciate creativity, recognize individual contributions, and place trust in every member of our team. If you bring strong business or technical expertise and want to do meaningful work alongside people who are equally passionate about getting it right, we think you'll feel right at home here.
   

 This role requires a balance of client relationship management, operational oversight, and strategic thinking to ensure services are delivered efficiently and aligned with evolving client business needs.
   

  

 Key responsibilities
   

  

 This role requires candidates to work in IST hours from 5:30 PM to 2:30 AM and have a minimum of 6\+ years of relevant professional experience.
   

 While this is a remote opportunity open to candidates across India, applicants based in Hyderabad or Bangalore will be preferred, as these are our primary hiring locations.
   

  

 The consultant will work as part of the Application Managed Services (AMS) / Support team, providing ongoing functional and technical support for Oracle ARCS (Account Reconciliation Cloud Service) and related EPM Cloud applications. The role focuses on ensuring smooth reconciliation processes, resolving production issues, and supporting business users in financial close activities.
   

  

 \- Provide L2/L3 support for Oracle ARCS including Reconciliation Compliance and Transaction Matching modules
   

 \- Monitor and support month\-end and period\-end reconciliation processes to ensure timely completion
   

 \- Resolve issues related to reconciliations, matching rules, data loads, profiles, and automated business rules
   

 \- Troubleshoot and fix issues in ARCS configurations, security, reports, and workflow processes
   

 \- Support data integration activities between ERP/source systems and ARCS, including validation and reconciliation

Summary: We are looking for an IT/OT – Industrial AI – Connectivity Solution Architect Manager with 12\+ years of experience and strong expertise in IT/OT convergence, industrial connectivity, data platforms, edge computing, automation, cybersecurity, and AI\-enabled operations. Strong experience is required in secure industrial connectivity, protocols, data contextualization, streaming, edge/cloud integration, architecture governance, global team leadership, PoCs, RFP/RFI responses, technical workshops, and business development.  

Roles and Responsibilities:  

Lead architecture and delivery of secure, scalable IT/OT, Industrial AI, plant connectivity, and Smart Manufacturing solutions.  

Define reference architectures connecting OT assets, PLCs, DCS, SCADA, historians, MES/MOM, edge, enterprise, and cloud platforms.  

Assess brownfield/greenfield environments and define current, target, transition, and deployment architectures.  

Translate manufacturing needs into connectivity, data, contextualization, integration, analytics, and AI solutions.  

Design industrial data pipelines for real\-time and historical production, quality, maintenance, energy, event, and time\-series data.  

Lead Industrial AI and Edge AI use cases including predictive maintenance, anomaly detection, quality/process optimization, computer vision, and energy management.  

Architect industrial connectivity using OPC UA, MQTT, Sparkplug B, Modbus TCP, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, REST APIs, and vendor interfaces.  

Integrate OT with MES/MOM, ERP, PLM, WMS, QMS, EAM/APM, IoT, data platforms, Digital Twin, and analytics.

Implement OT cybersecurity and resilient architectures covering segmentation, zones/conduits, identity, encryption, remote access, redundancy, and disaster recovery.  

Lead site assessments, PoCs, feasibility studies, workshops, design reviews, vendor evaluations, and demonstrations.  

Govern architecture, integration, testing, DevSecOps/MLOps, documentation, risks, dependencies, quality, and multi\-site delivery.  

Provide technical leadership across IT/OT, automation, data, AI, cloud, and cybersecurity teams, including client engagements, RFP/RFI, proposals, estimation, and partner coordination.  

Develop reusable frameworks, accelerators, reference architectures, and deployment patterns that deliver measurable improvements in downtime, quality, throughput, cost, energy efficiency, and scalability.  

Professional and Technical Skills:  

Strong hands\-on expertise in industrial IT/OT architecture, factory connectivity, manufacturing integration, edge computing, industrial data engineering, and Industrial AI is mandatory.  

Deep knowledge of OT systems including PLC, DCS, SCADA, HMI, historians, industrial gateways, machine controllers, sensors, drives, robots, and vision systems.  

Advanced knowledge of OPC UA, MQTT, Sparkplug B, Modbus TCP, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, REST, AMQP, Kafka, and industrial/vendor connectivity patterns.  

Strong understanding of Purdue/ISA\-95 architecture, industrial network segmentation, DMZ patterns, zones and conduits, and enterprise\-to\-plant integration.  

Experience designing high\-availability industrial networks and edge architectures with firewalls, switches, routing, VLANs, redundancy, time synchronization, and secure remote access.  

Strong understanding of IEC 62443, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, zero\-trust principles, asset inventory, identity and access management, certificate management, patching, and vulnerability management.  

Experience with industrial connectivity and data platforms from Siemens, Rockwell Automation, Schneider Electric, Honeywell, ABB, PTC, Microsoft, AWS, NVIDIA, or equivalent ecosystems.  

Experience with edge and IoT platforms, containerized workloads, Kubernetes, Docker, APIs, message brokers, streaming platforms, and hybrid\-cloud architectures.  

Strong experience integrating OT data with MES/MOM, ERP, PLM, WMS, QMS, EAM/APM, historians, data lakes, lakehouses, Digital Twin, and analytics platforms.  

Strong knowledge of industrial data modelling, asset hierarchies, Unified Namespace concepts, semantic models, contextualization, time\-series data, event processing, and data governance.  

Experience designing Industrial AI/ML solutions covering data preparation, feature engineering, training, deployment, inference, monitoring, retraining, and responsible AI controls.  

Experience with Python, SQL, REST APIs, scripting, data engineering, analytics, and integration automation is preferred.  

Understanding of AI/ML, deep learning, anomaly detection, predictive models, optimization, computer vision, GenAI, and retrieval\-oriented industrial knowledge solutions.  

Strong understanding of Digital Twin, Industry 4\.0, smart manufacturing, connected operations, virtual commissioning, and closed\-loop optimization concepts.  

Experience with observability and operations covering device health, connectivity status, data quality, pipeline monitoring, model performance, logging, alerting, and support processes.  

Knowledge of manufacturing operations, production systems, maintenance, quality, material flow, utilities, energy management, and industrial engineering.  

Strong solution architecture, system design, analytical, troubleshooting, problem\-solving, and technical decision\-making skills.  

Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile, DevSecOps, DataOps, MLOps, project delivery, technical governance, quality management, and change control.  

Excellent client\-facing communication, executive stakeholder management, workshop facilitation, presentation, and technical documentation skills.  

Proven experience leading global and distributed teams and coordinating industrial OEMs, automation vendors, network providers, cloud providers, and delivery partners.  

Strong experience in solution design, PoCs, feasibility studies, technical assessments, site surveys, RFP/RFI responses, effort estimation, and proposal development.  

Strong understanding of Automotive, Aerospace, CPG, Life Sciences, Resources, Utilities, or General Manufacturing domains.  

Ability to convert architecture and Industrial AI insights into actionable recommendations, scalable rollout patterns, and quantified business outcomes.  

Additional Information:  

Experience: 12\+ years of overall experience with significant expertise in industrial IT/OT, manufacturing connectivity, automation, industrial data, edge computing, cybersecurity, and Industrial AI.  

Location: Bengaluru, India.

083b70f8.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, Trust CX Innovations
083b70f8.description:
**Description**
 Trust depends on two things being true at once: that every piece of customer data is governed, controlled, and provably compliant, and that the organization can move fast enough to keep up as products evolve in the era of AI. TCI's AI Enablement \& Data Governance charter owns both. On the data side, we make sure data is classified, its handling is enforceable, and compliance can be proven rather than asserted. On the enablement side, we use AI\-driven automation to take operational load off the entire organization so builders spend their time building trust, not maintaining it by hand.
   

  

 We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to drive the programs across this charter. You will own complex, cross\-functional initiatives that span product, engineering, and science teams, and often multiple organizations, from data governance and enforcement programs to the automation efforts that reduce operational burden at scale. Operating with significant autonomy, you will set the plan, map dependencies across teams, surface risks early, and keep a broad set of stakeholders aligned on a shared bar and timeline, including partners in privacy, legal, and other organizations we depend on. You will operate at a technical level, understanding the systems and trade\-offs well enough to ask the right questions and drive sound decisions, and you will bring the judgment and influence to hold teams that do not report to you accountable to their commitments. Above all, you will be the connective tissue that turns provable data governance and AI\-driven efficiency from goals into delivered outcomes.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Own and drive complex, cross\-functional programs across both data governance and AI enablement, spanning multiple engineering, product, and science teams and often multiple organizations.
* Build the program plan from ambiguity: define scope, milestones, and success criteria, and translate a broad charter into an executable roadmap with clear owners.
* Map and manage cross\-team and cross\-org dependencies, including partners in privacy and legal, surface risks early, and drive them to resolution before they affect delivery.
* Drive data governance programs so that data classification, handling enforcement, and retention obligations are met and provable, and make those requirements a prerequisite for new services rather than an afterthought.
* Drive the AI enablement and automation agenda that reduces operational burden across the organization, and track its impact on capacity and delivery.
* Establish the bar for what "done" and "compliant" mean in this space and embed it into how programs are planned and run.
* Keep a diverse set of stakeholders aligned, from individual builders to senior leaders, through clear written narratives, status, and decision documents.
* Operate at a technical level: understand the systems and trade\-offs well enough to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions, and drive sound decisions.
* Define and track the metrics that show whether governance is provable and whether automation is actually returning capacity, and use them to prioritize.
* Influence and hold teams that do not report to you accountable to shared commitments and timelines.


**About The Team**
 The Trust CX Innovation team drives advancements across Amazon Devices \& Services (D\&S) products. Our mission focuses on maintaining trust as the foundation while ensuring universal access as AI technology evolves. Our team develops essential privacy safeguards and accessibility features that serve millions of customers globally.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 7\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi\-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

* \- Expertise in privacy regulations and accessibility standards
* \- Ability to drive technical decisions across teams
* \- Advanced program management capabilities
* \- Experience defining technical metrics

* \- Experience with rapid technology adoption

a67f82f1.description:
**Description**
 Amazon strives to be Earth's most customer\-centric company, where customers can find and discover anything they want to buy online. Retail Business Services (RBS) accelerates Amazon's growth by improving customer and Selling Partner (SP) experiences, while optimizing costs across Stores WW. RBS operates at the intersection of retail, operations, technology, and finance, ensuring Amazon's systems and processes scale reliably while maintaining a high\-quality customer and selling\-partner experience.
   

  

 Cost to Serve (CtS) is a specialized organization within RBS focused on improving Amazon's per\-unit economics across the global supply chain. CtS operates on two pillars: defect identification and defect elimination, and partners with WW Operations, Finance, Returns, Concessions, and abuse\-related programs to uncover true cost drivers and remove them systematically. The team builds mechanisms that improve cost predictability, strengthen upstream defect visibility, and enable consistent governance across high\-impact cost categories, contributing directly to improved Free Cash Flow and scalable business growth.
   

  

 Are you passionate about building AI\-powered cost intelligence solutions at scale? Amazon's RBS CtS organization is looking for an experienced Senior Program Manager to lead our charter for identification of emerging cost trends, which serves as the first step in the journey of Defect Identification and contributes to the organization’s defect elimination work. This role serves as the primary business POC, engaging with RBS, Retail category, FBA and Finance teams in managing two projects (i) Project Strata, a layered analytical product built on a "peel the layers" philosophy that gives RBS and Stores leadership a unified, one\-stop view of how Cost to Serve is trending — decomposing headline P\&L costs into granular operational drivers and identifying cost opportunities through benchmarking between different time periods, MPs, channels and business lines. (ii) Defining and setting up P0 output and input metrics for RBS's UDE program. This role also serves as the primary POC to our tech partners in building and scaling above two projects and guides a team of Business Analysts who co\-develop and validate the MLP and scaled product's outputs.
   

  

 This leader will define requirements, own the working backward plan and oversee the daily mechanisms that connect business expertise to technical development. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable managing technical product delivery and presenting program health to Director\-level leadership, with the judgment to navigate ambiguity in a fast\-moving, high\-visibility space.
   

  

 Why You’ll Love This Role
   

  

* High Impact at Scale: You'll lead identification of emerging cost trends and drive investment by the Org in right cost areas.
* Build with Tech: Serve as the key business voice shaping an AI\-powered platform from the ground up, defining what good looks like and ensuring the tool meets the bar for downstream adoption.
* Leadership Visibility: Own updates to senior leaders on key organizational priorities, with direct influence on how the organization invests in automation long\-term.


 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Business/Tech Partnership \& Requirements Definition: Serve as the primary business counterpart to the analytics and tech teams.
* Working Backward Planning: Own the milestone delivery plan for above two projects. Identify risks early, adjust plans proactively, and maintain credible path\-to\-green narratives for leadership.
* BA Team Oversight: Manage the Business Analysts who develop MLP of the products. Iteratively capture feedbacks from Stores leaders and ensure the feedback mechanism runs smoothly, quality standards are maintained, and BAs are effectively translating domain expertise into product development.
* Quality \& Trade\-off Decisions: Hold a high bar on output quality. When design or quality blockers arise, make trade\-off decisions that balance speed, accuracy, and adoption — escalating to senior leaders for significant calls.

9e9e4506.title: Pre-sales Techno-functional Consultant (FCC & GRC)
9e9e4506.description:
Sciente is a Singapore-headquartered specialist BFSI technology and AI/data consulting firm, with offices across Singapore, Malaysia, India, and the USA. We help banks, insurers, and financial services firms modernize through AI-driven governance, risk and compliance (GRC), data intelligentisation, and business technology consulting, delivered through strategic partnerships with Dataiku, Denodo, and Neo4j, alongside our technology talent management practice.

**Role Summary**

Sciente is hiring a mid-level, India-based Pre-sales Techno-functional Consultant (FCC & GRC) who turns BFSI clients' financial crime compliance (FCC) and governance, risk and compliance (GRC) problems into solution concepts, and grows into a senior pre-sales role.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. **Problem discovery.**
   Run discovery sessions with compliance, risk, operations and IT stakeholders at banks, insurers and other financial institutions. Turn vague pain points into structured problem statements with scope, root causes and success measures.
2. **Solution conceptualisation.**
   Design solution concepts across FCC (AML, sanctions screening, fraud, KYC/CDD, transaction monitoring) and GRC (regulatory mapping, controls, risk registers, audit readiness).
3. **Partner-stack architecture.**
   Map each problem to Sciente's capabilities and partner technologies, for example:

* Neo4j for entity resolution, network analytics and linking regulations to controls and risks
* Denodo for unifying data spread across core banking, case management and GRC systems
* Dataiku for models, analytics and explainable decisioning

1. **Proposals and effort estimates.**
   Write solution sections of RFP/RFI responses and proposals, including scope, assumptions, phasing and effort estimates, with delivery leads.
2. **Demos and proofs of concept.**
   Build and present demos and small proofs of concept tailored to the client's data and use case.
3. **Client presentations.**
   Present to both business buyers (Chief Compliance Officer, Chief Risk Officer, Head of Financial Crime) and technical buyers (CIO, CDO, enterprise architects), mostly remotely, with occasional travel.
4. **Market and regulatory awareness.**
   Track regulatory change and industry practice in the markets Sciente serves, and feed this into reusable solution accelerators.
5. **Handover to delivery.**
   Hand over won deals with clear solution documentation so delivery starts without rework.

**Requirements**

Candidates need depth in either GRC or FCC domain and working knowledge of the other.

**Must have**

* Roughly 6 to 10 years in BFSI, including hands-on work in FCC or GRC
* Deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working knowledge of the other domain, enough to frame its problems credibly:

**(a) FCC:**
AML transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, fraud detection, KYC/CDD or case management

**(b) GRC:**
regulatory compliance mapping, risk and control frameworks, operational risk, internal audit or policy management

* Hands-on experience with at least one FCC or GRC platform, as implementer, consultant or user
* Hands-on work experience in technology solutioning is a must
* Solid data literacy: data models, data quality, integration patterns, and how analytics and models drive alerts or risk scores
* Familiarity with regulatory expectations beyond one country, such as FATF standards and at least one of MAS, BNM, US BSA/FinCEN
* Strong written and spoken English; able to whiteboard a solution live with senior client stakeholders
* Willingness to take calls across APAC and US time zones, and to travel occasionally

Find out more: www.sciente.com

When you apply, you voluntarily consent to the disclosure, collection and use of your personal data for employment/recruitment and related purposes in accordance with the SCIENTE Group Privacy Policy, a copy of which is published at SCIENTE’s website (https://www.sciente.com/privacy-policy/).

Confidentiality is assured, and only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

ac12a7f9.title: Senior Engagement Manager, AWS Strategic Industries
ac12a7f9.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Are you energized by leading complex technical programs that transform how organizations operate in the cloud? As a Senior Engagement Manager within Amazon Web Services (AWS) Professional Services, you will guide customers through their most ambitious cloud initiatives, turning strategic vision into measurable business outcomes. You will own the full lifecycle of large-scale engagements, orchestrating teams of technical consultants, customer stakeholders, and partners to deliver results that matter.  
  
This role puts you at the intersection of technology and business strategy. You will navigate ambiguity, align competing priorities, and build trusted relationships with executives and technical leaders alike. If you are a collaborative, adaptable program leader who thrives on solving hard problems and helping customers realize the full value of cloud adoption, we want to hear from you.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Lead the end-to-end delivery of large, multi-workstream cloud engagements by creating and maintaining comprehensive project plans, defining quality standards, and aligning AWS, customer, and partner resources to achieve agreed-upon business outcomes.
* Build and manage strategic customer relationships across technical and executive stakeholders, proactively identifying risks, clearing blockers, and driving timely decisions to keep programs on track — including redirecting distressed engagements toward successful delivery.
* Facilitate release planning, workshops, and discovery sessions using multiple delivery and cloud frameworks (such as Agile, Waterfall, Well-Architected Framework, and Cloud Adoption Framework) to translate customer strategy into executable roadmaps.
* Lead complex business and technical discussions, harmonize conflicting perspectives, and guide customers to define and expand on their cloud adoption strategy while identifying opportunities to maximize engagement value through scope and financial negotiations.
* Establish reusable delivery mechanisms, best practices, and documentation standards that improve quality and efficiency across engagements, and mentor fellow engagement managers to raise the overall team capability.

  
A day in the life  
You start your morning reviewing program dashboards and preparing for a steering committee meeting with a customer's leadership team, where you present delivery progress and align on upcoming milestones. Mid-morning, you facilitate a cross-team planning session, helping architects and developers prioritize the next sprint. After lunch, you join a technical review to validate that a proposed solution meets the customer's business objectives, then spend time coaching a newer engagement manager on stakeholder communication. Your afternoon wraps with a pipeline discussion, where you help shape an upcoming pre-sales opportunity.  
  
About the team  
AWS Professional Services partners with customers worldwide to accelerate their cloud journeys, from migration and modernization to building entirely new capabilities. Our engagement managers are the connective thread between technical delivery and business strategy, ensuring every project creates lasting value.  
  
We are a collaborative, customer-focused team that values continuous learning and operational excellence. Whether you are helping a customer adopt generative artificial intelligence or guiding a complex enterprise transformation, you will work alongside some of the brightest minds in cloud technology and have the opportunity to shape how organizations innovate at scale.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 2+ years of leading multiple Agile teams (like Scrum Masters, Product Owners) concurrently or at scale experience
* 7+ years of leading and delivering enterprise-level IT engagements experience
* Bachelor's degree in STEM field
* Knowledge of the value proposition of the public cloud and cloud engagement delivery (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS)
* Experience in leading multiple Agile teams (like Scrum Masters, Product Owners) concurrently or at scale
* Experience in leading and delivering enterprise-level IT engagements

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5+ years of delivering customer engagements in a professional services role experience
* active project management certification (e.g., APM, CSM, PMI-ACP, PRINCE2)
* AWS certification
* Experience in delivering customer engagements in a professional services role
* Experience with Agile and project management toolsets like Jira, Rally, VersionOne or Taiga
* Experience working with and presenting to C-level executives, IT, and lines of businesses across organizations or equivalent

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

Our technology is key, but our people make the difference. Brilliant minds innovate. They connect, create, and keep us on track towards changing the world’s energy systems. Their spirit fuels our mission. Our culture is defined by caring, agile, respectful, and accountable individuals. We value excellence of any kind. Sounds like you? Your new role – challenging and future-oriented.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Client Requirement Analysis: Ability to understand and interpret client requirements to align project outcomes.
* System Architectures: Knowledge of various architectures, including RSTP, PRP, and HSR.
* Networking: Hands-on experience in conﬁguring and testing Ethernet switches, routers, and ﬁrewalls.
* Communication Protocols: Experience with various communication types such as Ethernet, Fiber Optic, Serial (RS232/RS485), and PLCC.
* Substation Automation: Proﬁcient in Substation Automation and communication protocols, including SNMP, SNTP, Modbus, IEC 60870-5-103, IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-101, and IEC 60870-5-104.
* Technical Documentation: Ability to read and interpret panel drawings and schematics, with a focus on verifying technical compliance for hardware and software systems.
* HMI Conﬁguration: Hands-on experience in preparing HMI conﬁgurations, including Single Line Diagrams (SLD), System Architecture, Bay Views, and Interlock Vie
* System Integration: Proﬁciency in testing SAS systems and integrating them with various IEDs, meters, and devices.

* Basic knowledge of Electrical Protection Systems is an added advantage.
* Innovation: Willingness to collaborate on new solutions and technologies to drive.
* Customer Engagement: Experience in managing Customer FAT (Factory Acceptance Testing) and ensuring inspection compliance.
* Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

df408cfd.title: Associate Solutions Engineer- (Manufacturing) - Night Shift
df408cfd.description:
**About MISUMI Americas**

MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.

**What s in it for you**

**Opportunity To Unlock Your Creativity**

Think of all the times you were held back from trying new ideas because you were boxed in by bureaucratic legacy processes or old school tactics. Having a growth mindset is deeply ingrained into our company culture since day 1 so Fictiv is an environment where you have the creative liberty and support of the team to try big bold ideas to achieve our sales and customer goals.

**Opportunity To Grow Your Career**

There are plenty of jobs out there. The question is whether any of them will help you grow in your career Will you be challenged by teammates to achieve your potential Or are they roles that will ask you to do more of what youve already mastered. At Fictiv, youll be surrounded by supportive teammates who will push you to be your best through their curiosity and passion.

**Impact In This Role**

At Fictiv, we are building the worlds premier platform for hardware manufacturing. As an Associate Solutions Engineer, you will support our critical quoting and manufacturability functions, working at the interface between our two sets of customers - the builders who order parts through us, and the manufacturing partners who make them.

In this role you will learn to review the manufacturability and cost of parts submitted by our builders across processes such as CNC machining and 3D printing. Under the guidance of senior Solutions Engineers, you will apply your Mechanical Engineering background to interpret designs, prepare accurate quotes for custom parts, and flag design considerations that affect cost, quality, and lead time. Your work helps bring products to market faster and directly supports Fictivs growth.  
You will report to a Team Lead within Solutions Engineering, who will support your development from guided execution toward independent ownership of quoting and DFM work.

Why this role matters to our customers:  
Speed to Market - accurate quotes and timely DFM feedback help customers make faster decisions and launch sooner.  
Cost Confidence - precise, transparent costing prevents budget surprises later in the process.  
Risk Mitigation - catching manufacturability issues early avoids costly rework, material waste, and delays.  
Quality Assurance - confirming designs are feasible and tolerances are achievable helps customers get correct parts the first time

**What You ll Be Doing**

Quoting Support  
Prepare cost estimates for standard and moderately complex CNC machining and other manufacturing parts, combining your analysis with Fictivs software recommendations.  
Escalate complex geometries, non-standard processes, or challenging timelines to senior Solutions Engineers or High Touch (HT) quoting.  
Use platform tools to automate portions of the quoting process for speed and accuracy.

Design for Manufacturability (DFM)  
Perform DFM reviews on straightforward parts to highlight risks and suggest design or process adjustments, with guidance on more complex cases.  
Interpret engineering drawings, GDT, and material requirements to assess feasibility.

Technical Support Learning  
Build knowledge of machining, finishing, and assembly processes and their cost drivers.  
Learn region-specific manufacturing considerations across the US, India, China, and Mexico.

Customer Engagement  
Communicate with customers on routine clarifications and provide clear, timely updates during quoting.  
Support senior engineers in explaining trade-offs between cost, lead time, and quality.

Cross-functional Collaboration  
Work with internal teams (Sales, Operations, Sourcing, Quality Logistics) to keep projects moving.  
Provide feedback to the quoting software team to help improve the accuracy of automated quoting.

Documentation  
Assist in generating clear 2D drawings per ANSI/ASME Y14.5 standards and maintain accurate records of your quoting analysis.

All employees are expected to maintain and contribute to the QMS.

**Desired Traits**

Experience Education  
1-2 years of hands-on experience in manufacturing, quoting, design, or a related engineering function (internships and co-ops count).  
4-year Mechanical Engineering degree or equivalent technical training.  
Working familiarity with CNC machining and 3D printing is required; exposure to additional processes (sheet metal, urethane casting, injection molding, etc.) is a plus.  
Understanding of GDT and conventional (coordinate) tolerancing.  
Working knowledge of the manufacturability and limitations of common metals and plastics.

Traits  
Meticulous, detail-oriented, with an inclination for documentation.  
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English required.  
Self-starter who manages time efficiently and is eager to learn and take on more responsibility over time.  
Enjoys learning from others and, in time, sharing knowledge about manufacturing processes.

We re actively seeking teammates who:

* Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company.
* Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team.
* Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth.
* Have an always learning mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins.
* Help us continue to build a world-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates

We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.

  
  
Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.

30015066.title: AI Solution Architect
30015066.description:
**ROLE SUMMARY:** We are looking for an AI Solution Architect who can take an enterprise AI initiative from vision to execution. You will shape AI strategy with C-level stakeholders, architect cloud-native GenAI and ML platforms on Azure and Databricks, and lead cross-functional teams across data science, MLOps and product engineering to deliver them. You are equally comfortable presenting a roadmap to a board, reviewing a RAG pipeline design and coaching an engineer through a production incident.

**Experience**

* 12+ years in data, analytics or software engineering, including 5+ years leading AI/ML platforms or products in an enterprise setting.
* Proven record of taking ML and GenAI solutions into production at scale, with measurable business impact.
* Hands-on delivery of at least one production LLM/RAG solution, plus hands-on experience with agentic AI patterns.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary teams and presenting to C-level executives.
* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Data Science, Engineering, Statistics or a related field.

**Cloud & MLOps:** Azure (ADF, Azure ML, Synapse, Event Hubs, Key Vault), Databricks, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, CI/CD

**Data & ML:** Python, SQL, PySpark, MLflow, TensorFlow, Gurobi, Dataiku, SAS, Alteryx

**GenAI & Agentic AI:** OpenAI and other LLMs, LangChain, Milvus / vector databases, RAG, prompt engineering, memory agents, NLP, LLM evaluation

**BI & Visualisation:** Power BI, Tableau, Spotfire, Qlik

**Leadership Competencies:**

* AI strategy and roadmap execution
* AI/ML product lifecycle management
* Responsible AI and governance
* Stakeholder engagement and executive communication
* Training, change management and AI adoption
* Cross-functional team leadership
* Vendor and partner collaboration

**Nice to Have**

* Certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure AI Engineer, Databricks ML Professional or TOGAF.
* Experience with AWS or GCP AI services, or multi-cloud architectures.
* Industry exposure in financial services, energy, healthcare, manufacturing or the public sector.
* Experience designing or delivering AI training and enablement content.

**SUCCESS IN THE FIRST 12 MONTHS**

* An agreed AI roadmap and reference architecture adopted across key client engagements.
* At least two GenAI or ML solutions in production with tracked business value.
* A working Responsible AI and MLOps framework reused by delivery teams.
* A high-performing, cross-functional team and a strong bench of client executive relationships.

**Reports to: Chief Executive Officer / Head of AI**

 **Requirements**

**AI Strategy & Leadership**

* Define and own AI strategy and multi-year roadmaps aligned to client and C-level business priorities, with clear value metrics (revenue, cost, risk, productivity).
* Lead the full AI/ML product lifecycle: opportunity discovery, business case, architecture, build, deployment, adoption and value tracking.
* Build, mentor and lead agile delivery teams spanning data scientists, ML/MLOps engineers, data engineers and product managers.
* Act as a trusted advisor to executives, translating complex technical options into clear decisions on investment, risk and trade-offs.

**Solution Architecture & Delivery**

* Architect enterprise-grade, cloud-native AI/ML and analytics platforms on Azure (ADF, Azure ML, Synapse, Event Hubs, Key Vault) and Databricks.
* Design and deliver GenAI and agentic AI solutions: LLM integrations (OpenAI and others), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases (e.g. Milvus), prompt engineering, memory-enabled agents and NLP pipelines.
* Establish MLOps foundations using MLflow, Docker, Kubernetes and Terraform for reproducible training, CI/CD, monitoring and scalable model serving.
* Set architecture standards, reference designs and reusable components that reduce time-to-production across engagements.
* Guide data and analytics solutions end to end, from pipelines (Python, SQL, PySpark) to optimisation (Gurobi) and BI dashboards (Power BI, Tableau, Spotfire, Qlik).

**Responsible AI & Governance**

* Define and embed Responsible AI practices: fairness, explainability, privacy, security, model risk management and human oversight.
* Design governance for GenAI, including evaluation frameworks, guardrails, hallucination and prompt-injection controls, cost monitoring and audit trails.
* Ensure solutions comply with relevant regulations and client policies (e.g. PDPA, GDPR, MAS FEAT principles where applicable).

**Stakeholder, Change & Adoption**

* Engage business, IT, security and risk stakeholders to align scope, secure buy-in and manage expectations.
* Lead training, change management and AI adoption programmes so solutions are used, trusted and sustained.
* Manage vendor and partner relationships (cloud providers, LLM providers, platform and SI partners), including evaluation, selection and commercial input.
* Produce clear executive communication: roadmaps, status reports, value realisation reviews and steering committee materials.

  and Open Telemetry

* Design, develop, and deploy Agentic AI applications using Python, Generative AI, and Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Build and orchestrate multi-agent workflows using LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or Semantic Kernel.

Digital Health Strategy and managing the day-to-day operations of the FOGSI-Koita Centre for Digital

Maternal and Child Care (FOGSI-KCDM). You will work closely with doctors across India, partner

organizations, and external stakeholders to ensure successful execution of digital health initiatives

coordination, and implementation support across initiatives such as digital health adoption, EMR

enablement, AI-enabled solutions, capacity building, and ecosystem development for FOGSI members.

impact of digital health and AI-enabled solutions in OB-GYN practice.

 Develop and roll out capacity-building programs for practitioners, including workshops, CME

sessions, and digital training modules.

 Monitor progress and adoption metrics, analyze outcomes, and prepare reports for FOGSI

leadership and partners.

 Represent FOGSI-KCDM in external forums, conferences, and consultations.

healthcare /digital health/public health program management.

professional bodies.

Business Administration preferred.

Digital Health tools and technologies, or healthcare-focused nonprofit organizations.

By fostering a collaborative and supportive environment, you'll empower your team to excel while ensuring alignment with global SPEAR priorities and deadlines.

You will report directly to the US-based Area Vice President of Solutions Consulting, who leads the SPEAR Team. This reporting structure gives you a direct line into the strategy and priorities of Appian's global Presales organization, and positions you as the on-site Chennai leader and primary liaison between the Chennai team and stakeholders worldwide.

This role combines leadership, deep technical expertise, and strategic oversight, offering you the chance to make a significant impact both as a contributor and as a mentor. If you thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and are ready to elevate the capabilities of your team while showcasing the power of Appian's platform, this role is for you.

**What you'll be doing...**

* Team Leadership: Manage and mentor a team of Demo Engineers in Chennai, ensuring smooth day-to-day operations, clear priorities, and alignment with global Presales strategy.
* Technical Oversight: Provide senior technical guidance on capturing, refining, and expanding product demos, ensuring all outputs are reusable, impactful, and aligned with current Appian capabilities and industry trends.
* Operational Excellence: Own the cataloging and ingestion of product demos into DemoHub, maintaining high standards of quality, consistency, and discoverability across hundreds of assets per year.
* Senior Technical Contribution: Personally de-brand prospect-specific demos, enhance them with advanced new Appian features, and prepare them for broader organizational use -- setting the technical bar for the team's work.
* DemoHub Application Development: Lead and contribute to ongoing development and maintenance of the DemoHub Appian application itself -- the platform that stores, governs, and surfaces demo content to the global SC team. This includes building new features, fixing bugs, and improving usability.
* Clickable Demo Production: Oversee and personally contribute to the recording, editing, and continuous updating of interactive clickable demos in a commercial third-party demo platform, ensuring our self-service and accelerated demo experiences stay accurate, on-brand, and current.
* Demo Artifact Creation: Produce and oversee production of supporting artifacts including walkthrough videos, demo scripts, talk tracks, and quick-reference guides that help SCs adopt and adapt assets quickly.
* Cross-functional Collaboration: Act as the primary liaison between the Chennai team and global stakeholders, including the US-based SPEAR Team and Presales leadership, ensuring seamless communication, project execution, and knowledge transfer across time zones.
* Continuous Improvement: Develop and implement processes that improve the efficiency, quality, and throughput of demo ingestion, refinement, and maintenance workflows.
* Mentorship: Provide technical mentorship to Demo Engineers, fostering skill development, career growth, and a strong engineering culture within the team.
* Additional SPEAR Initiatives: Lead or contribute to other Presales enablement and readiness initiatives as the SPEAR Team's portfolio evolves.

**Who you are...**

* Strong, senior-level experience with Appian or a similar low-code application development platform, including design, development, and debugging of complex applications.
* Proven ability to manage and mentor technical teams, with demonstrated leadership and people management skills.
* Excellent technical and programming skills, with concrete examples of delivering polished, impactful work that others have used as a benchmark.
* Highly organized, with a track record of managing multiple projects and priorities in a high-volume, dynamic environment.
* Skilled in cross-functional collaboration, with solid verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication abilities -- including the ability to communicate clearly across global teams and time zones.
* Familiarity with interactive demo platforms (Storylane, Reprise, Navattic, Walnut, or similar) is a strong plus.
* Familiarity with video recording and editing tools for producing walkthrough content is a plus.
* Self-motivated, driven individual with a proactive approach to problem-solving and a strong sense of urgency.
* B.S. or M.S. in Engineering, Computer Science, or related fields, or equivalent work experience.

**Tools and Resources**

* Training and Development: During onboarding, we focus on equipping new hires with the skills and knowledge for success through department-specific training. Continuous learning is a central focus at Appian, with dedicated mentorship and the First-Friend program being widely utilized resources for new hires.
* Growth Opportunities: Appian provides a diverse array of growth and development opportunities, including our leadership program tailored for new and aspiring managers, a comprehensive library of specialized department training through Appian University, skills based training, and tuition reimbursement for those aiming to advance their education. This commitment ensures that employees have access to a holistic range of development opportunities.
* Community: We’ll immerse you into our community rooted in respect starting on day one. Appian fosters inclusivity through our 8 employee-led affinity groups. These groups help employees build stronger internal and external networks by planning social, educational, and outreach activities to connect with Appianites and larger initiatives throughout the company.

**Benefits**

Benefits may include health coverage, Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with free mental health support, life and disability insurance, an Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), a retirement/pension plan, wellness dollars, tuition reimbursement, family-forming benefits and more. Benefits vary by country—please ask your Talent Acquisition contact for details specific to the location you are applying to.

84757f43.title: Solutions Architect
84757f43.description:
At YNV Group, we are building an AI-enabled engineering organisation and are looking for a hands-on Solution / Technical Architect who can translate business needs into secure, practical, and deliverable technology solutions. You will work from business context and requirements through architecture, build, and operational handover, leading the design of internal tools, AI agents, workflow automations, and integrated applications.

This is not a role that stops at producing diagrams. You will shape the solution, make the key technical decisions, define the work for engineering teams, guide delivery and verify that the implemented product meets the intended business outcome. You will also design the Microsoft Azure resources required by each solution and ensure that AI-assisted engineering is applied safely through appropriate guardrails, quality controls and end-to-end engineering practices.

The ideal candidate combines business analysis, solution architecture and technical delivery leadership. They can move comfortably between stakeholder conversations, architecture design, Azure configuration, engineering backlog refinement and hands-on validation of working solutions.

**Helping people thrive and grow in the modern digital world.**

YNV Group has been building successful businesses that deliver long-term value since 2010. As a privately owned holding company, we excel at identifying and addressing unmet market needs. With a global workforce of over 6,000 employees across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia, our portfolio spans technology, real estate, and financial services. Led by industry experts committed to sustainable growth and innovation, we prioritize building lasting relationships with our clients and partners, ensuring their needs remain central to our approach. The brands in our portfolio include TeKnowledge, Everty, Sandglass, Monifai and Smart Factoring.

**Mindset & Ways of Working**

* Business-first: starts with the problem, users, process, and measurable outcome before selecting technology
* Hands-on by default: prototypes, validates assumptions, reviews implementation and uses the Azure portal when needed
* Delivery-minded: produces designs that engineers can build, operate, secure, and support
* Clear and decisive: makes trade-offs visible, records decisions and gives development teams actionable direction
* AI-enabled but accountable: uses AI coding tools to accelerate delivery while maintaining human review, traceability and engineering quality
* Secure and responsible: treats identity, data protection, privacy, safety, compliance and misuse prevention as core design concerns
* Pragmatic and adaptable: balances target architecture, delivery pace, cost and technical debt
* Collaborative: works effectively with product owners, business SMEs, developers, data/AI specialists, security, operations and vendors

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end solution architecture from business discovery and requirements clarification through design, build guidance, testing, release, and operational handover
* Understand the business context, user journeys, operating processes, pain points, constraints, and expected benefits, and translate them into clear solution requirements
* Lead the design of tools, AI agents, workflow automations, integrations, and supporting cloud services
* Decompose the target solution into components, interfaces, data flows, user stories, technical enablers, and delivery work packages
* Provide clear technical direction to development teams, including architecture patterns, acceptance criteria, non-functional requirements and implementation guardrails
* Review code, infrastructure, integrations, prompts, agent workflows and technical outputs to ensure alignment with the approved design
* Facilitate design workshops and make proportionate decisions across build, buy, configure and integrate options
* Create and maintain architecture artefacts, including context diagrams, solution designs, data flows, integration contracts, threat models, design decisions and support models
* Identify risks, dependencies, technical debt and delivery constraints early, and drive appropriate resolution or escalation
* Partner with product and delivery leads to shape estimates, sequencing, milestones and release plans
* Ensure solutions are production-ready, observable, supportable, cost-conscious and aligned with enterprise architecture standards
* Contribute reusable reference architectures, templates, patterns and engineering standards to the architecture practice

**Solution Design & Delivery Leadership**

* Convert functional and non-functional requirements into an implementable architecture covering application, data, integration, security, cloud and operations
* Design modern solutions using APIs, events, microservices, serverless components, low-code/workflow platforms and appropriate packaged services
* Define system boundaries, component responsibilities, interfaces, error handling, resilience, performance, scalability and service-level requirements
* Lead technical discovery and proof-of-concept activity to validate feasibility, value, user experience and key architectural assumptions
* Guide engineers during sprint planning, backlog refinement and delivery, resolving design questions and preventing divergence from the intended architecture
* Define engineering quality gates covering code review, automated testing, security scanning, dependency management, deployment controls and architecture conformance
* Plan the transition into production, including environments, release approach, rollback, monitoring, documentation, support ownership and knowledge transfer
* Assess vendor or platform designs and ensure external delivery teams meet organisational architecture, security and engineering expectations

**AI, Agents & Automation Architecture**

* Design AI-enabled applications and agentic workflows that combine models, tools, enterprise data, APIs and human decision points
* Determine when to use deterministic automation, generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic patterns or a hybrid approach
* Define AI guardrails including authorised tools and actions, prompt and policy controls, content safety, data boundaries, grounding, confidence thresholds, human approval and exception handling
* Design for traceability and evaluation through prompt/version management, model and tool logging, quality measures, test datasets, feedback loops and audit evidence
* Address AI-specific risks such as hallucination, prompt injection, data leakage, excessive agency, unsafe actions, model drift and inappropriate reliance on model output
* Establish secure patterns for model access, secrets, identities, vector stores, knowledge sources, memory, tool invocation and agent-to-system integration
* Apply responsible AI principles and ensure solutions have appropriate transparency, explainability, privacy, accessibility and human oversight
* Define operating controls for AI solutions, including monitoring, usage and cost controls, incident response, change governance and periodic re-evaluation

**AI-Enabled Engineering**

* Use AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor or equivalent to accelerate analysis, design, coding, testing, documentation and troubleshooting
* Define safe usage patterns for AI coding tools, including approved repositories and models, data handling, intellectual property protection, secure prompt practices and prohibited uses
* Ensure AI-generated code is treated as untrusted until reviewed, tested, scanned and validated against engineering standards
* Integrate AI assistance into the software development lifecycle without weakening peer review, segregation of duties, security testing or release controls
* Promote specification-led development, reusable prompts and context, automated tests and evidence-based quality checks
* Coach engineering teams on effective and responsible use of AI tools and continuously improve the end-to-end engineering process

**Azure Architecture & Platform Responsibilities**

* Design the Azure resources required for each solution and validate designs directly in the Azure portal where appropriate
* Select suitable services across App Service, Container Apps, Functions, AKS, Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, Logic Apps, API Management, Service Bus, Event Grid, Storage, Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, Cosmos DB and Key Vault
* Design identity and access using Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities, role-based access control and least-privilege principles
* Define secure networking patterns using virtual networks, private endpoints, private DNS, firewalls and controlled ingress/egress
* Design environment and subscription structures, resource groups, naming, tagging, policy, secrets, configuration and deployment boundaries
* Ensure infrastructure is repeatable through Bicep and/or Terraform and delivered through Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions pipelines
* Build observability into the solution using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics and Application Insights, including actionable logs, metrics, traces and alerts
* Estimate and manage cloud consumption, model usage and automation run costs, and design appropriate budget, quota and scaling controls
* Align designs with the Azure Well-Architected Framework and organisational cloud governance standards

**Required Qualifications**

**Experience**

* Minimum 10 years in software engineering, systems integration or technology delivery, including at least 5 years in solution or technical architecture roles
* Proven experience leading complex solutions from early business discovery through production implementation and operational handover
* Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business problems into clear requirements, architecture decisions and executable engineering work
* Experience providing technical leadership to multidisciplinary development teams without relying solely on formal line authority
* Hands-on experience designing and deploying solutions on Microsoft Azure
* Experience delivering automation, AI-enabled applications, digital tools or integration-led solutions in an enterprise environment
