a8c0731a.title: Architect, IT Solutions, Copilot & Agentic AI Platforms
a8c0731a.description:
Edwards Lifesciences is expanding its global technology capabilities with the launch of a new IT Innovation Hub in Pune, India. The Hub strengthens the technology foundation that supports our business worldwide, working in close partnership with teams across regions to deliver reliable, high-quality solutions at scale. Designed as a long-term investment, the Pune Hub will advance newer digital capabilities such as automation, data, AI, and cloud, and will include roles spanning end user services, application development, and enterprise platform teams. Together, these teams will help Edwards operate more efficiently and accelerate innovation in support of our mission of advancing patient care.
  
  
As Edwards accelerates its AI-driven transformation, we are seeking an Architect, IT Solutions to serve as the enterprise technical authority for our two most strategic agentic AI platforms — Microsoft Copilot (M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio) and Moveworks. This is a multi-faceted architecture role that spans platform leadership, integration design, and end-to-end solution architecture. You will define how these platforms are built, extended, integrated, and governed across the enterprise.
  
  
This role works alongside our existing Azure infrastructure architect and complements cloud expertise with deep, platform-specific technical authority. If you thrive at the intersection of enterprise architecture, applied AI, and business-facing delivery — and want to shape how a global lifescience company adopts agentic AI at scale — this is the role for you.
  
  
**How you’ll make an impact:**
**Platform Architecture Leadership — Copilot & Moveworks**

* Own the enterprise platform architecture for Microsoft Copilot (M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio) and Moveworks — serving as the definitive technical authority on capabilities, extensibility, and best practices.
* Define the ecosystem blueprint, platform standards, extensibility patterns, and long-term technical roadmap for both platforms.
* Evaluate and recommend new platform features, plugins, connectors, and agentic AI capabilities as they emerge from Microsoft and Moveworks.

**Integration Architecture**

* Design and govern the integration layer connecting Copilot and Moveworks to enterprise systems such as ServiceNow, Workday, JDE, Active Directory, HRIS, LMS, and CMDB.
* Define API strategies, event-driven patterns, connector frameworks, and messaging standards that enable secure, reliable, and scalable data flows across platforms.
* Partner with the Azure architecture team to ensure integration patterns align with cloud infrastructure, identity (Entra ID), and security standards.

**Lead Solution Architecture**

* Provide end-to-end solution design and technical authority for all AI agent, copilot, and automation solutions built on these platforms.
* Lead architecture reviews, approve design decisions, and ensure solutions are production-ready, secure, and aligned with enterprise standards.
* Translate complex business requirements into scalable, repeatable architectural patterns and executable design strategies.

**Governance, Mentorship & Innovation**

* Develop, institute, and maintain platform-specific design methodologies, development standards, security patterns, and operational best practices.
* Provide training, coaching, and technical mentorship to Forward-Deployed Engineers (FDEs), solution developers, and IT team members on Copilot and Moveworks architecture.
* Survey emerging developments in agentic AI — including multi-agent orchestration, RAG patterns, and tool-using agents — and recommend approaches that extend platform value.
* Develop and maintain architecture models, reference designs, integration maps, and documentation for current and proposed implementations.

**What you’ll need (Required):**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Progressive IT experience, including significant depth in platform architecture, integration architecture, or solution architecture.
* Experience in an architect role working with cross-functional teams (within IT and/or business) on enterprise-level or complex system implementations.
* Deep expertise in at least one of the following: Microsoft Copilot ecosystem (M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Graph API, Graph Connectors, Copilot extensibility) or Moveworks platform (conversational AI, enterprise integrations, workflow automation).
* Strong integration architecture skills: REST/GraphQL APIs, event-driven architectures, enterprise connectors, middleware, and messaging patterns (e.g., Azure Service Bus, Logic Apps, Power Automate).
* Proven ability to design end-to-end solution architectures for enterprise AI, automation, or digital workplace platforms.
* Experience defining platform standards, governance frameworks, and reusable architectural patterns at enterprise scale.
* Strong understanding of identity, security, and compliance requirements in enterprise AI deployments (e.g., Entra ID, conditional access, DLP, data classification).
* Expert-level documentation and communication skills — ability to create architecture blueprints, integration maps, and present complex technical concepts to senior leadership and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong interpersonal and leadership skills, including cross-functional negotiation, vendor management, and the ability to drive alignment across distributed teams.

**What else we look for (Preferred):**

* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio — building custom copilots, plugins, connectors, topics, and generative AI orchestration.
* Hands-on experience with Moveworks platform — configuring enterprise virtual agents, workflow automation, knowledge integration, and analytics.
* Experience with agentic AI patterns including multi-agent orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), tool-using agents, and planner-executor models.
* Experience integrating AI platforms with enterprise systems such as ServiceNow, Workday, SAP, Active Directory, LMS, and CMDB.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps) as an automation and extensibility layer.
* Experience deploying AI solutions in regulated industries (e.g., medical device, pharmaceuticals, financial services) with attention to governance and responsible AI practices.
* Advanced degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
* Professional certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert, TOGAF, or equivalent architecture frameworks.
* Track record of mentoring engineers and building technical communities of practice.

**Why is this role different?**
This is not a generic enterprise architect role. You will be the single technical authority for two of the most strategic AI platforms at Edwards Lifesciences — platforms that are actively transforming how our work, decide, and collaborate. You will shape the architecture, set the standards, and mentor the next generation of Forward-Deployed AI Engineers who build on these platforms every day.
  
  
You will operate at the intersection of platform strategy, hands-on architecture, and business impact — with direct visibility to senior IT leadership and the opportunity to influence how a global healthcare company scales agentic AI responsibly.
  
  
Recruiting scam alert: Read our notice about potential recruiting scams.

6ee53337.title: Solutions Architect - Digital Buildings
6ee53337.description:
**FPC Digital.**

At FPC Digital, we are driven by a bold vision: to become a global leader in digitally transforming real estate into secure and sustainable environments that set the digital building standard and benefit both people and our planet.

Our mission is clear: to empower the global delivery of intelligent, secure and vendor-agnostic digital buildings that prioritize human-centric design, operational effectiveness and sustainability.

As an aspiring leader in Digital Building Design, Delivery and Operations, FPC Digital specializes in creating spaces that are not only smart and connected but also environmentally responsible. With a dedicated team operating across the Americas, EMEA, APAC and India, we are shaping a more innovative and sustainable built environment.

**Job Description**

**Overview.**

We are looking for a Digital Buildings Architect to support the design and delivery of digital building solutions across international projects.

This role sits within the Digital Engineering team and focuses on smart building design, systems integration and digital infrastructure. You will work alongside senior architects and engineers to help shape how Independent Data Layers, building systems, networks and cloud platforms are brought together to deliver secure, sustainable and human centric buildings.

The ideal candidate will architect integrated solutions across BMS, IoT, analytics, and enterprise platforms while managing engineering teams and ensuring successful project execution from concept through handover.

**Key Responsibilities.**

Support Solution Architecture and Integration Design.

* Assist senior colleagues in developing digital building architectures covering building systems, networks, cloud platforms and Independent Data Layers.
* Help document integration between systems such as BMS, HVAC, lighting, metering, access control, vertical transport, IoT devices and workplace applications.
* Prepare and maintain technical artefacts including diagrams, data flow maps, interface schedules, device lists and point schedules.
* Contribute to the definition of IP addressing, VLAN structures, device naming and tagging that support scalability, security and analytics.

Smart Building Requirements, Energy and User Outcomes.

* Work with senior architects, project managers and client stakeholders to capture and refine smart building requirements, user journeys and use cases.
* Support the design of solutions that improve comfort, wellbeing, maintainability, space utilisation and energy performance, not just connectivity.
* Assist in selecting and specifying sensors, platforms and analytics tools that support optimisation, FDD and reporting against ESG and performance KPIs.

Cybersecurity and OT Network Support.

* Help apply secure by design principles to digital building architectures, aligned with client policies and recognised standards.
* Support coordination with client IT and security teams on topics such as segmentation, remote access and monitoring.
* Contribute to OT cyber risk assessments and remediation activities on projects, under guidance from senior team members.

Delivery Coordination, QA and Technical Support

* Support the Digital Solutions and MSI teams through the full project lifecycle, from concept and design through construction, commissioning and handover.
* Assist in reviewing contractor and vendor submissions for alignment with the agreed architecture, standards and scope.
* Help develop integration test plans, commissioning scripts and data validation checklists, and support their execution on projects.
* Provide day to day technical support to project managers and site teams, escalating complex issues to senior architects as needed.

Client, Stakeholder and Partner Engagement

* Participate in client workshops, design meetings and technical reviews, contributing to discussions and capturing actions and requirements.
* Support the preparation of technical content for proposals, scopes of work, deliverables and client presentations.
* Help coordinate with technology partners and vendors to align solutions, clarify interfaces and resolve design questions.

Standards, Knowledge Management and Continuous Improvement

* Use and help refine FPC Digital’s standards, templates and playbooks for MSI, IDL, smart building design and OT cyber.
* Contribute to internal knowledge libraries, lessons learned and case studies from live projects.
* Take part in training sessions, brown bag talks and communities of practice, both as a learner and, over time, as a contributor.

Team Leadership & People Management

* Lead and mentor solution engineers, deployment coordinators, and technical specialists.
* Support resource planning and team allocation across programs.
* Support hiring, training, performance management, and career development.
* Build technical capability within the remote center of excellence.

**Qualifications**

**Education.**

* Preferred: Degree in Engineering, Building Services, Computer Science, IT, or a related technical discipline.
* Equivalent industry experience will be considered.
* Additional training or certifications in any of the following would be beneficial but not essential:

  + Controls, BMS or systems integration
  + Networking fundamentals
  + Cloud platforms, data engineering or analytics

**Experience.**

* Industry Expertise:

  + Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Electrical, Mechanical, Controls, or related field).
  + 12–15 years of experience in BMS, smart buildings, or digital infrastructure
  + Exposure to commercial, workplace, life sciences, mixed use or similar building projects is preferred.
  + Strong knowledge of: Niagara Framework, BACnet / BACnet SC, Modbus,MQTT,,OPC, Cloud IoT platforms
  + Experience managing teams
  + Good to have knowledge of OT cybersecurity frameworks (NIST, IEC 62443).
* Technical Skills:
  + Good understanding of at least some key building systems and protocols, for example BMS, HVAC, lighting, metering, access control, BACnet, Modbus, MQTT or REST APIs.
  + Experience with integration design, data flows or connecting systems through gateways, APIs or middleware is desirable.
  + Awareness of IP networking concepts (addressing, VLANs, routing, firewalls) and an interest in developing deeper OT networking skills.
  + Interest or experience in analytics, FDD, dashboards, digital twins or data visualisation is beneficial.
  + Any exposure to tagging standards or ontologies (for example Haystack, Brick, custom schemas) would be a plus.
* Soft Skills:
* Clear written and verbal communication, able to present technical information in a structured and accessible way.
* Strong analytical and problem solving skills with attention to detail in documentation and design outputs.

**Additional Information**

**Our Culture and Values.**

At FPC Digital, our values guide everything we do:

Integrity: We act with honesty, accountability and a commitment to doing what’s right.

Diversity and Inclusion: We celebrate diverse perspectives and foster an inclusive environment where everyone thrives.

Collaboration: By working together, we unlock creativity and deliver exceptional results for our clients.

Effectiveness: We strive to deliver impactful solutions that maximize value and drive measurable outcomes.

**Why Join Us?**

FPC Digital is more than a company, it’s a mission-driven organization focused on delivering human-centric, effective and sustainable solutions. We value professional development, continuous learning and work-life balance.

a2142123.title: Senior Engagement Manager, AWS Strategic Industries
a2142123.description:
**Description**
Are you energized by leading complex technical programs that transform how organizations operate in the cloud? As a Senior Engagement Manager within Amazon Web Services (AWS) Professional Services, you will guide customers through their most ambitious cloud initiatives, turning strategic vision into measurable business outcomes. You will own the full lifecycle of large-scale engagements, orchestrating teams of technical consultants, customer stakeholders, and partners to deliver results that matter.
  
  
This role puts you at the intersection of technology and business strategy. You will navigate ambiguity, align competing priorities, and build trusted relationships with executives and technical leaders alike. If you are a collaborative, adaptable program leader who thrives on solving hard problems and helping customers realize the full value of cloud adoption, we want to hear from you.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Lead the end-to-end delivery of large, multi-workstream cloud engagements by creating and maintaining comprehensive project plans, defining quality standards, and aligning AWS, customer, and partner resources to achieve agreed-upon business outcomes.
* Build and manage strategic customer relationships across technical and executive stakeholders, proactively identifying risks, clearing blockers, and driving timely decisions to keep programs on track — including redirecting distressed engagements toward successful delivery.
* Facilitate release planning, workshops, and discovery sessions using multiple delivery and cloud frameworks (such as Agile, Waterfall, Well-Architected Framework, and Cloud Adoption Framework) to translate customer strategy into executable roadmaps.
* Lead complex business and technical discussions, harmonize conflicting perspectives, and guide customers to define and expand on their cloud adoption strategy while identifying opportunities to maximize engagement value through scope and financial negotiations.
* Establish reusable delivery mechanisms, best practices, and documentation standards that improve quality and efficiency across engagements, and mentor fellow engagement managers to raise the overall team capability.

A day in the life
  
  
You start your morning reviewing program dashboards and preparing for a steering committee meeting with a customer's leadership team, where you present delivery progress and align on upcoming milestones. Mid-morning, you facilitate a cross-team planning session, helping architects and developers prioritize the next sprint. After lunch, you join a technical review to validate that a proposed solution meets the customer's business objectives, then spend time coaching a newer engagement manager on stakeholder communication. Your afternoon wraps with a pipeline discussion, where you help shape an upcoming pre-sales opportunity.
  
  
**About The Team**
AWS Professional Services partners with customers worldwide to accelerate their cloud journeys, from migration and modernization to building entirely new capabilities. Our engagement managers are the connective thread between technical delivery and business strategy, ensuring every project creates lasting value.
  
  
We are a collaborative, customer-focused team that values continuous learning and operational excellence. Whether you are helping a customer adopt generative artificial intelligence or guiding a complex enterprise transformation, you will work alongside some of the brightest minds in cloud technology and have the opportunity to shape how organizations innovate at scale.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 2+ years of leading multiple Agile teams (like Scrum Masters, Product Owners) concurrently or at scale experience
* 7+ years of leading and delivering enterprise-level IT engagements experience
* Bachelor's degree in STEM field
* Knowledge of the value proposition of the public cloud and cloud engagement delivery (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS)
* Experience in leading multiple Agile teams (like Scrum Masters, Product Owners) concurrently or at scale
* Experience in leading and delivering enterprise-level IT engagements

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of delivering customer engagements in a professional services role experience
* active project management certification (e.g., APM, CSM, PMI-ACP, PRINCE2)
* AWS certification
* Experience in delivering customer engagements in a professional services role
* Experience with Agile and project management toolsets like Jira, Rally, VersionOne or Taiga
* Experience working with and presenting to C-level executives, IT, and lines of businesses across organizations or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
  
  
  
**Company**
- AWS India - Karnataka

e75cb6b3.title: Principal Architect — Cloud, Agentic AI & Data Engineering
e75cb6b3.description:
**Principal Architect — Cloud, Agentic AI & Data Engineering**

**Field**

**Detail**

**Job Title**

Principal Architect — Cloud, Agentic AI & Data Engineering

**Function / Practice**

Digital, Data & AI — Technology & Solutions

**Reports To**

Head of Architecture / Practice Head — Digital & AI

**Experience**

15+ years in software, data and cloud engineering, including 5+ years in an architect capacity

**Location**

Hyderabad / Bengaluru / Pune (Hybrid), with travel to client sites as required

**Employment Type**

Full-time, Permanent

**Grade / Band**

Principal Architect

**ROLE SUMMARY**

Cyient is looking for a Principal Architect who can operate at the intersection of cloud platform engineering, agentic AI and modern data engineering — and who is equally comfortable in front of a customer as in a design review.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing architecture role. You will own end-to-end solution architecture for strategic engagements, shape winning proposals and RFP responses, build demos and proofs of concept alongside the delivery team, and set the technical direction that engineering teams execute against. You will also mentor architects and senior engineers, and partner with fellow architects across practices to drive reusable assets, accelerators and an active innovation agenda.

Success in this role looks like architecture decisions that survive production, customers who ask for you by name, proposals that convert, and a bench of engineers who are measurably stronger because you invested in them.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Solution & Cloud Architecture**

* **Own end-to-end architecture**
  for large, multi-workstream programs spanning cloud infrastructure, data platforms and AI services.
* **Design cloud-native solutions**
  on Microsoft Azure (or AWS ) covering compute, networking, identity, integration, observability, cost management and security.
* **Define the non-functional architecture**
  — scalability, resilience, latency, availability, disaster recovery and multi-tenancy — and hold designs accountable to it.
* **Establish architecture governance**
  : reference architectures, design standards, review checkpoints, a technology radar and architecture decision records (ADRs).
* **Drive cloud modernisation**
  and migration strategy — landing zones, containerisation, microservices, event-driven patterns and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform / Bicep / ARM).

**Agentic AI & Applied GenAI**

* **Architect agentic AI systems**
  — multi-agent orchestration, tool and function calling, planning and reflection loops, memory, and human-in-the-loop control points.
* **Select and integrate the AI stack**
  : LLM providers (Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, open-weight models), orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, MCP-based tooling) and vector / retrieval layers.
* **Design production-grade RAG**
  and knowledge-grounding pipelines — chunking strategy, embeddings, hybrid search, re-ranking, grounding and citation.
* **Define AI evaluation and guardrails**
  : accuracy and hallucination benchmarks, red-teaming, prompt-injection defence, PII handling, cost and token governance, and model observability.
* **Operationalise LLMOps**
  — prompt versioning, CI/CD for AI assets, regression evaluations, drift monitoring and safe rollout patterns.
* **Champion Responsible AI**
  principles — transparency, traceability, bias assessment and auditability — aligned to client and regulatory expectations.

**Data Engineering & Platform**

* **Architect modern data platforms**
  — lakehouse and medallion architectures on Azure Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Synapse, Snowflake or equivalent.
* **Design batch and streaming pipelines**
  using Spark, Kafka / Event Hubs, Azure Data Factory and dbt, with clear SLAs on freshness and data quality.
* **Establish data governance**
  : cataloguing, lineage, master data management, quality frameworks and access control (Unity Catalog, Microsoft Purview).
* **Model data for both analytics and AI consumption**
  , ensuring the same governed assets serve BI, ML and agentic workloads.
* **Optimise for cost and performance**
  — partitioning, storage tiering, compute right-sizing and workload isolation.

**Customer Engagement & Presales**

* **Act as the senior technical face to the customer**
  — run discovery workshops, architecture reviews and executive briefings for both engineering and CxO audiences.
* **Translate business problems into solution options**
  , with honest trade-offs on cost, risk, time-to-value and long-term maintainability.
* **Lead technical responses to RFPs, RFIs and proactive proposals**
  — solution narrative, architecture diagrams, delivery approach, effort estimation, staffing model and risk register.
* **Build compelling demos and proofs of concept**
  with the team — tightly scoped, built fast, and mapped to a measurable customer outcome.
* **Support deal shaping**
  alongside sales and account teams: value articulation, differentiation, competitive positioning and defence of the proposed architecture.
* **Own the technical narrative post-win**
  , ensuring that what was sold is what gets designed and delivered.

**Leadership, Mentoring & Innovation**

* **Guide and mentor**
  architects, tech leads and senior engineers through design reviews, pairing, structured feedback and career conversations.
* **Collaborate with peer architects**

66d62d4d.title: Lead Consultant- Documentum Life Sciences Solutions
66d62d4d.description:
**Opentext - The Information Company**
OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.
  
  
**AI-First. Future-Driven. Human-Centered.**
At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We're hiring talent that AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.
  
  
**Your Impact**
Provides technical and consultative assistance on engagements involving implementing the OPENTEXT Documentum Life Sciences solutions for our world-wide clients. Understands client requirements, conducts detailed technical design, determines level of effort & implementation approach, performs installation, development & integration and prepares technical documentation. Provides assistance and guidance to junior staff members in solving technical implementation issues.
  
  
**What The Role Offers**

Collaborate with senior staff and the engagement project manager as required during difficult client situations. Keep project managers informed of activities and alert of any issues promptly. Provide inputs as part of engagement closure on project learnings and suggest improvements

ff027c1c.title: Infra & AI  Architect
ff027c1c.description:
**Overview**
Microsoft Industry Solutions Delivery is a global organization hosting over 6,000 strategic sellers, industry and security experts, elite engineers, world-class data scientists and architects, consultants, and delivery specialists. Together with our partners, we help Microsoft’s most strategic customers worldwide to address their specific challenges and provide comprehensive and industry-specific solutions that meet their unique needs.
  
  
Our organization is at the forefront of innovation, driving value across the entirety of the customers’ digital and AI transformation journey through repeatable and customized cutting-edge solutions powered by Microsoft Cloud and AI. We take pride in embodying Microsoft's mission of empowerment, promoting a growth mindset, inspiring excellence, and fostering a culture of inclusivity where everyone is encouraged to share their unique perspectives and be their authentic selves. By joining our team, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to life-changing innovations that impact billions of people worldwide.
  
  
The Infrastructure & AI Architect is responsible for designing secure, scalable, resilient, and AI-ready enterprise platforms on Microsoft Azure.
  
  
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
The architect works with customers, engineering teams, security teams, and delivery stakeholders to translate business and technical requirements into practical Azure architectures. The role combines strong Azure infrastructure architecture with modern AI platform, security, governance, automation, and operational design capabilities.
  
  
The architect is expected to provide technical leadership from discovery and architecture through implementation, governance, and operational readiness.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 14+ years experience in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting, and/or technology domain of Infra & AI.
* OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 14+ years experience in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting, and/or technology domain (e.g., Security)

Azure Infrastructure Architecture
  
  

* Design enterprise-scale Azure architectures using Azure Landing Zones and cloud adoption principles.
* Define subscription, management group, resource organization, naming, tagging, and governance models.
* Design hub-and-spoke and Virtual WAN architectures.
* Architect hybrid connectivity using ExpressRoute, VPN, Azure Virtual WAN, and private connectivity.
* Design Azure networking including VNets, subnets, routing, NSGs, Azure Firewall, Application Gateway, load balancers, NAT Gateway, Private Link, and Private Endpoints.
* Define scalable DNS and private DNS architecture.
* Design resilient solutions across Availability Zones and Azure regions.
* Define business continuity, disaster recovery, backup, and high-availability strategies.

Identity, Security & Governance
  
  

* Design identity architectures using Microsoft Entra ID.
* Define managed identity, workload identity, role-based access control, privileged access, and least-privilege models.
* Implement security architecture using Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, Azure Policy, Key Vault, encryption, and customer-managed keys.
* Design secure administrative and privileged-access patterns.
* Define network segmentation and Zero Trust architecture.
* Ensure architecture aligns with enterprise security, regulatory, data sovereignty, and compliance requirements.

Observability & Operations
  
  

* Design centralized and distributed monitoring architectures using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, and Microsoft Sentinel.
* Define logging, monitoring, alerting, operational dashboards, and telemetry strategies.
* Design infrastructure that supports SRE and modern cloud operations.
* Define operational readiness, service health, capacity management, incident response, and troubleshooting approaches.
* Drive infrastructure automation and configuration consistency.

AI & AI-Ready Infrastructure
  
  

* Design secure enterprise AI platforms using Microsoft Foundry/Azure AI services and supporting Azure capabilities.
* Define networking, identity, compute, storage, data, security, and monitoring requirements for enterprise AI workloads.
* Design private and controlled access patterns for AI environments.
* Architect solutions supporting:
* Generative AI
* AI agents
* Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
* Enterprise search
* Vector and semantic search
* Embeddings
* Model endpoints and AI services
* Define secure connectivity between AI applications, enterprise data sources, APIs, and business systems.
* Establish AI platform governance, responsible AI, security, monitoring, and operational controls.
* Support integration of AI solutions with the broader Microsoft cloud ecosystem.

Automation & Platform Engineering
  
  

* Drive Infrastructure as Code using Bicep, ARM templates and/or Terraform.
* Define reusable architecture patterns, templates, and platform components.
* Support CI/CD and DevOps-based infrastructure deployment.
* Promote policy-driven governance and automated environment provisioning.
* Design self-service platform capabilities where appropriate.

Architecture Leadership
  
  

* Lead customer architecture and technical design workshops.
* Gather functional and non-functional requirements.
* Develop High-Level Designs and detailed technical designs.
* Produce architecture diagrams, decision documents, implementation guidance, and design standards.
* Conduct architecture reviews and identify technical risks and dependencies.
* Provide technical direction to engineering and implementation teams.
* Troubleshoot complex architecture, networking, identity, security, and platform issues.
* Conduct design reviews and ensure implementation remains aligned to the approved architecture.

Customer & Stakeholder Engagement
  
  

* Act as a trusted technical advisor to customer architects and technology leadership.
* Explain complex cloud and AI concepts in clear business language.
* Present architecture options, trade-offs, risks, costs, and recommendations.
* Collaborate with application, security, network, data, AI, governance, and operations teams.
* Help customers establish cloud and AI adoption roadmaps.
* Support solution estimation, implementation planning, risk management, and technical governance.

**Required Technical Skills**
Azure Infrastructure
  
  

* Azure Landing Zones
* Hub-and-Spoke / Virtual WAN
* Azure networking and routing
* ExpressRoute and VPN
* Azure Firewall
* Application Gateway / WAF
* Private Link / Private Endpoints
* Azure DNS / Private DNS
* Azure Load Balancer
* Azure compute and storage
* Availability Zones and multi-region architecture
* Backup and disaster recovery

Identity & Security
  
  

* Microsoft Entra ID
* Azure role-based access control
* Managed identities
* Key Vault
* Customer-managed keys
* Azure Policy
* Defender for Cloud
* Microsoft Sentinel
* Zero Trust security principles

AI
  
  

* Microsoft Foundry / Azure AI
* Generative AI architecture
* AI agents
* RAG architecture
* AI Search
* Vector and semantic search
* Model integration
* Prompt and AI security
* Responsible AI
* AI monitoring and governance

Monitoring & Operations
  
  

* Azure Monitor
* Log Analytics
* Application Insights
* Microsoft Sentinel
* Cloud operational models and SRE concepts

Automation
  
  

* Bicep / ARM
* Terraform
* Azure DevOps / GitHub
* CI/CD
* PowerShell / Azure CLI

Architecture Competencies
  
  
**The Successful Candidate Should Demonstrate The Ability To**

* Convert business requirements into end-to-end Azure architecture.
* Make architecture decisions across infrastructure, networking, security, identity, data, operations, and AI.
* Evaluate multiple technical approaches and clearly explain trade-offs.
* Design for security, reliability, scalability, performance, manageability, and cost.
* Lead complex enterprise architecture discussions involving multiple technology domains.
* Balance Microsoft platform capabilities with customer constraints and existing enterprise environments.
* Move comfortably between whiteboard architecture, detailed technical design, and implementation troubleshooting.

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
  
  
Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about
**requesting accommodations.**

c061b689.title: Cross Technology Managed Services Engineer (L3)
c061b689.description:

Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Your day at NTT DATA**

You will ensure that client infrastructure is configured, tested, and operational, leveraging your deep technical expertise to solve complex problems and enhance our service quality.

ccb12c08.title: Lead Managed Services Consultant
ccb12c08.description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.
  
  
By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real-time insights.
  
  
Today, 1,900+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role Summary**
Lead managed services delivery for Sprinklr CCaaS customers, driving platform configuration, optimization, and adoption across digital and voice ecosystems. Act as a hands-on solution lead ensuring scalable design, strong customer outcomes, and continuous value realization.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Translate customer business requirements into best-practice CCaaS solutions aligned to Sprinklr capabilities and defined solution blueprints.
* Own and manage end-to-end configurations across omnichannel workflows, routing, IVR, case management, SLA frameworks, and automation.
* Manage and maintain core configuration architecture, ensuring alignment with customer blueprints, supportability, and scalability standards.
* Configure and optimize advanced routing models including skills-based routing, priority logic, queue segmentation, and escalation workflows.
* Design and enhance IVR flows, voice queue logic, call routing paths, and contact center workflow automation.
* Build and optimize bot workflows, conversational AI journeys, and automation frameworks to improve containment, productivity, and customer experience.
* Drive platform adoption by aligning features to customer use cases, usage patterns, and operational objectives.
* Monitor and improve customer contact center operational metrics such as SLA adherence, AHT, queue performance, response times, productivity, and CSAT.
* Identify platform gaps and optimization opportunities and implement best practice solutioning to improve efficiency and service outcomes.
* Manage post go-live changes, releases, configuration updates, and continuous platform improvements across the customer lifecycle.
* Support and guide API, CRM, telephony, and third-party system integrations to enable connected workflows and unified service operations.
* Lead training and onboarding sessions for agents, admins, and customer teams to drive adoption of workflows, tools, and operating practices.
* Partner with Sales and Customer Success teams to identify new opportunities, drive platform consumption, and support upsell/cross-sell discussions.
* Act as the primary technical and functional point of contact, advising stakeholders on solution design, adoption strategy, and operational improvements.
* Leverage AI and automation opportunities to improve ROI, efficiency, and service performance.

**What Makes You Qualified?**
**Must Have Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in managed services, CCaaS, or technology consulting.
* Strong hands-on experience with Sprinklr CCaaS or similar platforms such as Genesys, Cisco Webex Contact Center, Twilio Flex, or comparable solutions.
* Strong knowledge of IVR, routing strategies, queue management, chatbot workflows, case management, and SLA configurations.
* Experience designing and supporting omnichannel customer journeys across digital and voice channels.
* Understanding of telephony concepts such as VoIP, SIP, CTI, and ACD.
* Experience with API, CRM, and third-party integrations.
* Hands-on experience in system configuration, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to translate business needs into platform solutions.

**Good To Have Skills**

* Exposure to AI-driven support models, automation use cases, and digital deflection strategies.
* Experience with social and digital engagement platforms.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset with understanding of customer service KPIs.
* CCaaS certifications such as Genesys, Cisco, or Avaya preferred.

**Who You Are**

* A strong technical consultant with an ownership mindset.
* Able to independently manage customer outcomes and multiple engagements.
* Skilled at balancing hands-on delivery with stakeholder engagement and solution guidance.
* Customer-focused, solution-oriented, and driven by continuous improvement.

**What Success Looks Like**

* High platform adoption and improved operational performance across customer accounts.
* Strong customer retention and measurable expansion opportunities.
* Successful delivery of scalable, optimized, and well-governed CCaaS solutions.
* Recognition as a trusted advisor for day-to-day platform and service improvements.

**We focus on our mission**
: Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:
  
  

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified-CXM.
* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.

**We believe in our product**
: Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.
  
  
**We invest in our people**
: We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.
  
  
To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.
  
  
To learn more about all-things-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.
  
  
**EEO - Our philosophy**
: Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful.
  
  
Sprinklr is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.
  
  
Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter.
  
  
**Warning about Recruiting Scams:**
Please be vigilant for recruiting scams impersonating Sprinklr. Sprinklr will never ask you for money, to pay for equipment, or for unnecessary personal information during the interview process. Sprinklr will also never pay in Bitcoin or send email communications from our executives. Please review the Federal Trade Commission's advice to avoid these types of scams.
  
  
If you are contacted by someone whom you suspect may not be appropriately representing Sprinklr, please do not engage and block their email or phone number immediately.

**Who We Are**
Welcome to TELUS Digital — where innovation drives impact at a global scale. As an award-winning digital product consultancy and the digital division of TELUS, one of Canada’s largest telecommunications providers, we design and deliver transformative customer experiences through cutting-edge technology, agile thinking, and a people-first culture.
  
  
With a global team across North America, South America, Central America, Europe, Africa, and APAC, we offer end-to-end expertise across various service offerings: Web, Mobile & Digital Marketing | Enterprise AI | Customer Care AI & Technology | Enterprise Technology Modernization

Noida, India (Hybrid)
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Program Manager / Senior Manager to lead end-to-end cloud migration and modernization initiatives across multi-cloud environments — including Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS), and Microsoft Azure. In this highly visible role, you will drive large-scale transformation programs that accelerate the organization's cloud adoption, modernize legacy workloads, and deliver measurable business outcomes. You will partner closely with executive stakeholders, engineering teams, architects, and vendors to define program strategy, govern delivery, manage risk, and champion cloud-native best practices across the enterprise. This role requires a blend of technical acumen, program governance expertise, and leadership presence.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Program Leadership & Governance**

* Develop and own the end-to-end program roadmap for cloud migration and modernization, spanning GCP, AWS, and Azure environments.
* Establish and manage program governance frameworks including steering committees, status reporting, RACI structures, and decision-making processes.
* Lead cross-functional teams of architects, engineers, DevOps practitioners, and business analysts across multiple concurrent workstreams.
* Track and report on program health — scope, schedule, budget, risk, and quality — to senior leadership and C-suite stakeholders.
* Drive milestone delivery, manage dependencies, and resolve escalations to keep programs on track.

**Cloud Migration Execution**

* Define and execute migration strategies including Rehost (lift & shift), Replatform, Refactor,Repurchase, Retire, and Retain (6Rs/7Rs).
* Oversee infrastructure assessments, application portfolio rationalization, and cloud readiness evaluations.
* Coordinate migration waves, manage cutover planning, and ensure zero-downtime or minimal-disruption transitions for critical workloads.
* Manage relationships with hyperscale partners (Google, AWS, Microsoft) and third-party migration tooling vendors.
* Ensure proper implementation of cloud landing zones, networking, IAM, security controls, and compliance requirements.

**Modernization & Transformation**

* Champion cloud-native modernization initiatives including containerization(Kubernetes/GKE/EKS/AKS), microservices adoption, and serverless architectures.
* Drive application re-platforming to managed cloud services (e.g., Cloud SQL, RDS, Azure SQL, Big Query, Redshift, Synapse).
* Lead DevSecOps and CI/CD pipeline modernization to enable continuous delivery and cloud-native development practices.
* Partner with data and AI/ML teams to enable cloud-native analytics and AI workloads on GCP(Vertex AI), AWS (SageMaker), and Azure (Azure AI).

**Financial & Risk Management**

* Own program budgets ranging from $5M to $50M+, with responsibility for FinOps, cost optimization, and cloud spend visibility.
* Identify, assess, and mitigate technical, operational, and business risks throughout the program lifecycle.
* Drive business case development, ROI modeling, and benefits tracking for cloud transformation investments.

**Stakeholder Management & Change Management**

* Act as the primary program interface for senior technology and business leaders, building trust and ensuring alignment across stakeholders.
* Develop and execute organizational change management plans to drive cloud adoption and new ways of working.
* Build cloud capability and literacy across engineering and product teams through training, communities of practice, and enablement programs.

**Qualifications**

* 8+ years of program/project management experience with 5+ years directly in cloud migration or transformation programs
* Demonstrated delivery of large-scale migrations ($10M+ budgets) on at least two of: GCP, AWS, Azure
* Experience managing multi-cloud or hybrid-cloud environments with 500+ workloads or applications
* Track record of managing cross-functional teams of 20+ people across engineering, architecture, and business functions
* Experience with enterprise change management and organizational transformation
* Deep familiarity with cloud architecture patterns: IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, serverless,containers
* Understanding of networking (VPC,VPN, DirectConnect/Interconnect/ExpressRoute), IAM, and security in cloud
* Working knowledge of Kubernetes,CI/CD, Terraform/IaC, and DevOps toolchains
* Familiarity with migration tooling: AWS MGN, Google Migrate, Azure Migrate, Velostrata, CloudEndure, etc.
* Understanding of FinOps practices and cloud cost optimization levers

**About the Role**

  

This is not a conventional supply chain/operations role. We're looking for a Program Manager to own the Spares & Inventory charter end-to-end managing a ~10 Cr monthly procurement outlay and standing inventory across 14 stores/warehouses, leading a team of ~150 professionals, and negotiating with a vendor ecosystem of 400+ suppliers. The role directly impacts vehicle turnaround time, cost of quality, working-capital efficiency, and business growth, combining large-scale field operations, vendor management, inventory ownership, and data-driven decision-making — with significant ownership and direct business impact.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

**Spares Procurement & Vendor Management**

* Own end-to-end procurement strategy, driving cost optimization, quality standards, and supply reliability across the vendor ecosystem
* Build vendor evaluation frameworks and scorecards; identify and onboard new vendors to improve cost, quality, and geographic coverage

**Inventory & Working Capital Management**

* Own inventory control and health across the warehouse network — tracking ageing, stock-outs, excess/obsolete stock, and fill rates
* Drive inventory optimization to improve working-capital efficiency without compromising service levels; partner with Finance to align on targets

**Operations & Team Leadership**

* Build and lead a high-performing, multi-city field team — driving hiring, training, and performance management
* Standardize processes and SOPs across stores/warehouses to ensure consistency at scale
* Solve complex ground-level operational challenges across geographies, balancing service levels with cost and working-capital discipline

**Cross-Functional Partnership & Data-Driven Decisions**

* Partner with in-house refurbishment workshops and the external partner workshop network to ensure spares availability supports vehicle TAT
* Work with Quality and Business/Operations leadership to align sourcing strategy with cost-of-quality and growth goals
* Build dashboards to track procurement spend, inventory health, and vendor performance; drive structured, data-backed stakeholder reviews

  

**Requirements**

  

**Education**

* B.Tech from a Tier 1 college is required; MBA preferred

  

**Experience & Skills**

* Proven experience in supply chain, procurement, vendor, or inventory management, ideally at scale
* Experience managing large, distributed, multi-city teams and field operations
* Strong vendor negotiation and relationship management skills, with experience managing a large supplier base
* Strong analytical skills, with comfort using data/dashboards to drive decisions
* Excellent stakeholder management skills across operations, workshops, quality, and finance teams
* Ability to solve complex, ground-level operational problems independently and at scale

  

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in automotive, auto-ancillary, refurbishment, or vehicle servicing industries
* Experience managing spares/inventory in a high-velocity, multi-location retail or service network
* Exposure to ERP/inventory management systems and procurement analytics tools

3c181c75.title: Solution Consultant (Remote)
3c181c75.description:
RainFocus, one of the most innovative software companies, is in search of an exceptional
**Solution Consultant.**
**About RainFocus**
RainFocus cares about its employees, customers, and the world in which we live. Our rapidly growing team serves Fortune 500 companies like Adobe, Cisco, IBM, Oracle, VMware, and others to prepare and execute in-person, virtual, and hybrid events, across the world. Those events are delivered through our industry-disrupting software platform, with groundbreaking business intelligence, to elevate the attendee experience, streamline event operations, and accelerate marketing results. We are well-funded, growing fast, and building a company that is changing the market — it will be challenging, fun and exciting.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a team member of the RainFocus Client Success organization, the Solution Consultant (“SC”) is critical to driving post-sale client implementations at RainFocus. As a member of a team, the SC is responsible for working alongside Solution Architect to consult on platform configuration best practices, drive requirements, design and configure solutions and educate our clients on the implemented RainFocus toolset.
  
  
We need collaborative, energetic team members who are capable of becoming experts in RainFocus products, industry best practices, and who work well within small, focused teams. Solution Consultants are thought leaders within the Client Success organization and often assume additional responsibilities to mentor, train and build the consulting skill set with their peers.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Technical**

* Become an expert in RainFocus platform
* Train client admins on the RainFocus tools and processes as necessary
* Configure the RainFocus platform

**Analysis / Business Acumen**

* Work with clients to identify business requirements and workflows
* Facilitate holistic system design and architecture workshops
* Identify platform configuration requirements
* Identify and mitigate risks to achieve implementation success

**Domain / Industry Knowledge**

* Follow best practices for implementing RainFocus products
* Consult with clients on new ideas and best practices

**Communication**

* Document requirements, solution designs and testing plans
* Provide regular updates on milestones and tasks to project managers
* Provide project managers with level of effort estimates
* Communicate issues and risks to project managers and leadership
* Leads solution project calls and demos with clients

**Organization**

* Balance priorities across multiple assignments
* Thoroughly track tasks and complete all assignments on time
* Contribute to implementation tools, processes and templates

**Qualifications**

* Software implementation experience (2-7+ years for Solution Consultants; 7+ years for Sr. Solution Consultants)
* SaaS solutions delivery through platform configuration, not custom development
* Experience implementing SaaS platforms for Enterprise level clients, including gathering and documenting complex requirements, configurations, and integrations
* Proven success in creating efficiencies through process design, including outlining and measuring adoption, both internal and client-facing
* Ability to think strategically to ensure solution supports business goals
* Proven track record in delivering innovative and creative solutions
* Ability to work independently, problem-solve, improvise
* Perform consistently under pressure
* Superior communication skills, both written and verbal
* Team players only
* HTML, CSS, SQL, JSON optional but preferred
* Must be able to travel domestically or internationally up to 20%

**Personal Characteristics**

* The best candidates for this position will need to have strong chemistry and a culture fit within RainFocus. They will need to be comfortable working in a fast-paced, challenging, and dynamic environment. Additional personal qualities include:
* Ability to creatively solve complex problems
* Friendly and outgoing, but assertive when necessary
* Willing to go the extra mile in support of reasonable client requests
* Team-player with a service-oriented mindset
* Self-motivated, thrives in fast-paced environments
* Proactive, relentless learner
* Excited by and eager to take on new challenges and opportunities
* Strong communicator with ability to be self-guided
* Embraces change

**Why work at RainFocus?**
At RainFocus we delight millions of attendees at large-scale events by delivering better insights, experiences, and marketing. We were able to pivot our product and services offering in 2020 to continue growing and serving new clients and events.
  
  
As a member of the RainFocus team, you will have the opportunity to experience first-hand the impact of our platform at events around the world. Additionally, RainFocus offers competitive salaries, competitive benefits, 401k, generous PTO, and countless other team building activities.
  
  
What are you waiting for? Apply today!
*We need more talented, hard-working, fun-loving team members just like yourself!*
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

7fbce6f9.description:
**Project Role :** Technology Architect  
**Project Role Description :** Design and deliver technology architecture for a platform, product, or engagement. Define solutions to meet performance, capability, and scalability needs.
  
**Must have skills :** Nvidia Omniverse  
**Good to have skills :** Unity Programming  
Minimum **12** year(s) of experience is required  
**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  
  
Summary:  
We are looking for an experienced NVIDIA Omniverse Application Architect to lead the design and implementation of next-generation Digital Twin, Industrial Metaverse, Physical AI, and 3D simulation solutions using the NVIDIA Omniverse platform. The ideal candidate will provide technical leadership, define solution architecture, collaborate with business stakeholders, and drive innovation across manufacturing, industrial automation, robotics, smart factory and smart city initiatives.  
  
Role and Responsibilities:  
Lead architecture, design, and implementation of enterprise solutions built on NVIDIA Omniverse.
  
Define end-to-end solution architecture for Digital Twin, Industrial AI, Virtual Commissioning, Smart City Simulation, Factory Simulation, and 3D visualization use cases.
  
Collaborate with client stakeholders to understand business challenges and translate them into scalable technical solutions.  
Design integration strategies between Omniverse and enterprise applications such as MES, SCADA, DES, PLM, Robotics and IoT platforms.  
Develop reusable architecture patterns, best practices, and reference implementations.
  
Lead technical workshops, architecture reviews, proof-of-concepts (PoCs), and client demonstrations.
  
Provide technical leadership to development teams and mentor engineers on Omniverse technologies and best practices.
  
Work closely with AI, Cloud, Data, and Visualization teams to deliver integrated Physical AI solutions.
  
Support solution estimation, proposal development, RFIs/RFPs, and client presentations.
  
Evaluate emerging NVIDIA technologies and recommend adoption strategies.  
Technical Skills & Professional Skills:  
Strong experience with NVIDIA Omniverse Platform – OV Kit SDK, OV Extensions, Nucleus, Isaac SIM, OV RTX Rendering, etc.  
Strong understanding of Digital Twins, Industrial Metaverse, Physical AI, Real-time 3D visualization and Simulation platform.  
Experience in Python, C++, REST APIs, Microservices
  
Experience in any one of the Cloud Architecture (Azure, AWS or GCP).  
Strong knowledge of Application Architecture, Distributed Systems, Solution Design, SDLC and Agile methodologies.  
Excellent stakeholder management and client-facing communication  
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills  
Experience leading distributed global teams  
Ability to influence technical decisions across multiple teams  
Strong mentoring and coaching capabilities  
  
Additional Information:  
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline.
  
12+ years of overall IT experience, including significant experience in solution/application architecture.
  
Hands-on experience with NVIDIA Omniverse implementations is mandatory.  
This position is based at our Bengaluru office.  
Willingness to travel internationally based on project requirements.
  
Candidates holding a valid Saudi Arabia work visa or having prior project experience in Saudi Arabia/Middle East will be considered an added advantage.
  
Preferred Certifications: NVIDIA Omniverse Certified Professional, NVIDIA Deep Learning Institute (DLI) Certifications, Cloud Certifications (Azure, AWS, or GCP), TOGAF or equivalent Architecture Certification

  
15 years full time education

57929c78.title: Technology Architect
57929c78.description:
**Project Role :** Technology Architect  
**Project Role Description :** Design and deliver technology architecture for a platform, product, or engagement. Define solutions to meet performance, capability, and scalability needs.
  
**Must have skills :** 3D Modeling  
**Good to have skills :** NA  
Minimum **12** year(s) of experience is required  
**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  
  
Summary:  
We are seeking a visionary and technically accomplished Manager – 3D to lead our reality-capture and digital twin production pipeline in support of engineering and supply chain initiatives. This senior leadership position demands a rare combination of deep hands-on 3D artistry, mastery of reality-capture workflows, fluency in digital twin/simulation platforms, expertise in XR (AR/VR/MR) development, and a proven ability to lead high-performing teams delivering high-fidelity, real-world-accurate 3D environments and simulations.  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:  
Lead, mentor, and scale a multidisciplinary team of 3D artists, technical artists, scan technicians, XR developers, and digital twin specialists  
Own the full lifecycle of digital twin and XR production — from site/asset capture to final validated 3D model to immersive deployment — establishing production pipelines, quality benchmarks, review cycles, and resource planning  
Plan, allocate, and track resources across multiple concurrent engineering, supply chain, and XR digital twin projects, ensuring on-time delivery  
Manage production schedules, sprints, or agile workflows across capture, modeling, integration, and XR development phases  
Direct the planning and execution of 3D laser scanning, LiDAR, and photogrammetry capture for facilities, equipment, and industrial assets  
Set and uphold standards for point cloud processing, mesh reconstruction, registration accuracy, and scan-to-BIM/CAD workflows  
Guide selection and use of reality-capture hardware and software  
Drive development of high-fidelity Digital Twin environments using platforms such as NVIDIA Omniverse (USD workflows, Omniverse Create, Isaac Sim as applicable)  
Lead development of XR (AR/VR/MR) experiences and applications for training, remote collaboration, design review, and operational visualization using platforms such as Unreal Engine, Unity, or enterprise XR toolkits  
Guide deployment of digital twin and XR content across headsets and other immersive/AR-enabled devices as applicable  
Ensure accurate real-world-to-virtual asset fidelity for industrial, manufacturing, and supply chain digital twin and XR use cases  
Collaborate with engineering, IoT, and simulation teams to integrate live sensor/operational data into 3D/digital twin/XR environments for real-time monitoring and simulation  
Support data-driven visualization of supply chain flows, factory layouts, and asset performance within digital twin and XR environments  
Provide expert-level, hands-on guidance on asset creation, cleanup, retopology, and optimization using Autodesk Maya, 3ds Max, and Blender  
Oversee modeling, texturing, UV layout, and rendering of scan-derived and CAD-derived assets for visualization, simulation, and XR deployment  
Review and approve high-fidelity 3D assets, ensuring dimensional accuracy, consistency, and technical specification alignment with source capture data  
Guide optimization of scan-heavy and CAD-heavy assets for real-time engines, simulation environments, and XR platforms without loss of engineering-relevant detail (frame-rate and performance requirements for headset deployment)  
Partner with Engineering, Supply Chain, and Operations stakeholders to align digital twin and XR deliverables with plant, facility, and logistics planning needs  
Continuously evaluate and improve capture-to-twin and capture-to-XR pipelines, tools, and workflows conduct detailed reviews and stay ahead of industry advancements in reality capture, simulation, and XR/immersive technology  
  
Professional & Technical Skills:  
12+ years of professional experience in 3D art/visualization production, with significant experience in reality capture, photogrammetry, digital twin, or XR (AR/VR/MR) development for engineering, manufacturing, or supply chain environments  
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Fine Arts, Animation, Industrial Design, Engineering, or a related discipline (or equivalent professional experience)  
Expert-level, hands-on proficiency (not just familiarity) with:
  
o Blender  
o Autodesk Maya  
o Autodesk 3ds Max  
Substantial hands-on experience with 3D scanning, photogrammetry, and reality capture workflows — from field capture through point cloud/mesh processing to final asset delivery  
Practical experience with Digital Twin development and platforms (e.g., NVIDIA Omniverse, USD pipelines)  
Hands-on experience developing and deploying XR (AR/VR/MR) applications and experiences, including familiarity with XR and XR-specific interaction/UX design considerations  
Familiarity with CAD/BIM ecosystems (e.g., AutoCAD, Revit, SolidWorks, Navisworks) and scan-to-BIM/CAD workflows  
Proficiency with real-time and simulation/XR platforms (e.g., Unity, Unreal Engine, Unity Reflect, Twinmotion, or proprietary enterprise visualization/XR tools)  
Proficiency with texturing and material authoring tools such as Substance Painter, Substance Designer, or Mari, and Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Substance 3D, After Effects)  
Proven track record managing and leading teams of 5+ artists/technicians, with direct accountability for project scoping, scheduling, resource allocation, and on-time delivery  
Strong portfolio/reel demonstrating scan-to-model, digital twin, and/or XR project outcomes, including examples relevant to industrial, engineering, or supply chain contexts  
Deep, practical understanding of modeling, UV layout, PBR texturing, retopology, lighting, and rendering pipelines, particularly for CAD- and scan-derived data  
Experience optimizing large, dense scan/CAD assets for real-time engines and XR/headset deployment (e.g., Unreal Engine or Unity)  
  
Additional Information:  
Background in game development or real-time 3D environments (Unity, Unreal).  
Autodesk Certified Professional – Maya or 3ds Max  
NVIDIA Omniverse Certification (or NVIDIA Deep Learning Institute courses on Omniverse/USD)  
Unity Certified Professional: Artist / 3D Artist, or Unreal Engine Certification  
Adobe Certified Professional – Photoshop / Substance 3D  
Familiarity with real-time rendering engines and game engine integration for simulation and XR use cases  
Basic scripting knowledge (Python, C#, or relevant programming language)  
This position is based at our Bengaluru office.  
A 15 years full-time education is required.

  
15 years full time education

0a536d51.title: Senior Solution Architect, Generative AI - CSP
0a536d51.description:
NVIDIA’s Solution Architect team is looking for a AI-focused Solution Architect with expertise in Large Language Model, generative AI, agentic AI. We work with the most exciting computing hardware and software, driving the latest breakthroughs in artificial intelligence. We need individuals who can enable customer productivity and develop lasting relationships with our technology partners, making NVIDIA an integral part of end-user solutions. We are looking for someone always thinking about artificial intelligence, someone who can maintain constructive collaboration in a fast paced, rapidly evolving field, someone able to coordinate efforts between corporate marketing, industry business development and engineering. You will be working with the latest AI architecture coupled with the most advanced neural network models, changing the way people interact with technology.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**

* Architect end-to-end generative AI solutions with a focus on LLMs training , deployment and RAG workflows.
* Collaborate closely with customers to understand their language-related business challenges and design tailored solutions.
* Work closely with NVIDIA engineering teams to provide feedback and contribute to the evolution of generative AI software.
* Engage directly with customers/partners to understand their requirements and challenges.
* Lead workshops and design sessions to define and refine generative AI solutions focused on LLMs and RAG workflows and lead the training and optimization of Large Language Models using NVIDIA’s hardware and software platforms.
* Implement strategies for efficient and effective training of LLMs to achieve optimal performance.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance on best practices for training LLMs and implementing RAG-based solutions.

**What We Need To See**

* Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or equivalent experience
* 7+ years of hands-on experience in a technical AI role, specifically focusing on generative AI, with a strong emphasis on training Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Proven track record of successfully deploying and optimizing LLM models for inference in production environments.
* Expertise in training and fine-tuning LLMs using popular frameworks such as Megatron-LM, Megatron-Bridge, AutoModel and PyTorch.
* Proficiency in model deployment and optimization techniques for efficient inference on various hardware platforms, with a focus on GPUs.
* Strong knowledge of GPU cluster architecture and the ability to leverage parallel processing for accelerated model training and inference.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience leading workshops, training sessions, and presenting technical solutions to diverse audiences.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Experience in deploying LLM models in cloud environments (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and on-premises infrastructure.
* Proven ability to optimize LLM models for inference speed, memory efficiency, and resource utilization.
* Familiarity with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker) and orchestration tools (e.g., Kubernetes) for scalable and efficient model deployment.
* Deep understanding of GPU cluster architecture, parallel computing, and distributed computing concepts.
* Hands-on experience with NVIDIA GPU technologies, and GPU cluster management and ability to design and implement scalable and efficient workflows for LLM training and inference on GPU clusters

b26e0cd5.title: SAP_Senior Domain Architect- Presales
b26e0cd5.description:
Job Location: Bangalore
  
  
Location Flexibility: Multiple Locations in Country
  
  
Req Id: 12422
  
  
Posting Start Date: 9/25/26
  
  
SAP BASIS & S/4HANA Presales
  
  
Role Snapshot
  
  
**Experience**
10–15 years in SAP BASIS and HANA, including presales or solution architecture experience.
  
  
**Core focus**
SAP ERP and S/4HANA architecture, conversion, migration, cloud, sizing, operations, resilience, and managed services.
  
  
**Platforms**
Azure, AWS, GCP, on-premises, and hybrid SAP environments.
  
  
**Key landscape**
S/4HANA, ECC, BW/4HANA, Fiori, HANA, Solution Manager, SAP cloud technologies, and integrated applications.
  
  
**Job Summary**
Lead end-to-end SAP BASIS and S/4HANA technical presales, shaping secure, scalable, resilient, and commercially viable architecture across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid landscapes.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Own technical presales from discovery and landscape assessment through architecture, sizing, estimation, proposal, client presentation, bid defense, negotiation support, and delivery handover.
* Design SAP ERP and S/4HANA target architectures, transformation of roadmaps, implementation and conversion approaches, and cloud or hybrid operating models.
* Lead S/4HANA readiness, system conversion, OS/DB migration, homogeneous and heterogeneous migration, DMO, installation, upgrade, patching, system copy, and cutover planning.
* Create SAP landscape and infrastructure designs covering compute, HANA sizing, network, storage, security, access, backup and recovery, high availability, disaster recovery, monitoring, and performance optimization.
* Shape SAP workloads on Azure, AWS, and GCP, including migration strategy, resilience, platform operations, and cost-conscious architecture decisions.
* Provide architecture guidance across S/4HANA, ECC, BW/4HANA, Fiori, HANA, Solution Manager, SAP cloud technologies, and application or data integration.
* Define SAP BASIS managed-services solutions including L2/L3 support, platform administration, service governance, automation, DevOps, observability, continuous improvement, and operational readiness.
* Develop technical solution artifacts, assumptions, dependencies, risks, effort estimates, staffing inputs, migration waves, service descriptions, and statement-of-work content.
* Support deal governance, and strengthen reusable standards, reference architectures, accelerators, and knowledge assets.

**Essential Skills**

* Deep SAP BASIS, HANA, NetWeaver, Solution Manager, and S/4HANA technical architecture expertise.
* Practical experience in SAP implementation, conversion, migration, upgrades, cloud hosting, sizing, HA/DR, backup and recovery, monitoring, and performance engineering.
* Understanding operating systems, databases, networks, storage, cloud infrastructure, security, integration, and SAP DevOps toolchains.
* Strong presales capability in solution storytelling, estimation, RFP responses, architecture documentation, customer workshops, executive presentations, and technical negotiation.
* Ability to convert complex technical findings into pragmatic roadmaps, clear options, measurable outcomes, controlled risks, and executable delivery plans.

**Qualifications & Attributes**

* Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Minimum one end-to-end S/4HANA conversion or major SAP transformation; relevant conversion, HANA, cloud, or migration certification is preferred.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, documentation, communication, customer engagement, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Self-directed, quality focused, collaborative, and able to lead cross-functional teams with limited supervision.
* Strong customer service orientation with commitment to service quality, continuous improvement, mentoring, and knowledge sharing.

**Soft Skills & Success Measures**

* Excellent written, oral, presentation, facilitation, and executive stakeholder-management skills.
