4f931939.title: Infra & AI Architect
4f931939.description:
**Overview**

Microsoft Industry Solutions Delivery is a global organization hosting over 6,000 strategic sellers, industry and security experts, elite engineers, world-class data scientists and architects, consultants, and delivery specialists. Together with our partners, we help Microsoft’s most strategic customers worldwide to address their specific challenges and provide comprehensive and industry-specific solutions that meet their unique needs.  
  
Our organization is at the forefront of innovation, driving value across the entirety of the customers’ digital and AI transformation journey through repeatable and customized cutting-edge solutions powered by Microsoft Cloud and AI. We take pride in embodying Microsoft's mission of empowerment, promoting a growth mindset, inspiring excellence, and fostering a culture of inclusivity where everyone is encouraged to share their unique perspectives and be their authentic selves. By joining our team, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to life-changing innovations that impact billions of people worldwide.

The Infrastructure & AI Architect is responsible for designing secure, scalable, resilient, and AI-ready enterprise platforms on Microsoft Azure.  
  
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**

The architect works with customers, engineering teams, security teams, and delivery stakeholders to translate business and technical requirements into practical Azure architectures. The role combines strong Azure infrastructure architecture with modern AI platform, security, governance, automation, and operational design capabilities.

The architect is expected to provide technical leadership from discovery and architecture through implementation, governance, and operational readiness.

 **Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 14+ years experience in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting, and/or technology domain of Infra & AI.

o OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 14+ years experience in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting, and/or technology domain (e.g., Security)

Azure Infrastructure Architecture

* Design enterprise-scale Azure architectures using Azure Landing Zones and cloud adoption principles.

* Define subscription, management group, resource organization, naming, tagging, and governance models.

* Design hub-and-spoke and Virtual WAN architectures.

* Architect hybrid connectivity using ExpressRoute, VPN, Azure Virtual WAN, and private connectivity.

* Design Azure networking including VNets, subnets, routing, NSGs, Azure Firewall, Application Gateway, load balancers, NAT Gateway, Private Link, and Private Endpoints.

* Define scalable DNS and private DNS architecture.

* Design resilient solutions across Availability Zones and Azure regions.

* Define business continuity, disaster recovery, backup, and high-availability strategies.

Identity, Security & Governance

* Design identity architectures using Microsoft Entra ID.

* Define managed identity, workload identity, role-based access control, privileged access, and least-privilege models.

* Implement security architecture using Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, Azure Policy, Key Vault, encryption, and customer-managed keys.

* Design secure administrative and privileged-access patterns.

* Define network segmentation and Zero Trust architecture.

* Ensure architecture aligns with enterprise security, regulatory, data sovereignty, and compliance requirements.

Observability & Operations

* Design centralized and distributed monitoring architectures using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, and Microsoft Sentinel.

* Define logging, monitoring, alerting, operational dashboards, and telemetry strategies.

* Design infrastructure that supports SRE and modern cloud operations.

* Define operational readiness, service health, capacity management, incident response, and troubleshooting approaches.

* Drive infrastructure automation and configuration consistency.

AI & AI-Ready Infrastructure

* Design secure enterprise AI platforms using Microsoft Foundry/Azure AI services and supporting Azure capabilities.

* Define networking, identity, compute, storage, data, security, and monitoring requirements for enterprise AI workloads.

* Design private and controlled access patterns for AI environments.

* Architect solutions supporting:

* Generative AI

* AI agents

* Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

* Enterprise search

* Vector and semantic search

* Embeddings

* Model endpoints and AI services

* Define secure connectivity between AI applications, enterprise data sources, APIs, and business systems.

* Establish AI platform governance, responsible AI, security, monitoring, and operational controls.

* Support integration of AI solutions with the broader Microsoft cloud ecosystem.

Automation & Platform Engineering

* Drive Infrastructure as Code using Bicep, ARM templates and/or Terraform.

* Define reusable architecture patterns, templates, and platform components.

* Support CI/CD and DevOps-based infrastructure deployment.

* Promote policy-driven governance and automated environment provisioning.

* Design self-service platform capabilities where appropriate.

Architecture Leadership

* Lead customer architecture and technical design workshops.

* Gather functional and non-functional requirements.

* Develop High-Level Designs and detailed technical designs.

* Produce architecture diagrams, decision documents, implementation guidance, and design standards.

* Conduct architecture reviews and identify technical risks and dependencies.

* Provide technical direction to engineering and implementation teams.

* Troubleshoot complex architecture, networking, identity, security, and platform issues.

* Conduct design reviews and ensure implementation remains aligned to the approved architecture.

Customer & Stakeholder Engagement

* Act as a trusted technical advisor to customer architects and technology leadership.

* Explain complex cloud and AI concepts in clear business language.

* Present architecture options, trade-offs, risks, costs, and recommendations.

* Collaborate with application, security, network, data, AI, governance, and operations teams.

* Help customers establish cloud and AI adoption roadmaps.

* Support solution estimation, implementation planning, risk management, and technical governance.

Required Technical Skills

Azure Infrastructure

* Azure Landing Zones

* Hub-and-Spoke / Virtual WAN

* Azure networking and routing

* ExpressRoute and VPN

* Azure Firewall

* Application Gateway / WAF

* Private Link / Private Endpoints

* Azure DNS / Private DNS

* Azure Load Balancer

* Azure compute and storage

* Availability Zones and multi-region architecture

* Backup and disaster recovery

Identity & Security

* Microsoft Entra ID

* Azure role-based access control

* Managed identities

* Key Vault

* Customer-managed keys

* Azure Policy

* Defender for Cloud

* Microsoft Sentinel

* Zero Trust security principles

AI

* Microsoft Foundry / Azure AI

* Generative AI architecture

* AI agents

* RAG architecture

* AI Search

* Vector and semantic search

* Model integration

* Prompt and AI security

* Responsible AI

* AI monitoring and governance

Monitoring & Operations

* Azure Monitor

* Log Analytics

* Application Insights

* Microsoft Sentinel

* Cloud operational models and SRE concepts

Automation

* Bicep / ARM

* Terraform

* Azure DevOps / GitHub

* CI/CD

* PowerShell / Azure CLI

Architecture Competencies

The successful candidate should demonstrate the ability to:

* Convert business requirements into end-to-end Azure architecture.

* Make architecture decisions across infrastructure, networking, security, identity, data, operations, and AI.

* Evaluate multiple technical approaches and clearly explain trade-offs.

* Design for security, reliability, scalability, performance, manageability, and cost.

* Lead complex enterprise architecture discussions involving multiple technology domains.

* Balance Microsoft platform capabilities with customer constraints and existing enterprise environments.

* Move comfortably between whiteboard architecture, detailed technical design, and implementation troubleshooting.

  
  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process**.**

711d1b38.title: EY - GDS Consulting - AI And DATA -AI Data Platform Architect/Lead - Manager
711d1b38.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Consulting - Data and Analytics - AWS Data Platform Architect / Engineering Manager - / Manager / Lead Architect**
EY's Consulting Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY's financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY's Consulting Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalise on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client's decision-making.
  
  
**Role**
**AWS Data Platform Architect / Engineering Manager - Experience Guide**

* Guide / 10+ years Primary Skill Area
* AWS Data Platforms, APIs, SageMaker, Data Security, Data SRE & Agentic Operations

**The opportunity**
Provide architecture leadership, platform ownership and delivery governance for enterprise-scale AWS Data & AI platforms. The role is responsible for shaping AWS data platform strategy, leading modernisation and migration programmes, defining reusable engineering standards, integrating APIs and enterprise services, establishing Git/CI-CD practices, embedding Data SRE, strengthening data security and enabling agentic/AI-assisted operations across AWS-native data platforms.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* AWS strategy, architecture and platform ownership
* Serve as design authority for AWS data platform initiatives across multiple domains, programmes and enterprise data products.
* Define target-state architecture using AWS Glue, Amazon S3, Athena, Redshift, EMR, MWAA/Airflow, Step Functions, Lambda, EventBridge, CloudWatch, Lake Formation and lakehouse patterns.
* Own architecture decisions for scalability, resilience, security, governance, observability, performance, maintainability, FinOps and production readiness.
* Create platform standards, reference architectures, reusable frameworks, migration playbooks and engineering governance for AWS data platforms.

**APIs, service integration and AWS platform connectivity**

* Lead API-led and service-based integration patterns across source systems, enterprise applications, SaaS platforms, data catalogues, governance tools, messaging services and downstream analytics/AI consumers.
* Define standards for REST APIs, event-driven ingestion, CDC, streaming, file ingestion, database integration, authentication, retries, error handling and dependency monitoring.
* Integrate AWS data platforms with enterprise services such as IAM, secrets management, network controls, monitoring, ticketing, metadata, lineage, access workflows and DevOps tools.
* Drive reusable integration frameworks using API Gateway, Lambda, EventBridge, Step Functions, Glue, EMR, MWAA, Kinesis and managed event-driven patterns where appropriate.

**Git connectivity, DevSecOps and platform automation**

* Establish Git connectivity across code repositories, branching strategy, pull requests, code reviews, release controls, artefact versioning and environment promotion.
* Lead CI/CD and Infrastructure-as-Code adoption using GitHub, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, Terraform/OpenTofu, CloudFormation and policy-as-code practices.
* Define automated testing, code scanning, dependency scanning, secrets management, configuration management, deployment validation and production release documentation standards.
* Promote automation for environment setup, monitoring, reconciliation, deployment validation, compliance evidence and support handover.

**Data security, Immuta and governed AWS access**

* Drive AWS security practices including IAM least privilege, KMS encryption, Secrets Manager, VPC endpoints, CloudTrail, logging, controlled data handling and audit-ready access patterns.
* Define governed access models using AWS Lake Formation, Glue Data Catalog, Macie, Immuta, Microsoft Purview, Collibra and enterprise IAM/access workflow tools as relevant.
* Implement controls for RBAC/ABAC, dynamic masking, row/column-level access, data classification, lineage, data residency, privacy and policy enforcement.
* Partner with cyber, privacy, risk, infrastructure and architecture teams to ensure AWS platform designs are secure, compliant and production-ready.

**Data SRE, observability and production operations**

* Establish Data SRE practices for AWS data pipelines, lakehouse services, orchestration, ML/AI workloads and platform operations.
* Define observability dashboards covering Glue/EMR/MWAA job health, data freshness, data quality, SLA/SLO, cost, capacity, access activity, incident trends and dependency failures.
* Act as escalation point for complex production issues, root-cause analysis, recurring incident elimination, performance tuning and long-term platform improvement.
* Drive restartability, retry logic, alert rationalisation, runbooks, service transition, support operating model and operational continuity.

**SageMaker, AI integration and agentic AWS operations**

* Integrate AWS data platforms with Amazon SageMaker for data preparation, feature engineering, model training, deployment, model monitoring, MLOps and inference-ready data products.
* Support AI/GenAI workloads using SageMaker, Bedrock where relevant, vector databases, knowledge bases, RAG, GraphRAG, model evaluation and enterprise AI governance patterns.
* Drive agentic and AI-assisted operations for metadata discovery, mapping, lineage, data quality rule generation, anomaly detection, failure diagnosis, automated remediation and self-healing workflows.
* Ensure AI-enabled AWS data solutions remain secure, governed, explainable, observable and aligned with enterprise risk controls.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Skill / capability area - Details**

* Core AWS platform - AWS Glue, Amazon S3, Athena, Redshift, EMR, MWAA/Airflow, Step Functions, Lambda, EventBridge, Kinesis, CloudWatch, Lake Formation.
* APIs and integration - REST APIs, API Gateway, Lambda integration, event-driven architecture, CDC, streaming, enterprise applications, workflow tools, downstream analytics and AI consumers.
* Git, DevSecOps and IaC -GitHub, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, Git connectivity, CI/CD, Terraform/OpenTofu, CloudFormation, policy-as-code, automated testing, deployment validation.
* Governance and security -- IAM, KMS, Secrets Manager, Lake Formation, Glue Data Catalog, Macie, CloudTrail, Immuta, Purview, Collibra, RBAC/ABAC, masking, lineage, audit.
* Reliability and operations - Data SRE, CloudWatch observability, SLA/SLO, incident management, root-cause analysis, runbooks, restartability, FinOps, capacity and cost governance.
* AI and agentic engineering - Amazon SageMaker, SageMaker Pipelines, Feature Store, Model Registry, Model Monitor, Bedrock, RAG, GraphRAG, vector databases, Agentic AI, LLMOps, AI governance.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Relevant experience guide: Guide / 10+ years
* 10+ years in data engineering, cloud data platforms, AI platforms, platform engineering, enterprise architecture or delivery leadership.
* Strong hands-on understanding of platform architecture, APIs, enterprise integration, Git/CI-CD, data security, governance, SRE operations and AI/agentic engineering.
* Preferred certifications aligned to cloud architecture, data engineering, DevOps, security, AI/ML, governance and platform-specific technologies.

**Ideally, you'll also have**

* Acts as trusted advisor to senior stakeholders while staying credible in architecture and engineering discussions.
* Balances strategy, delivery governance, team leadership, platform operations and hands-on technology judgement.
* Comfortable building future-ready autonomous data engineering capability and mentoring teams through emerging AI-native practices.

**What We Look For**

* Acts as trusted advisor to senior stakeholders while staying credible in architecture and engineering discussions.
* Balances strategy, delivery governance, team leadership, platform operations and hands-on technology judgement.
* Comfortable building future-ready autonomous data engineering capability and mentoring teams through emerging AI-native practices.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we're dedicated to helping our clients, from start-ups to Fortune 500 companies, and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasises high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that's right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

3c69bf5b.title: Global IT Solution Architect Expert Senior Manager
3c69bf5b.description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
The hands-on Solution Architect is responsible for the architecture, design, and delivery of cohesive technical solutions across BCG business, primarily focusing on implementation of new solutions, solution enhancements, and system/data integration. The Solution Architect likely will be aligned with one or more business area, such that they can develop a thorough understanding of the business and drive consistency and integration across solutions for that business area. They will also maintain awareness of emerging technologies relevant to their areas of expertise and responsibility.
  
  
The successful candidate will be a highly motivated strategic thinker, engaging collaborator, and effective influencer. Key objectives of the role are to drive digital transformation and the strategic and tactical use of technology to deliver business capabilities, while the organization with cutting edge technologies in a high paced environment. Critical to the Solution Architect’s success is their ability to drive projects and teams to deliver results for the business, balanced with adherence to standards and processes. They will coordinate and provide oversight to the solution/technical leads of multiple development squads.
  
  
The Solution Architect will also facilitate cross-enterprise coordination, ensuring that we accommodate requirements across the business and address system integration needs for solutions. They will collaborate with multi-disciplinary architects and engineers across the Technology organization and within the business to develop strategy, technology roadmaps, and technical standards. They will also work as an interface point with strategic partners, determining where they may offer value to business partners and facilitating coordination on joint initiatives.
  
  

* Architect and deliver GenAI solutions (copilots, workflow automation, knowledge assistants) from prototype to production.
* Use AI-assisted engineering tools (e.g., Claude code, Cursor, equivalents) to accelerate delivery with strong quality/security.
* Design and scale agentic systems; define standards for agent development, orchestration, deployment, and monitoring.
* Establish reusable MCP patterns/services for consistent tool integration, governance, and lifecycle management.
* Define patterns for enterprise scaling (access control, guardrails, evaluation, observability, cost/latency, reliability).
* Build production-viable prototypes for emerging tech (incl. GenAI/agents) and validate feasibility, security, operability, and scale.
* Interpret business needs and requirements and design/develop technical solutions to deliver the desired business capabilities.
* Collaborate with Enterprise Architects and other Solution Architects and engineers to architect and design technical solutions that are aligned with enterprise technology standards and strategy, while also working to help develop and grow those standards and roadmaps.
* Work across multiple systems/solutions to ensure their consistency and alignment, as well as to determine how multiple systems/solutions can work together to serve a particular line of business and/or to ensure that a solution works across lines of business.
* Leverage experience and expertise across a wide variety of technology domains, including infrastructure, data management, systems integration, and application development, with a recent emphasis on technologies leveraged by BCG, such as FiveTrans, MuleSoft APIs, Infomatica, AWS, Azure, and SnowFlake.
* Employ and enforce system/solution develop processes, agile methodologies, DevOps principles and practices, and quality engineering best practices.
* Exercise concepts and best practices for designing system reliability/resilience, performance/scalability and maintainability/operability.
* Provide technical oversight to multiple project teams to ensure compliance with processes and standards. Ensure that solutions/systems developed in support of the business are aligned with BCG Enterprise Architecture, technical standards, and technology roadmaps.
* Organize Architecture and Design Reviews to ensure wider architecture peer group input is sought for robust design
* Conduct proof of concept exercises for emerging solutions and prove out potential enhancements to the design
* Ensure designs are implemented with target architecture and key design decisions are clearly communicated to leadership and all key stakeholders
* Review and consider prospective changes to the baseline solution that have been raised by process owners, projects, production support, continuous improvement initiatives and the business for architectural impact

What You'll Bring
  
  
**Essential Education**

* Master’s Degree in Computer Science
* 14 years of work experience + 10 years of experience designing and implementing business critical applications in multi-region environments +1 year of deep exposure to LLM based business applications

**Essential Experience & Job Requirements**

* Minimum of 7 years of experience as a software developer, preferably in multitenant/SaaS projects
* Work experience as a Solutions Architect in at least one project
* Demonstrated hands-on Solution Architect experience; able to build reference implementations and unblock teams.
* Strong experience with AI coding assistants (Claude, Cursor, equivalents) and safe enterprise usage.
* Familiarity with GenAI dev platforms (e.g., AI Studio, Replit, Devin, equivalents) for rapid prototyping.
* Deep expertise in agent patterns (RAG, tool use, planning, memory, guardrails, HITL) and production operations.
* Experience with agent orchestration/deployment (CI/CD, runtime, monitoring, incident response).
* Experience building/managing MCP ecosystems (registry, access, versioning, performance/cost controls).
* Critical thinking and analytical skills to address complex technical challenges
* Experience in conducting technical assessments and feasibility studies
* Advanced Expertise in major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
* Knowledge of cloud-native technologies and practices
* Proficiency in multiple programming languages (Python, Typescript)
* Understanding of software development lifecycles and methodologies
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and practices
* Knowledge of containerization and orchestration (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes)
* Knowledge of distributed systems concepts
* Knowledge of current technical landscape and emerging trends
* Ability to document business processes and system architectures
* Experience with one or more application development languages and/or system integration platforms
* Knowledge of and exposure to Azure and AWS application services, including serverless solutions.
* Excellent collaboration skills, evidence of building highly effective partnerships with projects, vendors, peer architects, security teams and operational Service lines and engagement with senior stakeholders
* Provide technical coaching and mentoring, actively keeps current with developments
* Ability to work simultaneously on multiple projects, at times with conflicting priorities with a strong track record of delivery
* Ability to estimate tasks and workload to achieve deliverables and goals, delivering on time and on estimation
* Ability to work with multiple external teams and accomplish shared goals
* Demonstrated ability to constantly learn outside of a classroom environment, and successfully apply learnings
* Experience with relational and NoSQL databases
* Understanding of data modeling and data integration patterns
* Experience with various architectural patterns and styles (e.g. microservices, event-driven, layered)
* Enthusiastic, high-energy individual; self-motivated and self-directed
* Advanced understanding of LLM concepts (agents, vector db, graph db, RAG, MoE, guardrails, HITL, RFHL), frameworks (llamaindex, unstructured, etc)
* Capacity to learn new and emerging technologies

Who You'll Work With
  
  

* Global functional tribe technical leaders (Finance, HR, Marketing, Legal, Risk, IT), product owners, functional area teams across levels
* Global Data Tribe Management & teams (Enterprise Data Model, Data Catalog, Master Data Management)
* Consulting and internal Data Tribe teams across BCG

Summary:  
We are seeking a visionary and technically accomplished Manager – 3D to lead our reality-capture and digital twin production pipeline in support of engineering and supply chain initiatives. This senior leadership position demands a rare combination of deep hands-on 3D artistry, mastery of reality-capture workflows, fluency in digital twin/simulation platforms, expertise in XR (AR/VR/MR) development, and a proven ability to lead high-performing teams delivering high-fidelity, real-world-accurate 3D environments and simulations.  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:  
Lead, mentor, and scale a multidisciplinary team of 3D artists, technical artists, scan technicians, XR developers, and digital twin specialists  
Own the full lifecycle of digital twin and XR production — from site/asset capture to final validated 3D model to immersive deployment — establishing production pipelines, quality benchmarks, review cycles, and resource planning  
Plan, allocate, and track resources across multiple concurrent engineering, supply chain, and XR digital twin projects, ensuring on-time delivery  
Manage production schedules, sprints, or agile workflows across capture, modeling, integration, and XR development phases  
Direct the planning and execution of 3D laser scanning, LiDAR, and photogrammetry capture for facilities, equipment, and industrial assets  
Set and uphold standards for point cloud processing, mesh reconstruction, registration accuracy, and scan-to-BIM/CAD workflows

Lead development of XR (AR/VR/MR) experiences and applications for training, remote collaboration, design review, and operational visualization using platforms such as Unreal Engine, Unity, or enterprise XR toolkits  
Guide deployment of digital twin and XR content across headsets and other immersive/AR-enabled devices as applicable  
Ensure accurate real-world-to-virtual asset fidelity for industrial, manufacturing, and supply chain digital twin and XR use cases  
Collaborate with engineering, IoT, and simulation teams to integrate live sensor/operational data into 3D/digital twin/XR environments for real-time monitoring and simulation  
Support data-driven visualization of supply chain flows, factory layouts, and asset performance within digital twin and XR environments  
Provide expert-level, hands-on guidance on asset creation, cleanup, retopology, and optimization using Autodesk Maya, 3ds Max, and Blender  
Oversee modeling, texturing, UV layout, and rendering of scan-derived and CAD-derived assets for visualization, simulation, and XR deployment  
Review and approve high-fidelity 3D assets, ensuring dimensional accuracy, consistency, and technical specification alignment with source capture data  
Guide optimization of scan-heavy and CAD-heavy assets for real-time engines, simulation environments, and XR platforms without loss of engineering-relevant detail (frame-rate and performance requirements for headset deployment)  
Partner with Engineering, Supply Chain, and Operations stakeholders to align digital twin and XR deliverables with plant, facility, and logistics planning needs  
Continuously evaluate and improve capture-to-twin and capture-to-XR pipelines, tools, and workflows conduct detailed reviews and stay ahead of industry advancements in reality capture, simulation, and XR/immersive technology  
  
Professional & Technical Skills:  
12+ years of professional experience in 3D art/visualization production, with significant experience in reality capture, photogrammetry, digital twin, or XR (AR/VR/MR) development for engineering, manufacturing, or supply chain environments  
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Fine Arts, Animation, Industrial Design, Engineering, or a related discipline (or equivalent professional experience)  
Expert-level, hands-on proficiency (not just familiarity) with:
  
o Blender  
o Autodesk Maya  
o Autodesk 3ds Max  
Substantial hands-on experience with 3D scanning, photogrammetry, and reality capture workflows — from field capture through point cloud/mesh processing to final asset delivery  
Practical experience with Digital Twin development and platforms (e.g., NVIDIA Omniverse, USD pipelines)  
Hands-on experience developing and deploying XR (AR/VR/MR) applications and experiences, including familiarity with XR and XR-specific interaction/UX design considerations  
Familiarity with CAD/BIM ecosystems (e.g., AutoCAD, Revit, SolidWorks, Navisworks) and scan-to-BIM/CAD workflows  
Proficiency with real-time and simulation/XR platforms (e.g., Unity, Unreal Engine, Unity Reflect, Twinmotion, or proprietary enterprise visualization/XR tools)  
Proficiency with texturing and material authoring tools such as Substance Painter, Substance Designer, or Mari, and Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Substance 3D, After Effects)  
Proven track record managing and leading teams of 5+ artists/technicians, with direct accountability for project scoping, scheduling, resource allocation, and on-time delivery  
Strong portfolio/reel demonstrating scan-to-model, digital twin, and/or XR project outcomes, including examples relevant to industrial, engineering, or supply chain contexts  
Deep, practical understanding of modeling, UV layout, PBR texturing, retopology, lighting, and rendering pipelines, particularly for CAD- and scan-derived data  
Experience optimizing large, dense scan/CAD assets for real-time engines and XR/headset deployment (e.g., Unreal Engine or Unity)  
  
Additional Information:  
Background in game development or real-time 3D environments (Unity, Unreal).  
Autodesk Certified Professional – Maya or 3ds Max  
NVIDIA Omniverse Certification (or NVIDIA Deep Learning Institute courses on Omniverse/USD)  
Unity Certified Professional: Artist / 3D Artist, or Unreal Engine Certification  
Adobe Certified Professional – Photoshop / Substance 3D  
Familiarity with real-time rendering engines and game engine integration for simulation and XR use cases  
Basic scripting knowledge (Python, C#, or relevant programming language)  
This position is based at our Bengaluru office.  
A 15 years full-time education is required.

29321f81.description:
Work Your Magic with us!
  
  
Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.
  
  
**Job Description**
We are seeking an experienced Oracle APEX Service Delivery Manager who is not only an expert developer but also possesses strong project management and business analysis skills. The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 12 to 15 years of experience in Oracle APEX development, project delivery, and leading teams. This role demands a highly skilled professional who can estimate project durations, assign tasks to team members, willing to create FRS documentations and serve as the primary point of contact for business stakeholders.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Service Delivery Management:

* Oversee the delivery of Oracle APEX projects, ensuring alignment with business goals and objectives.
* Estimate project timelines and resource requirements, assigning tasks effectively to team members to meet deadlines.
* Act as the primary point of contact (POC) for business stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
* Implement automation cases as part of service improvement using AI to enhance operational efficiency and effectiveness.
* Perform thorough assessment of business requirements and provide informed recommendations to the project team on whether to implement the solution using Oracle APEX or Snowflake, ensuring the chosen technology best aligns with business needs and technical feasibility.

* Development Leadership:





- Lead the design, development, and deployment of Oracle APEX applications in line with business requirements.
- Write Functional Requirements Specifications (FRS) and User Requirements Specifications (URS) to guide development and ensure stakeholder alignment.
- Support business and developers in drafting comprehensive FRS and URS documentation.

* Technical Skills and Capabilities:





- Proficiency in Oracle APEX, PL/SQL, Oracle SQL, and RESTful Web Services integration.
- Experience with reporting tools and frameworks, such as Jasper Reports and integration with platforms like Snowflake and GoAnywhere.
- Strong understanding of application migration processes, particularly from Oracle Forms to Oracle APEX.
- Familiarity with Agile methodologies, JIRA, and version control systems like GIT and SVN.
- Knowledge of Jenkins for continuous integration and deployment practices.
- Capability to conduct thorough code reviews, testing, and ensure compliance with quality standards.

* Solution Architecture:





- Collaborate with technical teams to design scalable and efficient solutions for new projects.
- Ensure that architectural designs meet business needs and adhere to best practices in application development.

* Technical Mentorship:





- Provide technical leadership to both internal and external teams, fostering a collaborative and innovative environment.
- Mentor junior developers, offering guidance on best practices in Oracle APEX development and project management.

* Stakeholder Communication:





- Communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders to gather requirements, provide project updates, and facilitate decision-making.
- Ensure that all project documentation is maintained and updated regularly.

**Qualifications**







- Minimum 12 to 15 years of experience in Oracle APEX development and service delivery management.
- Strong knowledge of Oracle APEX, PL/SQL, Oracle SQL, and JavaScript.
- Proven experience in writing FRS and URS documents.
- Extensive experience in integrating applications with REST APIs and third-party platforms.
- Hands-on experience in project management and agile methodologies.
- Proven experience in developing Oracle APEX applications integrated with AI technologies to enhance application capabilities, automate business processes, and increase overall team productivity.
- Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage with business stakeholders at all levels.
- Experience leading diverse teams and managing multiple projects concurrently.
- Strong analytical skills and problem-solving capabilities.
- Oracle APEX certified is preferred.

**Note : The candidate should be willing to work in hybrid model (2-3 days working from office) and in UK shift 1.30 PM to 10.30 PM IST.**
**What we offer:**
We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!
  
  
Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

d1ccde78.title: Program Manager
d1ccde78.description:
**Location, Working Hours and Notice Period**

Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai, Pune. NCR, India (hybrid). Shift: 1:00 PM to 10:00 PM IST, Monday to Friday, covering the EMEA working day and US Eastern mornings, with occasional calls up to 11:30 PM IST for US West Coast teams. Notice period: immediate joiners to 60 days preferred; up to 90 days considered.

**Role Summary**

BrightEdge Technical Services makes customer data trustworthy within 30 days of integration, finishes the setup that makes customers successful in the 30 days after onboarding, and keeps that data trustworthy through renewal. The team is scaling from a proven pilot to a standard motion in every BrightEdge business unit, and its delivery engine sits in India.

As Program Manager, Technical Services Engagements, you own how those engagements run, from intake to customer sign-off, for customers across the US, EMEA and APAC. You manage the complex engagements yourself, run the portfolio for the rest, and own every customer escalation on a Technical Services engagement, with the delivery team beside you, Customer Success and the customer.

If you have worked as an Engagement Manager or Implementation Program Manager at a SaaS company, this role will feel familiar: scope, plan, status, change control, escalations and acceptance. Customer Success owns the customer relationship; you make Technical Services its most reliable partner.

**Key Role Responsibilities**

* Own the Technical Services engagement portfolio end to end: intake, tiering, assignment, scope sign-off, delivery tracking, customer sign-off and closure.
* Serve as engagement manager on complex engagements, such as multi-domain estates and enterprise and strategic accounts: build the plan, hold the timeline, manage risks, dependencies and change, and lead acceptance.
* Own escalations on Technical Services engagements: make sure each is acknowledged fast, agree an action plan with the Customer Success owner within one business day, drive the fix with the delivery team, write the daily update until it closes, and lead the root-cause review.
* Hold scope with care: review every scope sign-off before it goes out, run change control, and route new requests into a new, approved scope.
* Keep the engagement tracker as the single source of truth: milestones, hours against estimate, QA status, service levels and a risk log. Flag an engagement the day it turns amber.
* Work side by side with the Support delivery teams to match work to capacity and keep hand-offs to US and EMEA colleagues clean across time zones.
* Work inside the Customer Success relationship: the CSM or Onboarding Manager owns the customer, the agenda and every invitation. On your engagements and your escalations, you are the one Technical Services voice, on the account thread and on the calls they set.
* Report performance: monthly business unit scorecards, service levels and trends, and inputs to executive and board updates.
* Improve the engagement model: templates, playbooks, SalesForce views, tracker automation and retrospectives. Propose rule changes through change control.
* Support each business unit's launch of Technical Services: engagement setup, tracker lines and the weekly interlock.
* Partner with Support and Engineering when a product defect surfaces in an engagement, through the Jira escalation lane.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Candidate Traits**

* Calm and decisive in an escalation. You own the problem until it is closed and keep everyone informed without being asked.
* Confident on a US customer call from India: clear, direct English, equally credible with a marketing leader who doubts the numbers and analytics engineer who owns the integration.
* Holds scope firmly and kindly. Accommodate scope changes as necessary.
* Process discipline without bureaucracy. The tracker is always current, and every status report fits on one page.
* Influence without authority: you move work through delivery leads, CSMs and customer teams in three regions.
* Sense of urgency.
* Data-driven. You run the portfolio on the scorecard and spot the trend before it becomes an escalation.
* Service mindset: additional hands and eyes on Customer Success's side, never a second track for the customer.

**Background**

* 7 to 12 years of experience, including at least 4 years in customer-facing program, implementation or engagement management at a B2B SaaS product company.
* A record of running 15 or more concurrent engagements for US or EMEA customers against scope, timelines, hours and acceptance criteria, with oversight of a larger portfolio.
* Escalation management with US enterprise customers, alongside Customer Success and account teams, including executive-level communication.
* Technical fluency in marketing and analytics technology: Google Analytics 4, Adobe Analytics, Google Search Console, single sign-on, APIs and data validation. SEO, Martech or AI search platform experience is a strong plus.
* Tools: Zendesk or Freshdesk, Salesforce, Jira, and Excel, Google Sheets or BI for reporting.
* Excellent spoken and written English: leading a call with a customer's leadership, and writing scope documents, status reports and executive summaries.
* Bachelors Degres or an equivalent degree; an MBA or PMP is a plus.

BrightEdge is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants of every background.

88995ba2.title: Professional Services Program Manager
88995ba2.description:
**Our Mission**
At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
  
  
**Who We Are**
In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
  
  
We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Professional Services Program Manager will lead services programs and projects as part of the delivery cycle, including handling all deployment resources and ensuring that all deliverables are met and delivered on-time and under budget. The Program Manager will drive customer deployment programs and projects including program, process initiatives, as well as partner with IT on systems and infrastructure processes.
  
  
**Your Impact**

* Determine project partners and team structure/organization partners will include technical and business resources
* In conjunction with project partners, help ensure the definition of project scope, requirements, and deliverables
* Develop project timeline and landmarks using appropriate tools and techniques
* Build and execute project work plans and revise as appropriate to meet changing needs and requirements
* Identify resources needed and assign individual responsibilities and tasks
* Run day-to-day operational aspects of a project and scope
* Work on services operational projects that target new services IP delivery, partner communications, scheduling, etc.
* Review deliverables prepared by team before passing to client
* Effectively apply Palo Alto Networks Project Management methodology and implement project standards
* Minimize our exposure and risk on all projects
* Ensure project documents are complete, current, and stored appropriately
* Track and report team hours and expenses on a weekly basis

**Qualifications**
**Your Experience**

* BS in Computer Science, MIS, Business, or equivalent education/training/experience or equivalent military experience required
* 5+ years of related work experience or leading complex projects desired
* Analyze project profitability, revenue, margins, bill rates, and utilization
* Good presentation skills including written, oral, presentation
* Good organizational skills including tool utilization (spreadsheets, project management tools etc), information collection, attention to detail, and prioritization
* Strong interpersonal skills including appreciation and the ability to elicit collaboration from a wide variety of sources, including upper management, clients, and other departments
* Flexible to shifting priorities, demands, and timelines - able to promptly and expertly react to project adjustments and alterations
* Experience managing large scale (Global) deployments with multiple projects, teams and resources
* Experience with Google’s G Suite (Drive, Docs, Sheets, and Slides) is a plus

3452bc24.title: Salesforce Delivery Manager
3452bc24.description:
**Your Job**
As a Salesforce Delivery Manager at Koch, you will lead the successful delivery of enterprise-scale Salesforce programs and digital transformation initiatives. In this role, you will provide leadership across delivery, architecture, stakeholder engagement, and team development while ensuring scalable, secure, and high-quality Salesforce solutions that create long-term value for our businesses. You will work closely with business partners, product teams, architects, and global delivery teams to enable innovation, improve business outcomes, and drive continuous improvement across the Salesforce ecosystem.
  
  
**Our Team**
The Enterprise Applications team enables Koch companies by delivering technology solutions that support critical business capabilities and digital transformation initiatives. Our team partners closely with business stakeholders, architects, and technology professionals across the globe to develop scalable, secure, and innovative Salesforce solutions that help create value and accelerate business outcomes.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Delivery & Program Management**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of Salesforce programs across multiple business units and geographies.
* Manage program scope, timelines, risks, dependencies, and resource planning.
* Establish delivery governance, status reporting, metrics, and release management processes.
* Ensure successful execution of Agile/Scrum projects and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Drive on-time, high-quality delivery while maintaining stakeholder satisfaction.

**Salesforce Technical Leadership**

* Provide technical oversight for Salesforce implementations and enhancements.
* Review and approve solution architecture, design patterns, integrations, and security models.
* Ensure adherence to Salesforce best practices and enterprise standards.
* Guide teams in Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flows, APIs, Platform Events, and Integration frameworks.
* Lead adoption of emerging Salesforce capabilities including Agentforce, Einstein AI, Data Cloud, and Experience Cloud.

**Stakeholder & Business Engagement**

* Partner with business leaders, product owners, architects, and delivery teams.
* Translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Facilitate executive reviews, steering committee meetings, and roadmap planning.
* Provide strategic recommendations for platform optimization and digital transformation.

**Team Leadership**

* Lead and mentor Salesforce architects, technical leads, developers, administrators, and consultants.
* Drive capability development, succession planning, and technical excellence.
* Conduct hiring, onboarding, and performance development activities.
* Build a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.

**Architecture & Integration Oversight**

* Oversee integrations with ERP, middleware, data platforms, and third-party applications.
* Ensure scalability, reliability, security, and maintainability of solutions.
* Drive DevOps maturity using Salesforce DX, Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and deployment frameworks.
* Reduce technical debt through modernization and platform optimization initiatives.

**Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)**

* 12+ years of overall IT experience, including 8+ years of hands-on Salesforce platform experience.
* 5+ years of experience leading large-scale Salesforce delivery programs and globally distributed teams.
* Experience delivering complex Salesforce solutions across multiple business units and stakeholder groups.
* Strong knowledge of Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, CPQ, Marketing Cloud, Manufacturing Cloud, and Data Cloud.
* Experience with Salesforce development and integration technologies, including Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce Flows, SOQL/SOSL, Platform Events, and REST/SOAP APIs.
* Experience implementing Agile delivery methodologies and managing program governance, budgeting, risks, and dependencies.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and leadership skills with the ability to influence technical and business decisions.

**What Will Put You Ahead**

* Salesforce certifications such as Application Architect, System Architect, Technical Architect, Platform Developer, or related credentials.
* Experience leading enterprise-wide Salesforce transformation programs with multi-million-dollar budgets.
* Hands-on experience with Agentforce, Einstein AI, Data Cloud, and AI-driven Salesforce capabilities.
* Experience designing and governing enterprise integration architectures using middleware and cloud integration platforms.
* Knowledge of Salesforce DX, Git-based deployment strategies, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing frameworks, and DevOps best practices.
* Experience working within manufacturing, supply chain, shared services, or complex global enterprise environments.
* Proven success driving platform modernization, technical debt reduction, and adoption of scalable design patterns.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor technical leaders and build high-performing global teams.

At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy.
  
  
**Who We Are**
At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.
  
  
Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results.

e4451390.title: Program Manager III, Transportation Financial Systems (TFS)
e4451390.description:
**Description**
Transportation Financial Systems (TFS) team is looking for a talented and highly motivated Sr. Program Manager who enjoy solving challenging and complex business problems at Amazon scale.
  
  
Imagine being a part of a team where every single team member is a critical voice in the decision-making process, has a meaningful impact on product features, and has the ability to re-define the customer experience. Welcome to Transportation Financial Systems (TFS), where we are building multiple financial automation products and functionalities to meet Amazon’s ever-growing finance and accounting customer requirements. You will be in a well-funded, highly technical, and highly visible business critical tech platform team.
  
  
We are a technology team focused on building a suite of products for transportation financial systems and beyond that enable Amazon business units (BUs) to add new offerings at scale. Our products abstract complexities from the world of accounting, invoicing, audit, payment, taxation, and allocation at the required level of fidelity and insights to build generic solutions scalable to multiple businesses and geographies. We ensure that financial functions are complete, accurate, timely and compliant with worldwide regulatory and tax requirements. Our software systems include services that handle thousands or requests per second and make decisions to pay billions of dollars a year and ensure that transportation's liabilities and revenues are correctly accounted. Our current team comprises of ~200+ engineering organization and Program management team of 10+ TPMs and Program Managers with great growth and lateral opportunity.
  
  
We are looking for a high caliber Senior Program Manager (Sr. PM) who enjoy working on challenging, high impact business problems. The Sr. PM will manage business onboarding to our systems and services, prioritize opportunities in tech systems /process flows and support the functional systems to deliver to defined goals. Successful candidates will be analytical, highly-organized, accustomed to working with technical teams, able to bridge the gap between business and tech, clear communicators, and interested in getting deep into the details of our business. This Program Manager is a high visible role as s/he will front end with Senior Leaders across Amazon Organization.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As a Sr. PM on the team, you would be responsible for understanding the functional flow of TFS onboarded businesses and key TFS capabilities, required to enable transport finance processes (account payables and receivables) and identifying opportunities to refine both. The Sr. PM will manage the auditing, invoicing, payments products and process with a team of SMEs in TFS and partner teams, identify short term solutions and work with Product/SDM on long term solutions to customer problems. The Sr. PM will evaluate self-serve opportunities to reduce overhead load on TFS, document dashboard or tool requirements and present to TFS Tech team to build consensus for solutions to self-serve on commonly occurring issues. The program manager will work closely with Product/SDM to define the road map. Key responsibilities -
  
  

* Define and manage cross-functional program strategy, including mission, vision, objectives, and measurable success criteria, while driving teams across organizations to deliver on key milestones.
* Analyze data to identify trends, drive improvements, and inform resource allocation decisions — regularly reviewing metrics and proactively seeking new mechanisms for visibility into program health.
* Lead stakeholder alignment through clear written narratives and verbal communication, presenting program updates, trade-offs, and recommendations to senior leadership.
* Identify and mitigate risks proactively, reduce exposure to common failure modes such as unclear requirements or ineffective cross-team collaboration, and solve ambiguous problems with sound judgment.
* Streamline processes and eliminate unnecessary dependencies, partnering with engineering and business teams to prioritize initiatives that improve efficiency and customer outcomes.

A day in the life
  
  
TFS has over 200+ engineers, and 20+ product & program managers. Each Program Manager is responsible for delivering large to medium programs; working closely with business teams and product, building transformation roadmaps to deliver long term benefits for our customers.
  
  
**About The Team**
Transportation Financial Systems (TFS) platform owns the technology components that perform the financial activities for Amazon’s transportation business. TFS systems are used across all Amazon’s transportation programs and retail expansion to new geographies. The platform provide financial document creation & management, expense auditing, accounting, payments and cost allocation functions. Our new generation products are highly scalable and operate at finer level granularity to reconcile every dollar in transportation financial accounts with zero manual entries or corrections. The goal is to develop global product suite for all freight modes touching every single package movement across Amazon. Our mission is to abstract logistics complexities from financial world and financial complexities from logistics world. You will be part of one of the largest tech and program team with ~200 engineering organization with great growth and lateral opportunity.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
* Experience owning program strategy, end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
  
  
  
**Company**
- ADCI HYD 13 SEZ

b7c2b1ed.title: CRM Architect
b7c2b1ed.description:
Job Description
  

Avanade India’s Business Applications practice is looking for a Dynamics 365 CRM Solution Architect to take overall architectural ownership of our CRM projects. This is a senior, functionally led role for someone whose career has been built on Dynamics 365 CRM — who understands how sales, service, marketing and field teams actually work, and can design a CRM solution that fits those processes rather than forcing them to fit the product.

You will lead solution design across the Dynamics 365 customer engagement modules and the Power Platform, run the functional conversation with business stakeholders, and give the technical team a design they can build. The emphasis is on functional depth — process design, fit-gap, configuration-first solutions and adoption — backed by enough technical understanding to make sound decisions on integration, data, security and extension, and to hold the build team to a good standard. The role also carries a strong presales element: you will be the CRM solution lead on pursuits for Dynamics 365 and Power Apps opportunities — shaping the solution, demonstrating it, estimating it and helping us win it.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end solution architecture for Dynamics 365 CRM projects — from discovery and requirements through design, build, testing, go-live and hypercare.

* Lead business process workshops with client stakeholders, map current and future-state processes, and translate them into a Dynamics 365 solution design.

* Run fit-gap analysis against standard Dynamics 365 capability, favouring configuration over customisation, and make clear recommendations where gaps need Power Platform or custom extension.

* Design functional solutions across the Dynamics 365 customer engagement modules: Sales (lead-to-opportunity, forecasting, sales accelerator), Customer Service and Contact Center (case management, SLAs, entitlements, knowledge, omnichannel routing), Field Service (work orders, scheduling, resources, assets, inventory), Customer Insights – Journeys and Customer Insights – Data (marketing journeys, segmentation, unified customer profile), and Project Operations where project-based selling and delivery are in scope.

* Design the Dataverse data model and security model — tables, relationships, business units, security roles, teams, field-level security and hierarchy security — to match the client’s organisation.

* Design Power Platform extensions: model-driven apps for core CRM processes, canvas apps for task-focused and mobile scenarios, Power Pages portals for customers and partners, and Power Automate for workflow and automation.

* Bring Copilot and AI capabilities into the CRM solution where they add value — Copilot in Sales and Customer Service, Copilot Studio agents and AI-assisted productivity features.

* Define the integration approach with ERP, marketing, telephony, websites and third-party systems — at design level, with the technical team owning detailed build.

* Define data migration strategy from legacy CRM platforms (Salesforce, older Dynamics CRM versions or others) — mapping, cleansing, sequencing and reconciliation.

* Author and own solution design documents, functional specifications, configuration workbooks and architecture decisions, and walk client stakeholders through them.

* Guide functional consultants and developers during build, review configuration and design quality, and resolve functional and architectural escalations.

* Oversee testing strategy with QA and business teams — scenario coverage, UAT support and business sign-off — and support cutover and go-live readiness.

* Set ALM, environment and governance standards with the technical lead — solutions, environments, deployment approach and Power Platform governance.

* Lead presales solutioning for Dynamics 365 CRM and Power Apps opportunities — understanding the client’s business problem, qualifying scope and shaping the right solution from the Dynamics 365 modules and Power Platform components.

* Run presales discovery workshops, business-process walkthroughs and high-level fit-gap to define the solution scope and approach.

* Build and deliver tailored solution demos and proofs of concept on Dynamics 365 and Power Apps, showing the client’s own scenarios rather than generic product tours.

* Prepare solution architecture, scope, assumptions, effort estimates, phasing and team structure for proposals, RFP/RFI responses and statements of work.

* Advise on Dynamics 365 and Power Platform licensing during presales, and position the solution against competing platforms such as Salesforce and ServiceNow.

* Work with sales, bid management, delivery and Microsoft account and partner teams on pursuits, including Microsoft co-sell and funded programmes where applicable.

* Present the solution and delivery approach in client orals and executive presentations, and support negotiation of scope through to contract and handover to delivery.

* Mentor CRM functional consultants and contribute reusable process models, demo assets and accelerators to the practice.

  
Qualification
  

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 14–17 years of overall experience, with the substantial majority focused on Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM / Customer Engagement and its predecessor Dynamics CRM versions.

* Deep functional expertise in Dynamics 365 Sales and Dynamics 365 Customer Service, with strong working knowledge of at least one of Field Service, Customer Insights (Journeys / Data), Contact Center or Project Operations.

* Proven experience as solution or functional architect on multiple end-to-end Dynamics 365 CRM implementations, including at least two full lifecycle projects from design to go-live.

* Strong grounding in CRM business processes — lead and opportunity management, account and contact management, quote and order, case management, service scheduling and marketing journeys.

* Demonstrated ability to run discovery and process workshops, lead fit-gap analysis and produce clear solution designs and functional specifications.

* Strong command of the Power Platform: model-driven apps, canvas apps, Power Pages and Power Automate — knowing which to use for which scenario.

* Good understanding of Dataverse — data model, security model, business rules, business process flows and configuration capability.

* Technical implementation understanding sufficient to guide the build team: plug-ins and JavaScript extension points, integration patterns (APIs, connectors, Azure integration services), data migration tooling and ALM — hands-on development is not required.

* Experience designing data migration from legacy CRM platforms and managing data quality through cutover.

* Awareness of Dynamics 365 and Power Platform licensing and how it shapes solution design.

* Strong client-facing skills — credible with sales, service and marketing leaders, and able to defend design decisions with business and IT stakeholders.

* Experience guiding and reviewing the work of functional consultants and developers on medium-to-large projects.

* Solid presales experience for Dynamics 365 CRM and Power Apps based solutions — discovery, solution shaping, demos, estimation and proposal writing — with a track record of contributing to won deals.

* Understanding of the presales lifecycle from qualification through RFP response, orals and negotiation, and of how estimates and assumptions translate into commercial risk.

* Ability to build and deliver compelling Dynamics 365 and Power Platform demos tailored to the client’s industry and processes.

**Preferred / Good to Have**

* Microsoft certifications: Dynamics 365 Customer Experience Analyst (MB-280), Customer Service Functional Consultant (MB-230), Field Service Functional Consultant (MB-240), Power Platform Solution Architect (PL-600) or Dynamics 365 Fundamentals (MB-910).

* Hands-on experience with Copilot in Dynamics 365 Sales and Customer Service, and with Copilot Studio agents in a CRM context.

* Experience migrating clients from Salesforce or other CRM platforms to Dynamics 365.

* Experience integrating Dynamics 365 CRM with Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, Business Central or SAP.

* Experience with Microsoft FastTrack or Success by Design reviews.

* Industry depth in one or more of BFSI, manufacturing, retail, professional services, healthcare or public sector.

* Exposure to Power BI reporting for CRM and to Customer Insights – Data for customer analytics.

* Experience in a consulting, global delivery or SI environment (Avanade, Accenture, or similar).

* Experience with Microsoft partner motions — co-sell, Microsoft-funded engagements (e.g. Business Applications workshops and envisioning programmes) and joint pursuits with Microsoft account teams.

* Competitive knowledge of Salesforce, ServiceNow and other CRM platforms for positioning and migration pursuits.
